༷/shā|༷༵༵/khrim/ma//༷/19rnyigisakhrirmi/khrikhri ༷༷༷hāX ༷/༷༷/shākhri:sbyo/khriXswār+shahā/tshohā:hāmi pa::7keshāng
72gtsog ༷༄khya (5855/༄79can/sku chen5/dpobag gotshetshetsha ba mda' smyug gis brkyas/ོ ge ngibabla dpagi rna6474ge gorna1
/(skyi|khyen((85597zla5//〉(tshoni5/dpochogayo sgrigag melce/smu/ |spri 〉〉phyo/tsho/177ga——— nga gatsha ba mda' smyug gis btsos/kun su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang /
dkar chag smu/ ā+oṃ ||hā//spyo gañdza1ca —— — yid khams rgya mtsho drag tu skyom pa'i snyan dbyangs/༷ (1)bod yul chol kha gsum/ ji ༷ ce (47)rtog ge pa'i mig nang gi chos lugs kyi 'jig rten/ (71)rang rtsom log rtogs snying stobs dang 'brel ba'i gtam/ ce(204)zhogs dung gi gdong grogs/ ༷ ༷ ༷ (215)deb sgrig pa po'i gsal bshad/ ༷ (265)
yid khams rgya ma:byo drag tu spyodam pa'i snyan dbyangs/———ka ma skal bzang me tog gi 'khrab ston gyi sgyu rtsal sleng ba/mkhas pas nyams dang 'gyur la lta bar byed//blun pos skad dang gzugs la lta bar byed//dbul yos gos dang rgyan la lta bar byed// byis pas rogs dang glog la lta bar byed//sngon du 'gro ba'i gtam/deng sang ga sa ga ru glu gar 'khrab ston ru khrag 'dra rtsa'adzugs byas te de nyid bod kyi rig gzhung rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel gtong ba yin zer kyin 'dug mod/ 'dzam gling shar nub yongs su skad grags chod pa'i bod pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gzhung zhes bya ba de/ bod rigs nag mo tshos a la yo zer bzhin ong do phar g.yug tshur g.yug byed bzhin pa dang / skyes pa tshos phu dung sa 'drud gnam 'drud byed bzhin pa 'di ga la sher ba yin na bod pa'i rig —1—
gzhung am des su la ci zhig mkho ba yin nam/ skad cha 'di ni skyes yul mdo stod tsha rong nas yin pa'i dge bshes mar log cig gis bshad pa red/ gus pas kyang sngon chad kho pa'i skad cha de mtha' gcig tu bden par rlom nas 'khrab ston gyi rigs la lta tshul yag po zhig rtsab nas 'dzin myong med/ da lta gzhi nas zhib 'dang re brgyab na lta tshul de ni ma 'grig pa zhig tu snang ste/bden dge mdzes gsum gyi ya gyal mdzes sdug gi rnam grangs gang yang 'jig rten 'dir med pa'i dbang du btang na 'tsho ba'i bro ba yod tshad yal zin pa yin pas da gzod kha dog med pa'i mi yul 'dir don snying ci zhig yod dam/mdzes pa kun gyi nang nas phul du byung ba'i mdzes pa ni sgyu rtsal phun tshogs kyi mdzes pa 'di yin la/ rnam mang sgyu rtsal gyi khrod nas snyan ngag gi brtsams chos lta bu yig ngos sgyu rtsal ni tshad nges can zhig gi thog nas bshad na don du sgyu rtsal shi ro yin zhing / ri mo'i sgyu rtsal lta bu lag shes sgyu rtsal ni sgyu rtsal gyi 'dra gzugs tsam du zad/ rol mo'i sgyu rtsal lta bu g.yar ma'i sgyu rtsal ni sgyu rtsal gyi phyi shu na kho na las ma 'das/ glu gzhas dang zlos gar lta bu 'khrab ston gyi sgyu rtsal gcig pu gzi byin rab tu 'bar ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi dwangs ma dang / bla tshe srog gsum gyis ma stongs pa'i snyan ngag gson po ru grub yod stabs/ mi rigs shig gi 'khrab ston gyi sgyu rtsal de mi rigs gang de'i rig gnas kyi bla srog min du chug kyang don lnga snod drug gi gras su cis kyang yod nges/ dmigs yul gzhan du — 1—
bskor te bshad na mi rigs kyi ngo bo srung nyar dang / skad yig dang rig gzhung myur skyob kyi thad la yang sgyu rtsal 'khrab ston gyi rigs 'dis nus pa ang dang po 'don bzhin yod pa myong grub yin te/ dus rabs phyed ku'i yar sngon nas bod rigs mi dmangs rnams 'dzam gling yongs su kha 'thor zhing / bod nang khul du'ang dum bu mang po yar bcad mar bcad byas te bzhag yod pas phan tshun 'brel gtug dang mnyam las byed pa'i go skabs ha lam med pa lta bu'i dus 'dir yang 'khrab ston sna tshogs brgyud nas rgyus lon phran bu re yong thub kyin yod la/ gzhis byes gnyis su gnas bzhin pa'i bod rigs gzhon skyes rnams skabs res 'ga' tsam la lhan 'dzoms kyi go skabs 'dra rag dus kyang gzhis byes so sor glu gzhas gtong mkhan su dang su zhig yod pa dang / rang nyid ches dga' shos kyi glu gzhas gang yin pa sogs ni skad cha kun gli gling gzhi yin 'dug pas so//brgya tshogs stong 'dus dbus kyi mi mo/nga tsho bod nang khul la mtshon na gzhung sger chos gsum gang rung gis bkod sgrig byas pa'i 'khrab stegs che ma chung gsum gyi thog tu 'dzegs nas sa lding gnam lding byed bzhin pa'i glu pa glu ma'am gzhas pa gzhas ma'i kha grangs nī mang thag chod nas brtseyang mi thon par 'dug 'on kyang sde tsho lung shog nyi —3—
tshe ba las brgal te gzhis byes bod mi yongs kyis dga' bsu thob par ma zad rgyal khab gzhan dag dang mi rigs gzhan pa/ tha na 'dzam gling gi gzigs mo ba tsho'i khrod du'ang grags 'gul mi chung ba bzo myong mkhan gyi 'khrab ston pa ni khams sde dge nas yin pa'i glu pa yar dung ngam g.ya' dwangs lags dang / bde chen khams pa'i sras mo dbyangs can lha mo lags rnam gnyis ma gtogs gzhan pa su yang da sngon thon myong med/ sku zhabs g.ya' dwangs lags kyi 'khrab ston la deng rabs kyi sgyu rtsal gyis phyug cing sras mo dbyangs can ma'i glu dbyangs ni srol rgyun gyi bro bas gtams pa shas che ba zhig tu snang / deng sang gar stegs steng nas 'khrug po slong bzhin pa'i gsar bu gsar mo khyu zhig 'dug pa'i khrod nas gzhon skyes phal mo ches kha nas yig drug bzhin zlo zhing / sems nang du bsam gtan bzhin sgom bzhin pa ni dkar mdzes kun dga' dang mdo ba tshe skyid gnyis red 'dug de yang da sngon rang re'i gar stegs thog tu kun dga' lta bu'i ltag shar pho sgo can zhig dang / tshe skyed lta bu'i sman shar mo sgo can zhig thon myong med stabs gzhon pa tsho'i sems sa thog tu phab thub kyin med pa 'dra/thugs khag khyon nas med de/ 1992 lor sku zhabs khi lin thin rgyal khab chen po a me ri ku'i thengs zhe gnyis pa'i srid 'dzin du bdams pa dang / 2005 lor khong 'dzam gling mi mang gis 'dzam gling yongs kyi dbu khrid ang gnyis pa ru bdams pa bcas la'ang khong gi gzugs byad kyis thugs rkyen nges can zhig —4—
thebs yod pa'i shod tshul yod pa dang / na ning ste 2006 lor shar lho e she ya'i yul gru the lan di ru sa go la'i rgyal sras lhan tshogs kyi skabs su/ 'brug rgyal sras 'jig/sa med ge sar rnam rgyal dbang phyug mchog phul byung rgyal sras gcig pu ru bdams thon byung song ba yang yid dbang 'phrog pa'i khong gi skyes gzugs la brten nas yin 'dug na/ nga tshos mig dbang gso ba'i sgyu rtsal 'khrab ciston pa tshor skyes lus gzugs gsum gyi cha nas gdeng 'jog tsam byed pa ni mi 'os pa dang mi 'tsham pa ci yang min/ de lta na'ang 'khrab ston ni 'khrab ston rang yin gyi 'grems ston dang bshams ston gang yang ma yin la/ sgyu rtsal gyi mdzes pa zer ba de'ang rang byung thon dngos shig gi phyi dbyibs legs pa tsam la mi zer bar mi'i rigs kyi rnam dpyod kyi klong nas brdol ba'i nyams 'gyur ram blos bslang gi bkod pa khyad par ba zhig la go ba yin 'dug pas/ rnam pa yag btsog kho na sgyu rtsal pa'i tshad gzhi 'jal byed ang dang po ru rlom na de ni 'khrul pa min du chugs kyang nor ba yin par the tshom med/ gzugs mdzes pa dang / ji skad snyan pa/ sems bzang ba tsam gyis sgyu rtsal pa ru mi 'gro bar nang sems khong gi 'gyur ba'i dwangs ma rnams phyi lus ngag gi nyams kyi thog tu gson por bzhengs skrun byed thub pa'i thabs rtsal zhig la 'khrab ston gyi sgyu rtsal rdu 'bod pa shes dgos/ de ltar na glu pa kun dasa' dang glu ma tshe skyid gnyis rnam pa mdzes shing skad ngag snyan pa bden yang phul byung gi glu pa glu mar gdam —5—
pa'i cha rkyen da dung 'tshol dgos/ snyam/ kho bor glu gar gyi rigs la do snang slebs nas lo gcig lhag song ring mdo dbus khams gsum gyi glu gzhas mi nyung ba zhig myong rol byas pa'i khrod nas skal bzang me tog zer ba'i bu mo de dang / /bo mo'i 'khrab ston khag gis nam yang gsub tu med pa'i bag chags zab mo zhig bzhag byung / de'ang sngar lo'i dbyar khar/ kha byang du gnas yul gyi bu mozhes bris pa'i brnyan 'khor de khrom rar thon pa nas bzung kho mo gsar du ngo shes shing / de nas bzung ste da lta'i bar du brnyan 'khor de la phal cher nyin rer tshar re bltas pa yin mod/ da dung sun snang med pa'i thog tu blta rgyu zhig dang myang rgyu zhig rnyed bzhin 'dug pas/ lta bas tshog mi shes pa'i gzugs dang /mnyan pas ngoms pa med pa'i dbyangs/ nam yang bklags myi tshar ba'i snyan ngag sogs kyang dkon pa tsam las gtan nas med pa min pa'i nges shes gsal por rnyed/ na gzhon snyan ngag pa skyabs chen lags kyis/ bod kyi rol mo'i bla srog ga par yod dam/ zhes dri ba 'gangs chen zhig gton 'dug pa de la/ bod kyi rol mo'i bla srog 'di gar yod/ ces dris lan 'gangs chen zhig btab 'dug pa'i snang ba yang ster/ spyir sgyu rtsal phun tshogs kyi ro bro mthar thug de sgyu rtsal rig pa la sbyangs 'dris med pa'i mi dag la mtshon na smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa zhig yin shas che yang / byams sdang byis pa'i sems dang kha mngar lkug pa'i lce yi dpe ltar phyogs 'gro tsam re dpog mi thub pa'ang min par snang bas/—6—
'dir kho bos glu ma skal bzang me tog gi glu dbyangs sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos khag las rang gi myong tshor tsam zhig rnam pa lhan rgyas kyi snyan lam du 'di ltar bsgron par bya ste/gcig gzhugagashigalhadamedam/ sgyu rtsal med pa'i sgyu rtsal de sgyu rtsal kun gyi mchog tu bsngags pa cis ma bden/ hob ste bltas na skal bzang me tog gi byad gzugs dang / skad ngag nyams 'gyur/ stangs stabs/ tha na rgyan gos tshun chad dkyus ma dang / spyir btang ga 'ba' zhig las bltas na mig tshig pa dang /mnyan na rna 'bar 'ong ba de 'dra ci yang mi 'dug yod tshad dkyus ma dang spyir btang ba yin pa'i kho mo dang / kho mo'i 'khrab ston khag gi yid 'gug gi nus pa dang / sgyu rtsal gyi mtshar sdug ni yod tshad kyi rtsemor stegs pa'i ngo mtshar phul byung gi mdzes pa zhig tu snang ste/ mdzes pa 'di'i rigs la sgyu rtsal mkhan po rnams kyis ma bcos rang byung gi sgyu rtsal gyi mdzes pa zhes 'bod bzhin 'dugngag rig sgyu rtsal la dbang 'byor ba'i dam pa dge 'dun chos 'phel lags kyi zhal nas/ snyan ngag rtsom pa'i yon tan ngo ma de snga ma'i bag chags dang rang gshis la rag las pa zhig yin/ tshig rgyan gyi bstan bcos la sbyangs pas tshigs bcad kyi rkang pa tsam ni los 'grig 'gro/ 'on kyang des snyan ngag la dgos rgyu'i nyams khyad par ba de ni thon mi thub ces gsungs 'dug snyan ngag 'bri ba la de ltar yin par ma zad 'khrab ston byed pa la yang de ga rang du 'dug ste/ 'khrab — 1 —
khrid pa'i bkod 'doms ltar sgrig 'brab dang / 'khrab ston gzhan pa'i lad 'khrab byed po dag la yang rkang gra lag gra 'grig tsam ni los yod/ 'on kyang rang la yod dgos pa'i rmang gzhi de med tshe myong dang rol bar bya rgyu'i bro ba ni gleng thabs bral/ skal bzang me tog gi 'khrab ston ni rkang pa g.yon pa rgyab tu bzhag rkang pa g.yas pa mdun du brkyangs/ lag pa gnyis ka gnam la bkyags pa'i dmag rtsed sbyong brdar lta bu u tshugs kyis 'khrab pa'i 'gul skyod min la/rkang pa g.yug lag pa g.yug yong do g.yug sked pa g.yug mgo bo g.yug yod tshad snang ba skyid po'i ngang nas g.yug ci thub byed pa'i rang snang gang shar gyi smyo 'khrab de 'dra'ang min/ bslabs shing sbyangs pa la rag ma las par mo rang dang lhan du a ma 'i pang nas rang byon du 'khrungs pa'i lhan skyes kyi shes 'jon nam/gdod ma'i rtsal nus/ dmigs bsal ba zhig gi stobs kyis dbang po sgo lnga'i rnam 'gyur dang / yan lag nying lag gi ('gul skyod phra mo yan chad la sha gseng du sim pa'i khrag bzhin myang mi tshar ba'i ro bro khyad par ba res gtams nas yod pa las 'di'i tshun chad sgyu rtsal gyi nyams dang / de'i phan chad tha mal gyi tshugs ka zhes tshad dang mtshams bzung mi shes pa zhig 'dug lus ngag yid gsum gang la yang g.ya' dang dri mas ma gos pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi gong bu phyi gsal nang gsal zhig tu grub 'dug pa 'dis ltad mo pa'i mig dang rna ba la zad du med pa'i dngos grub stsol bzhin yod par ma zad/ de las kyang yid du 'ong zhing snying du —8—
sdug pa gzhan zhig ni mo'i lhad med rnam dag gi mi gzhi dwangs r+ya 'di yin te/de'ang med du ma 'phangs pa'i zur mig dang / btsan gyis ma bcos pa'i 'dzum dkar/ rtsamam las grol ba'i bzhin mdangs/ khengs dregs min pa'i rol sgeg bcas bzhi po 'di yo rob gling gi sgyu rtsal mkhan po rnams kyis rtog pa 'char yan gyi klong nas ma gtogs myangs ma thub cing / skye bo phal pa dag gi rmi lam a+thi+-i nang du ma gtogs yid yul du 'khor ma myong ba'i mtho sgang cathang gi mdzes ma'i yon tan dmigs bsal ba bzhi yin la/ skal bzang me tog la cimatshon na yon tan dmigs bsal ba 'di bzhi char ye nas rang gas su rdzogs yod pas ngas kho mo la mi yul mdzes pa'i mdzes ma zhes brjod na 'dod/ nga tshos phyi logs nas mthong rgyu yod pa'i yon tan 'di bzhi la brten nas mdzes ma skal bzang me tog gi nang sems kyi 'jig rten yang zhi dul bab chags/ ngo tsha khrel yod/ gzhung bzang phyi ring / gshis 'jam bag phebs/ ya rabs tshugs thub/'dris sla 'grogs bde/ re ba dang lhag bsam/ byams brtsedang dkyel yangs/ drang bden dang slobs pa/ yid ches dang mos pa/ spro snang dang 'dun pa/ shes rab dang 'og 'gyu/ mnyes gshin dang 'char yan sogs rin chen gser las lhag pa'i sems khams dang / ngang rgyud bzang po 'ba' zhig gis grub yod par lam tsam tshod dpag bya thub pas/ da gzod mo rang ni mi yul mdzes pa'i mdzes ma tsam du ma zad dam pa don gyi mdzangs ma ru'ang gyur pa red/ skal bzang me —9—
tog lta bu'i bod rigs bud med kho na'i rgyud la lhan skyes su yod pa'i ngo mtsharo can gyi bud med kyi mdzes sdug de dag gis da skabs sa steng gi mi sems yod tshad 'ub gcig tu bsdu bzhin yod la/ shes nas smra ba'i rang re'i bsam blo pa dag gis mi kho mo tshor/ ri tshogs gling gi ā+o na li sā (lo057 6188 cho a/ka// 〉〉)gson po dang / dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i lha mo we na si(6055bya ñdzalta 4)yo) zhes sogs kyi cho lo 'bul bzhin 'dug skad cha de dag nga tsho rang gi mdzes rig bed spyad de zhus pa yin na nor bu don yod zhags pas ma bzung ba'i yid 'phrog lha mo zhes pa'i don red/tshe srog gi mdzes pa/ lang tsho'i zig shugs/ mi yul gyi dgod sgra/ 'jig rtem gyi bde skyed/ mi lus kyi rin thang / 'khor ba'i snying po/ 'dir snang gi phun tshogs sogs kyang phyi mdzes 'dzum lang tsho'i 'dab lag grol zhing / nang dri med dwangs gtsang gi byis blo rnam dag la 'jig rten mi'i lugs kyi dri mas btsan gyis ma g.yem pa 'di 'dra la zer ba los yin snyam/ rtsom rig mkhan pos skal bzang me tog gi phyi nang gsang gsum ji ma ji bzhin zhib 'bri byas pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi 'jig rten khrod kyi mi sna zhig dgos na/ de ni ston lo ser po'i sgang gtam nang gi mi sna'i gco bo a cag pad dbyangs khong 'jog chog sgyu rtsal gyi 'jig rten du brdzus te 'khrungs pa'i a cag pad dbyangs khong mi yul 'dir sha khrag gdos bcas kyi gzugs kyis dngos su phebs pa'i dbang du btang na/ de ni —10—
ltad mo pa tshos gangs ljongs lha yi bu mo zhes dga' 'bod bya yul gyi glu ma skal bzang me tog [yong yin 'os/ pa tsam zhig gzhan pa su yang yin 'os par ma mthong ngo /gnyis/ 'khrabastaston la ba'i 'khrabastaston/ sgyu rtsal brtsams chos dang brtsams chos phal pa gnyis kyi khyad par de rjod byed tshig gi nyam sa gtso bor byas pa dang brjod don go ba'i 'gangs gtso bor byas pa'i khyad par/ rang mtshan 'dzin pa dang spyi mtshan 'dzin pa'i khyad par/ snang brnyan bkod pa dang ma bkod pa'i khyad par sogs su smra bzhin 'dug mod/ rtsom pa po'i sems khong gi tshor 'du gnyis las gang zhig rtsal 'don byas min gyi khyad par du kho bos 'dod bzhin yod/ snyan ngag 'bri ba la blo sbyong gtso bo min par snang yul gang dang phrad kyang de'i gting rim du zug 'gro ba rno khab lta bu dang / chung rim nas myong thub pa sha'u lta bu'i tshor pa rno ngar can zhig gal che bar bshad don de yin la/ snyan ngag bu mo'i kha na yod pa'i gnad kyang der thug yod/ da lta'i bod kyi snyan ngag 'bri mkhan phal mo cher 'du shes tsam las tshor pa ye nas med stabs kho tsho la na zug med pa'i snyan ngag pa'i sde zhes 'bod kyin 'dug de bas kyang thabs skyo ba zhig ni da lta'i bod kyi glu dbyangs pa phal mo che/ glu tshig gi nang don ci yin ha mi go bar/ rang dgar kha gdang zhing lag pa g.yug bzhin 'brab stegs thog tu lu sa 'dug pa la bltas na tshor pa lta ci 'du shes kyang go chod pa —11—
phyir rtogzhig yod bzo mi 'dug pas/ de tsho la rnam shes med pa'i 'khrab ston pa'i sde zhes 'bod dgos pa e yin/ sgyu rtsal pa zhig la nges par du tshang dgos pa'i tshor pa rnon po de'ang mi gzhan pa'i bde sdug la gzhan zhig gis rgyang lta byed pa lta bu min par/ don la rang dang 'brel ba yod med gang ltar yang skabs 'brel zlos gar khrod kyi dga' skyo chags sdang gi bsam blo yod tshad rang rgyud la dngos su brje spor byed thub pa zhig dgos/ de thub min ni sgyu rtsal pa yin min 'byed pa'i mtshams rtags kye rdo ring gcib] pu de yin/ 'on kyang de thub mkhan ni shin tu dkon pas don dam pa'i sgyu rtsal pa yang nyin mo'i skar ma ltar dkon pa'i tshod red/ snyan ngag pa dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog gis/ ngas skabs rer kha rog ye shu'i lha lang nang du 'dzul phyin te bsam blo gzhan pa gang yang ma btang bar kho rang tsho'i lugs kyi dkon mchog de la kho rang tsho'i gzhung nas bshad pa lta bu'i yon tan dran pa'i sgo nas gsol ba rtsegacig tu btab ste bsdad pa na/dus tshod gang 'tshams shig nas mig chu 'chor ba tsam gyi dad pa zhig skye 'ong rgyu 'dug pa ya mtshan zhes gsungs/ nges pa don gyi sgyu rtsal pa zhes pa de ya mtshan che ba'i skyes bu 'di 'dra la zer te/ mi phal pa su zhig yin yang sems khong nas khas len yod ma myong ba'i chos lugs shig la sdug btsir ci 'dra byas kyang glo bur du dad pa zhig skye shes thabs med la de ma skyes na mi mgo skam po las mig chu 'bab thub bab/ yang a me ri ga'i zlos gar 'khrab mkhan grags can we lan —17—
rba tres/ krong khyer chen po ne'u yog tu zlos gar khrod kyi mi ngan zhig gi rnam thar 'khrab ston byed ska bas/ ltad mo pa'i khrod kyi dmag dpon zhig la 'a[brab ston pa khong dngos su mi ngan de yin pa'i 'khrul snang skyes shing / mi des spyod ngan ston rgyu mang drags pas khong khro gnon ma thub par dkrum mda' bton te 'khrab stom pa 'khrab stegs thog de rang du bsad/ mi tshogs 'ur chil ler song ba na da gzod dmag dngo/na kho yang rmongs gnyid las sad nas glen rtags che ba'i rang nyid la khong khro snga ma de las che ba zhig skyes te/ slar yang mde'u gcig gi 'ashes sgo btang nas rang nyid kyang 'khrab ston pa khong dang mnyam du phyir bltas med par bud song / phyis su a ri'i mi mang tshos yod tshad sgyu rtsal gyi klong du gtim phod pa'i skyes bu ngo mtshar can de gnyis kyi sku phung lhan cig tu dur 'jus byas pa'i mdun du/ mi'i rigs kyi rlabs che ba'i sgyu rtsal pa sku mched gnyis zhes brkos pa'i dur byang bslangs yod skad/ des na 'khrab ston pa tshad ldan tshos 'khrab ston byed skabs mgo 'khrab ston nas 'dzin cing mjus 'khrab ston du bsdu ba tsam las/ 'khrab ston gyi dngos gzhi'i skabs su rang nyid 'khrab ston pa zhig gi tshad du lus nas mi 'dug par 'jig rten gzhan dag cig 'grims nas mi tshe gsar pa zhig skyel bzhin yod pa red/ skal bzang me tog la 'o/tshon na dkon la ngo mtshar che ba'i 'khrab ston gyi sgyu rtsal de ma gzhi nas rang chas su tshang 'dug ste/mos 'khrab ston gyi skabs su khral mngon sla bcos dang / gsog gro/sob zog rtsa'i —13 —
rigs ye nas med par rang nyide rang gi 'khrab ston la mtha' gcig tu yid ches dang blo dkar rkyang pa byas yod pas/ nam yang dga' sdug gi sems 'gyu yod tshad lam lam du 'bar zhing lhog lhog tu 'phyur bzhin yod pa 'i tshul nga tshos gsal por mthong thub/ dper na mo'i glu dbyangs dga' rogs yul du 'phur 'gro zhes pa de la ltos shing nyon dang / don du mo rang skabs der sems khong gi zab sar lhung ba'i gzhon nu de'i sar 'gro 'dod kyang 'phur ma thub par lus yod med sus shes kyang / glu dbyangs de'i khrod kyi skal bzang me tog ni sa cha skyid po zhig tu slebs nas dga' yang dga' la skyo yang skyo ba'i dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba rol bzhin pa'i bu mo kher 'gro ma zhig gi lus dngos su blangs 'dug pa las/ de min la de ru brdzus pa'i rjes shul gang yang mo'i lus steng nas mthong rgyu meng de bzhin gtan du dran pa zhes pa'i glu dbyangs de yang don du bu mo rang nying kyi lus sro ga rig gnas dang bcas pa phangs med du bstsal gnang ba'i drin chen a cha/ lags dang gtan bral byung ba'i yi mug skyo glu zhig yin min ni ngas mi shes mod/ gtan du dran pa'i skyo glu de len bzhin pa'i stsa bas su ni/ mig chu lo zi9ra ltar 'thor zhing lus sems yod tshad zhig 'gro ba lta bu'i h+pho gdung si/ 'dam du zug 'dug pa 'di ltar mthong rgyu 'dug la/ byi ba rgya mtsho'i nang du lhung ba ltar ya nga ba'i gnas stangs 'di mthong mkhan gyi ltad mo pa khyod kyang mi sem sa dron mo khog nang du yod pa zhig yin tshe/ sems la smug —14—
i/da khoms n+ya rmetsho dras tu skyom pa'i snyan dbyangs / ———— ————long dang mig la mchi zhas/sa 'khor ba la rang dbang mi 'dug pa'i tshor red/ kha gzhug nas 'dzum mtho gang tsam zhig 'tshor bzhin du sems sdus dpe med cis yod khul gyis brang kha la lag pas snyob tsam snyob tsam byed bzhin pa'i rang re'i 'khrab ston pa rdzun ma de tsho dag lta ci ste/ 'dzam gling shar nub kyi glu mkhan skad grags can tshos kyang dab/'a rogs yul du 'phur 'gro lta bu'i dungs pa'i 9nyams dang / gtan du dran pa lta bu'i skyo ba'i nyams thon pa'i glu dbyangs/ blangs pa nyung nyung red/ gong gi glu dbyangs de gnyis ni dper mtshon tsam yin gyi/ don du mo sa glu dbyangs/ gang 'dra cig blangs kyang glu dbyangs de nyid dang 'tsham sa pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi 'jig rten gsar pa re bdams rjes/ rang nyid kyang stangs ltabs mi 'dra ba re re'i sgo nas 'jig rten der rang dbang gis 'grul bzhud byed kyin 'dug pas mo ni bod pa tshang gi sgyu rtsal gyi bdag mo gcis pu de red r+b+ya slobs pa dang bcas pa'i ngag gis smra thub bo//tshim/ yababaskyar donabagatan nasamin/ da lta'i bod glu len mkhan tsho'i zhan cha che shos shig ni glu dbyangs brgya la dbyangs rta gcig las med pa jidang / 'khrab thengs brgya la 'khrab tshul gcig rang las med pa 'di red/ dga' skyo chags sdang mtshon pa'i glu dbyangs gang la yang nyams dang 'ag ba gcig rang las ston ma shes na 'khrag thengs gnyis pa phan chad la dgos zu pa ci zhis/ yod dam/ snga phyi bsdoms pas brnyan 'khor dang sgra thagasas bdun cu brgyad cu — 15—
nus re bral/ dge ldan pas bem po gzhi med du khas blangs na skur 'debs su 'gro bar dgongs te/ rtsom gzhi'i rdul de cha bcas su yod pa klu yi dgongs pa yin rgyur byas kyang / steng 'og gi ngos so sor dgar rgyu yod pa'i chung ma tha' zhig ga la srid/ tshad rdul smra bas gzugs med nus khyams kyi klong nas bzugs can gyi gsob rdul thon par bshad pa 'dis da gzod bongs tshad kho na'i cha nas dpyad pa gtong ba de nor 'khrul gyi bsam blo yin par ra 'phrod pa red/: kho bos ltos bcas tshan rig dang / tshad rdul nus rig gi sgra tsam thos ma thag gsar zhen g.yam rgyug byas te/ dbu ma'i rigs pa la khyad gsod byas pa zhig gtan nas min/ nga tshos gzhung chen khag tu rnam gzhag gang la yang dgag sgrub spang gsum gyi spros pa gra rgyas po zhe drag mdzad yod kyang / gang mtsham zhig la sleb dus dad pa dag snang 'dra sbyangs te sdod rgyu ma gtogs mtha' 'gro ba zhig rtsab nas byung mi 'dug la/ las ma dag pa'i kho bo la ni dag t+na nga ma skyes pa'i gong nas sun snang zhig skyes par gyur cing / ji ltar byas kyang mi bde bar lus pa'i skabs su rigs gsar gyi rnam gzhag 'di dag srog chad ka ma'i mi la sman bzhin du gnad la 'phrod par byung bas da gzod yid ches pa'i gnas su bzung ba lags so//
mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang sogs mkhas pa kha cig gis/ mdo lung za zur re drangs nas tshad ma rig pa'i khungs sangs rgyas kyi sasung la gtug ci thug ma dzad yod kyang / gsung rab gang du yang tshad ma dang tshad min gyi rnam gzhag ba'i / rtags yang dag dang ltar snang gi rnam dbye gsal por ma gsungs shing / mtshan gzhi tsam ni 'jig rten 'tsho ba'i khrod du'ang yod pas khungs su mi 'gro/ des na rig gzhung 'di thog mar mu stegs rig pa can pa'i khrod du rang rdu thub cing / phyis su sangs rgyas pa'i mkhas pa tshos rang lugs zur du phyes par grags pa nyid don la gnas so snyam/ ngo bo shes pa yul la ji ltar 'jug pa'i tshul gtan la 'bebs pa yin pas/ rig gzhung rang ngos nas bshad na chos dang 'jig rten/ phyi pa dang nang pa sogs kyi dbye ba 'byed rgyu med/ 'on kyang slob dpon phyogs glang gi mdo yi mchod brjod la rnam 'grel mkhan pos tshan pa logs su bzos te rgyas bshad gnang ba de nas bzung / sangs rgyas pa'i lugs kyi tshad ma rig pa'i kha phyogs kyang 'khor 'das gnyis kyi phyogs su bsgyur te don dngos kyi brjod bya blo rtags gnyis ni de'i lag cha tsam du gyur pa red/skabs 'di'i dpyad bya yang tshad ma rig pa dngos de min par tshad ma grub pa'i le'u de'i nang don te chos lugs dang thad par 'brel ba'i gnad don kha cig yin/ de la thog mar dpyad 'os pa ni skye srid kyi sko ra 'di yin te/༷ skye ba snga phyi
gtso phal dang phyi nang gsang ba'i ri ma pa mi 'dra ba du ma'i sgo nas 'dzoms yod/rnyang rje la sgeg pa'i nyams mi 'jug zhi ba la dgod pa 'i nyams mi 'jug ngam pa ni nga rgyal gyi yan 'a/ga yin/ sgeg pa ni 'phyar g.yeng dang ma zhi ba'i rang bzhin can no// zhes bshad pa rnams kyang spyir btang ba'i rnam gzhag tsam las snyan ngag mkhan la ci yang rgyan/ zhes pa'i dpe ltar sgyu rtsal la nang byan chud pa'i kho mo lta bu'i 'khrab ston la ni de ltar ma nges pa'i thog tu phan tshun gzhogs 'degs dang kha gas/ba tu 'gro ba'i thabs yod 'dug la/ khyad par du zhi ba dang sgeg pa'i nyams gnyis ni kho mo'i gar stabs yongs kyi gzhung shing ngam bla srog gi tshul du grub 'dug ngag gi sgyu cal gyi thad nas gleng na/ skad kyi ma rgyu la 'degs 'jog phra sbom/ grim lho da/ 'gyur ldem/ snyan gsang / gcod sbrel rnams ma lhag ma chad ma nor ma 'khrugs pa'i skad spus gtsang zhing skad mdangs gsal ba dang / sgra dbyangs kyi khyad par tshogs su seng ge'i nga ro/ dben par bung ba rnam rol/ mkhas la ne tso'i dbyangs snyan/ rmongs par rma bya 'jo sgeg bstod par lha yi rnga sgra/ chags la 'dod lha'i mda' rnon/ skyo tshe dang ba kun 'dren/ snyan pa dri za'i glu dbyangs/ spel ba me tog phreng ldan sogs gang la ji ltar 'tsham pa de la de bzhin du tshang ba dang / dbyangs rta re re la'ang 'dren pa dpag bsam ljon pa/bkug pa me tog 'khri shing / bsgyur ba rgya mtsho'i zla ba/ stengs pa chu klung dal bgrod bcas bzhi bzhi ming tsam min par ngos gzung rgyu yod/ gdangs dbyangs tsho—18—
gang ltar bkug kyang rna bar snyan zhing yid la bcags/ tshig si/ brjod pa bde zhing gcod mtshams snyo mas/ dbugs kyis gdangs la pham pa mi skyed cing gdangs kyis dbugs la rgyu lam phye ba'i yon tan 'dzoms pas// slob dpon snga ma dag gis/ ring yang mgo lus 'tsham pa/ thung yang yan lag rdzogs pa/ brjid kyang sgeg chags pa/ snyan yang rus ma shor ba/ gyong yang skabs su khugs pa/ dig kyang tshig gi go gsal ba/ mgrin pa/mang yang skad gcig pa/ skad gcis kyang nga ro du mas brgyan pa/ blun po'i yid 'dzin cing mkhas pa'i thugs dgyes pa zhig dgos/ zhes bshad pa'i khyad par gyi chos de dag las skal bzang me tog gi skad dang dbyangs la 'di ma tshang zer ba gci ga rkyang bgrang rgyu mi rnyed/ dig kyang tshig 'bru gsal ba'i dbyangs rta de kho mo 'i ngag gi yon tan gyi nang nas gzengs su thon shos yin pa mdzes pa'i gces ma deng / mun phre nga'i mdum/ lam gang du 'dug bcas gsum dang / brnyan 'khor gzhan pa'i nang du yod pa'i sa skyid po kong po'i lung pa dang / skyed pa'i glo mi zhes pa rnams la ma ngon gsal dod por yod/ deng skabos dbyangs rta 'di la dang dod byed mkhan mang yang dig skabs tshig 'bru brlag 'gro ba dang / tshig 'bru 'dzin skabs dig rgyu brjed nas 'gro ba ma gtogs kha gcig gis nya gnyis zin mkhan mi 'dug 'thig stangs 'dis skad mgo ci tsam mtho na skad bzang de tsam yin par rlom pa'i rang re'i dmangs khrod kyi glu pa glu ma de tshor ngo tsha khur na mi theg pa re rin med du byin — 19—
pa red/ a rir bzhugs yod pa'i bod kyi glu pa grags can phur bu bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal lags kyis/ rang re bod kyi glu la 'dzam gling thog gi glu dbyangs gzhan dag dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos de 'gyur khug gnyis kyi nang nas 'gyur gyi thog tu yod/ 'das po don grub rgyal gyis tshig brtsams shing glu ma zla sgrol lags kyis len myong ba'i glu dbyangs mtsho sngon po lta bu la nyan na khyad chos de gsal por mthong rgyu yod/ bod kyi glu dbyangs la dga' ba'i nub phyogs pa tshos kyang gtso bo 'di'i thad nas do snang gnang gi 'dug ces bshad song / 'on kyang da lta a mdo'i bdung len de tsho la bro ba 'di cher mthong rgyu mi 'dug cing / dbus gtsang pa tshos ni nam yang rgya gzhas la lad blos byas drags pas khyad chos de rtsaba nas brlags tshar/ grags can glu pa g.ya' dwangs lags kyi glu la'ang rdzob de bsdad med skad/ khams khul gyi dmangs khrod glu dbyangs rnams la nyan na da gzod mar dang rtsam pa'i dri ma zhim po de 'thul 'ong / lhag par du kong po dang rgyal rong phyogs kyi glu dbyangs de tshor 'gyur gyi yon tan de gsal po red/ ma gzhi bod gangs can pa'i glu dbyangs kyi me tog de rgyal rong gi phyogs su babs yod pa 'dra ste/ sngon chad rgya nag gong ma chen po'i pho brang nang ma'i glu dbyangs pa phal cher kyang rgyal rong pa yin tshod 'dug la/ da lta kho tshos so so'i pha skad ma yig ha lam rtsad nas brlags zin kyang glu dbyangs kyi khyad chos de sngar bzhin nyar tshags thub 'dug pa ngo natshar che/ sham la'i bu mo gsum sogs kyis 'khrab —20—
pa'i rgyal rong rma bya'i skor bro lta bu la nyan na skad brda mi 'phrod kyang snyan 'jebs ni rna ba'i bu ram red/ skal bzang me tog gi glu dbyangs rgya skad yod skad gang gis blangs kyang 'gyur gyi yon tan de snyan lhang lhang du thon 'ortsagang/sa kho mo'i skyes yul yang mdo khams gnyis kyi mtshams su chags pa'i rgyal rong ge nye sa zhig nas e yin snyam/ lar bod phye nang gnyis kyi glu dbyangs kyi gdangs rtsab nas mi 'dra bas bod glu'i khrod du rgya gdangs kyis btsan 'dzul byas — tshabs che ba ni ha las dgos pa zhig red 'dug ces pa'ang zhar la thal ba'i gtam 31/1 glu ma skal bzang me tog gi lus kyi gar stabs la lta skabs dbyangs dang tshig 'bru sogs gcig kyang thos mi thub cing / skad dang dbyangs rta la mnyam par 'jog tshe cha lugs dang gar stabs la blta rgyu rtsab nas brjed 'gro/ tha na mo'i 'od gor 'khyil ba'i mig zung gi g.yo 'gul la sems pa gtad de bsdad na/ de rang las gzhan yan lag nying lag gi 'gul skyod gang yang mig gis 'dzin mi shes pa'i gnas stangs khyad mtshar zhig 'dug ste sgyu rtsal phun tshogs kyi 'gugs thugs ni ting 'dzin gyi zhags pa ltar rmyo la skyen par snang / mos glu dbyangs mi 'dra ba re re len skabs phyi cha lugs nas nang yid 'gyur gyi bar du yod tshad gsar pa gsar rkyang re re ston 'ong bas/ skabs cider glu ma skal bzang me tog kyang mthong myong myong gi snang ba tsam las ngo shes dka' ba'i glu ma gsar —21—
6khu re rer 'gyur 'gro bzhin 'dug 'on kyang nam yang 'gyur rgyu med pa m+pi kho mo'i zhi 'jam lhod chags kyi gshis rgyud dang / mnyes gshin 'char yan gyi ngang tshul/ byams brtselhang nye'i mig mdangs bcas yin no//bzhi 'gayo'adulartsegaphyagaphulag 'dzam gling shar nub kyi rig gzhung phal che ba la mi 'dra ba'i bar khyad chen po re yod pa de bzhin du rig rtsal 'khrab ston gyi rigs la yang khyad par de ga rang 'dug ste/ phyi lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur khyad par ba zhig la brten nas nang gi sems don mtshon pa'am/ phyi yi nyams 'gyur la brten nas nang gi myong rtog gi tshad ji mthor gtong ba rang re'i srol rgyun nam shar phyogs pa'i sgyu rtsal dang / nang gi yid 'gyur gyi 'gros dang mthun pa'i lus ngag gi nyams 'gyur ston pa'am/ snying dbus nas drag tu 'phyur ba'i tshor 'du'i mgo ma non par lus ngag gi rang gzugs su 'phos pa ni deng rabs dang nub lugs kyi khyad chos yin/ mdor na shar phyogs pa'i sgyu rtsal de phyi rim nas nang rim la phar smin dgos pa yin la/ nub lugs kyi sgyu rtsal de nang logs nas phyi la tshur mched cing bzhur yong ba zhig yin/ de yang gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa ma gtogs nub lugs yod tshad deng rabs dang /shar lugs yod tshad la srol rgyun gyis khyab pa ni ga la yod/ gsar dar rang mos snyan ngag dang / rang dbang zhabs bro zhes pa de yang smyu gu dang rkang lag g.yug pa la mtshams tshod med par rang snang gang shar gyi don min/ snyan ngag gi —22—
tshig sbyor dang zhabs bro'i stangs stabs de yid 'gyur gyi 'gros dang mthun zhing tshor 'du'i ram 'degs su song na des chog pa las/ tshig sbyor gyi snyan pa de tshig sbyor rang steng dang / stangs stabs kyi mdzes pa de stangs stabs rang steng na rang dbang gis bsgrig mi rung zhing btsal du yang med ces pa'i don red/ spyi ldog nas bshad na de gnyis kyi nang nas deng rabs kyi sgyu rtsal de tshad mtho ba smos ma dgos mod/ mi rigs so so'i mdzes dpyod lta tshul mi 'dra ba dang / mi so so'i blo sbyong gi tshad gzhi mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis srol rgyun gyi khyad chos de'ang 'dor yag byed du mi rung ba zhig yin/ nga tsho'i snyan ngag gsar pa 'bri mkhan tshos srol rgyun gyi snyan ngag ni tshig skam gyi tshal rtsed rkyang pa ma gtogs des nang gi snying dmar dmar po de nam yang ston myong med ces dang / srol zhen pa tshos snyan ngag gsar pa ni skyon pa'i kha nas thon pa'i bla brdol ba'i gtam yin pas nyan na rna ba tsha ba 'ba' zhig de'i snying po yin zhes phan tshun rtsod cing yod la/mgo bde kha cig gis gsar rnying gnyis ka snyigs dor bcud len byed dgos zhes bar pa byed pa'i khul la/ snyigs dor bcud len bya tshul 'di ltar yin zhes pa'i mig dpe zhig ni kho tshos kyang ston thub kyin med/ gsar rnying bar gyi 'gal ba de zhabs bro la'ang 'phrad yod de/ 'khrab srol rnying pa mthong skabs gzhon nu tsho sgyid lug cing / 'khrab stangs gsar pa rig dus rgan pa tsho blo mi bde bar rang rang gi sa nas sdang sdug gi ma ṇi bgrang bzhin bsdad yod/ ngas bltas na glu — 23—
ma skal bzang me tog gis gnad don de thag rtsab nas bcad 'dug ste/ mo'i 'khrab ston kun la sgyu rtsal gsar rnying gnyis po dgra gshed du ma song bar phyogs gnyis ku'i legs cha nying bsdus kyis lus zungs su smin pa'i 'bras rtags la/ lta stangs/ 'dzum stangs/ 'gul stangs/ g.yug stangs/ gyer stangs/'gugs stangs/ gyon stangs/ 'dogs stangs tshun chad gang la yang 'di'i thad nas 'dzam gling dang dus rabs kyi rjes ma chod pa'i rdzab cig bstan 'dug snyam pa de 'dra gcig kyang bgrang rgyu mi 'dug la/ gsar dar rgya dkar nag ser gsum gyi zhabs bro kha shas ni mgo bo drag tu g.yug ches pas khrag klad pa'i nang du shor mi 'gro'am snyam pa'i sems 'tshab skye 'ong ba dang / gzhas tshig la snyan ngag gi nyams mi dgos skad cha'i bro ba tsam yang med pa'i 'chal gtam sha stag dang / de nyid kha nas gyer skabs zang zing khrod kyi skad cor lta bu las 'gugs dang dbyangs kyi rnam gzhag bya sa med pa dang / gyon pa nu shubs lheb tsam zhig dang 'doms dkris sor gang kho na las gzhan gang yang med pa'i dmar hreng ma la/ lag zung gis 'doms dang nu 'bur/ 'phongs tshos/ brla sha bcas la 'phur 'phur dang sbar nyul kho na brgyab ste/ ched du 'khrig sred slong ba lta bu'i chags nyams dmar rjen du ston ches pas 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal ma gtogs 'khrab ston gyi sgyu rtsal du 'bod dka' la/ tha na'ang ngo tsha dang 'dzem zol bya rgyu mang ba'i rang re bod pa tsho'i mig dang rna ba la ye nas mi 'tsham pa de 'dra mang ha/ rang re'i —24—
'khrab ston pa kha cig gis kyang sngon thon yin khul gyis de tsho'i lad mo ci thub byed kyin yod/ skal bzang me tog gis ni g.yam rgyus de rigs nam yang byas med par bab chags gcom skyung gi rang tshugs sngar bzhin bzung nas bsdad 'dug de'i rgyu mtshan yang ci tsam deng rabs can yin na de tsam sngon thon yin pas khyab kyang / ci tsam nub lugs can yin na de tsam sngon thom yin pas ma khyab/ bod pa'i deng rabs kyi sgyu rtsalade'ang bod pa rang gi deng rabs can gyi smyu rtsal zhig yin dgos pa las/ nub phyogs kyi deng rabs can gyi sgyu rtsal de khyer 'ong nas bod pa'i mgo thog tu slo 'dzugs byed dgos pa'i nges pa med pa 'di mos nam yang 'khrab ston gyi dam tshig gi tshul du ba6srung byed kyin yod pas red/ de bas mo'i 'khrab ston khrag la grong dang grong khyer gyi rgan dar gzhon gsum su zhig gis bltas kyang rang rang lugs kyi mdzes dpyod kyi lta ba las phar ma brgal bas lta bde la nyan spro zhing kun yid 'dzin pa'i khyad chos 'dzoms song bar snang /mdzes pa'i gces ma dang / mun bsnye gangs ljongs zhabs bro sogs gar gyi stangs stabs rtsal du bton pa'i rigs gcig dang / a sang sang dang / nga'i pha yul/ rgyal rong brtsegazhas sogs dbyangs kyi 'gyur khug rtsal/ du bton pa'i rigs gcig gtan du dran pa dang / gnam bskos gnyen sgrig nga'i mdun lam gang du 'dug sogs nang gi yid 'gyur rtsal du gton pa'i rigs gcig bu — 25—
nag po dang / dga' rogs yul du 'phur 'gro/ yag 'gul shog sogs sgo gsum cha mnyam pa'i nyams 'gyur phul du phyin pa'i rigs gcig bcas 'dug pa de dag snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma rnams sgyu rtsal gyi tshad je mtho dang / gting je zab/ rgya je cher song 'dug pa 'dis gcig nas kho mo'i 'khrab ston gyi sgyu rtsal de 'bag sku la gser chu byug pa ltar phyi nas phar bskus pa tsam min par/ me ri'i 'bar gad ltar nang logs su khong snying 'dzoms po zhig yod pa'i rtags mtshan bstan pa yin la/ gnyis nas 'khrab ston rmakhan pos 'khrab ston byed skabs mi dga' dag(ra mdog dang / mi sdug sdug mdog bstan pa tsam gyis mi chog par sems khong na dga' ba rnal ma dang skyo ba ngo ma zhig yod dgos la/ de'ang nang gi tshor pa tshad mthon por slebs te bsran ma tshugs par glu dbyangs kyi rnam pas kha nas 'phyur ba dang / skad brgyab pa tsam gyis da dung mi tshim pa'i snang ba byung tshe gzhi nas yan lag dang nying lag gi 'gul skyod kyang rang shugs kyis thon 'ong ba bcas nang nas phyi la mched pa'i rigs de tshad mtho shos kyi sgyu rtsal yin pa'i gsal bshad byas yod/ rgyal rong brtse gzhas dang bu nag po sogs spro gar khag la lus ngag 'khrug cha ha cang dod kyang / gtan du dran pa dang nga'i mdum lam gang du 'dug sogs skyo gar rnams la phyag rgya dang gar stabs nyung zhing skad la ched du dang dod byas med pa dang / gos rgyan yang dkyus ma kho nar byas 'dug pa 'di dag lhad med pa'i 'tsho ba'i nyams myong dngos ma sha stag —26—
yid khogs n+ya mtsho dra4 tu skyom pa'i snyan dbyangs/ yin te/ sems pa skyid po yod dus lus ngag gi nyams dang bzo lta 0〈 dang dod byed pa yin gyi skyo sdug gi gnas skabs su de ltar mi byed pa'i phyir ro// rang re'i glu pa glu ma mang shos shig la ni sdug glu len skabs kyang gzab spros/ mitra/ caphyid 'gro ba zhig gyon rgyu med na thabs med yin 'dug pa/ mya ngan gyi nyin mor ched du gzab 'tshor spros nas 'gro mkhan khong rnam tsho ma gtogs gzhan 'jig rten 'dir su zhig yod/ glu zhig len na lag pa zhig g.yug dgos pa'i khyab pa me da pa 'di'ang shes dgos par 'dug ste/ sdug gtam shod pa dang ngu ba'i skabs su phyag rgya dang gar stabs byed mkhan phal cher mthong rgyu med na skyo gar yang de dag dang rigs mtshungs pas stangs stabs nges par du bgos don ci yod/ lag pa g.yug dgos nga/'i gal 'gag ci yang thug ma byung na mgagayug na tshog pa yin gyi g.yug dgos zhes sus kyang bka' phab med/ cis kyang g.yug 'dod na sem sa don mtshon pa'i g.yug stangs de 'dra ma shes na'ang ma mtha' 'khrab ston pa'i lus la tshang dgos pa'i 'khril la ldem pa'i g.yug nyams shig e thon blta dgos pa las/ gling chen a h+phe ri lnga'i rang byung srog chags ra ba'i nang du nam rgyun mthong rgyu yod pa'i chu srin gdug pa can de tsho'i khra lag 'gul skyong byed stangs dang 'dra ba de rigs ni g.yug pa po ngo ma tsha na'ang lta ba po ngo tsha 'ong bar 'dug go/skal bzang me tog gi gyon pa nub lugs su byas pa'i skabs su ni bcu —27—
zung na tshod rdzogs pa'i gzhon nu ma zhig gi lang che' 'jo sgeg dang / deng rabs bu mo'i rang gshis te glod grol gyi mdzes nyams shas che ba dang / rang srol gyi gos rgyan spras nas yong skabs brtse ba mig nang du 'khyil zhing dung ba 'dzum kong du sba sa nas ngo tsha kha skyengs kyi nyams 'gyur ci yang ston pas mthang 'byog mo'i mdzes sdug lhang nger mngon yong / nga'i mdun lam gang du 'dug ces pa'i glu chung de len skabs sems pa sdug gin sdug gin/ skyo glu len gyin len gyin skabs skabs su kha rtsed lag rtsed 'dra'ang phran bu rtsebazhin 'dug pa lhad med byis pa'i gshis spyod ni 'di ga rang ste/ dgod sla la ngu yang skyen pa'i byis chung gi 'tsho ba de nga tsho sus kyang rol yod mod/ da lta der dngos su rdzog bzhur byed shes pa ni kho mo tsam du zad/ pha yul dang pha ma dran pa'i dran gdung che shos de gnyom lag ma rgyas pa'i phru gu tsho'i rgyud la yod pa 'di la dmigs nas mos skabs der ched du rang gi na tshod las kyang phra ba'i bu mo chung chung zhig gi bzo lta bstan 'dug la/ bzo lta ci zhig ston 'dod na de ltar du thon thub pa ni mo'i khyad gshis yin/ sgyu rtsal sgyu rtsal zer ba de'ang don du 'di rang red/ nga'i mdun lam gang du 'dug ces pa 'di chung sa nas bshad na ri grong du 'tshar longs byung ba'i na chung bu mo zhig glo bur du mi tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbus kyi grong khyer du slobs pa'i bu mo mo rang gi myong tshor yin srid la/ che sa nas bshad na 'dzam/ gling gi gling sne gsum par 'bod pa'i shar mtha'i mtho sgang gi ri khug na —28
dben 'jags kyis 'tsho ba skyel bzhin pa'i gdong dmar ba tsho/ gra sgrig dang gdeng tshod gang yang med par da char 'dzam gling chen po'i 'khor skyod kyi khrod du lhung nas ci bya gtol dang bral ba'i sems khams dang 'tsho ba mtshon bzhin yod/ yang na pha yul dang rgyal khab med pa'i mi ldom khyu zhig rang sa na rang dbang gis 'tsho ba rol bzhin pa'i nub phyogs yul gru khag tu 'khyams pa'i zin tho yin yang chog deng sang gi dpyad brjod pa tsho'i lugs su byas na mo'i glu gzhas khag la yang 'di lta bu'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mtshon don sna tshogs yod pa'i gdeng 'jog byed chog tshod 'dug mod tshod gtam la rna ba gtod mkhan rnyed dka' bas re zhig gleng bar mi bya yang / dga' ba'i dus su 'bar thub cing skyo ba'i dus su zhu thub pa/ su dang 'grogs kyang de dang mthun zhing gang du bzhag kyang de nas bud yong ba/ glog bzhu khra chem dang / du smug lang long gi ram 'degs med kyang snang sems drag tu skyom thub pa/ chags dang sred pa'i nyams 'gyur ched du ma bstan kyang rang bzhin gshis kyi mdzes pas tshogs drug bzi 'thom du gtong ba/ 'khrab mkhan zur du med par rang len rang 'khrab gcig pu la yang 'khrug cha ci bas dod pa/ 'khrab thengs gcig rang la glu dbyangs 'khrab ston lugs su byas te mnyan rgyu dang glog brnyan 'khrab ston lugs su byas te blta rgyu gnyis ka yod pa rnams ni tshod 'jog tsam min par ston rgyu rig rgyu yod pa'i mo'i rig rtsal 'khrab ston khag gi khyad chos yin la/— 29 —
gal te bod gangs can 'di glu dbyangs kyi rgya mtsho yin pa bden na/ glu ma ska la bzang me tog ni rgya mtsho de'i dbus gling du 'khrungs shing mdzes rtsal gyi yal 'dab bzhad pa'i me tog gi tshom zhig dang gnyis su ma mchis so/ / lnga/ g.yang ce'i sgang giyasasgron/ gnas yul gyi bu mo zhes pa'i skal bzang me tog gi ched bsgrigs brnyan 'khor 'di la mtshon na/ 'di ltar legs 'grub yong ba'i rgyu cha gtso bo glu ma rang steng gi khyad chos sngar bshad nga/ de dag las gzhan glu tshig dang 'char 'god kyi thad nas kyang nus pa che tsam thon yod de/ mdzes pa'i gces ma zhes pa'i glu tshig las/ pho nga la khyod yi ya/ brtse ba gnam las mtho zhing / sems pa gting gi brtse ba/ bu mo khyod la phul yod/ ces dang / a tsi a tsi bu mo khyad mtshar la/ dkar bo gas yis ma zin lus yag ston mkhas/ zhes kha skad gtso bor byas pa'i tshig sbyor kha gsal zhing gnad la phig pa'i thog gzhon pa'i sems kham/sa kyi khyad chos te pra chal bsta na bzhig gi zhad cig kyang zhar la thon yod stabs len mkhan dang nyan mkhan gnyis par spro snang rang thugs kyis 'dren yong / nga'i mdun lam gang du 'dug ces pa'i glu tshig der/ nga 'khyam po mi yul sa mthar 'grims song / sa mtha' la 'grims song /mtho zhing brjid pa'i khang brtsegs mang la/ rang khyim mi 'dug nga khur po rgyab la khur nas/ gar 'gro cha med red/ lha bla ma dkon mchog gsum po/ nga'i mdun lam gang du 'dug grong khyer gyi mtshan mor slebs dus/ nga'i pha yul dran/ glog — 30—
sgron 'og la mi tshogs ma nga / nga'i pha ma dran/ zhes sdeb sbyor lebs thing brtse dung gis phyug la gtan tshigs dang 'brel ba'i thog snang brnyan bzhengs skrun byas pa gsal po yin pas glu dbyangs kyi rgyab ljongs dang nang gi sems khams hril po glog brnyan bstan pa ltar mig lam du 'char 'ong la/ glu tshig de klog pa dang nyan pa tsam gyis yid sems 'char snang gi zhing du dbang med du 'dren 'gro bar 'dug dga' rogs yul du 'phur 'gro zhes pa'i glu tshig der thog mar/dbyar kha spang la skyed byung / spang la me tog 'khrungs byung / nga rang sems pa skyid byung / sems kyi dga' rogs yid la 'khor byung / zhes yul dus khor yus gang 'dra zhig gi 'og tu dga' rogs mkho zhing dran 'ong ba'i gnas lugs de rtsom rig gi gtan tshigs bed spyad de gsal por bris yod/ spyir mi tshe gcig gi gtan grogs yin na dga' ba'i gnas skabs las skyo gdung dang dka' sdug gi gnas skabs sunamakho gal dang phan thogs che ba zhig yin srid mod/ 'jig rten 'dir snang gi brtse dung gi sa bon de ni bde skyed dang dgod sgra'i khrod nas ma gtogs yi mug dang mig chu'i klong nas 'debs srol med stabs ming la yang sdug rogs mi zer bar dga' rogs zhes btags pa red/ skyo gdung dang dka' khrag la thug skabs thog mar dran 'ong ba ni drin chen pha ma'i byams skyong dang /bde skyid bag phebs kyi nyin mor gzhi nas gsar bsgrigs kyi grogs la brtse 'dang gtod pa 'di byis pa dang gzhon nu tsho'i sems khams kyi khyad chos red/—31—
des na dga' rogs dran pa'i skabs su dran mkhan gyi ngo la sdug 'dom pa gang lug dgos pa'i khyab pa'ang med pa yin/ de'i rjes su/ la dang lung pa brje dgos byung yang / dga' rogs yul du 'gro bsam/ zhes snying thub grogs kyi ched du 'grub srid pa'i bya bzhag cis/ yin tshe ci yang bsgrub phod pa'i dus rabs gsar pa'i na gzhon tsho la yod 'os shing yod kyang nges pa'i brtse dung gi snying stobs de gsal bsgrags byas nas/ nam mkha'i dgung la skyod pa'i/ khu byug yin na bsam byung / dga' rogs gar song yul du/ 'phur rgyu yod na bsam byung / zhes pas slar yang 'grub mi srid pa'i 'char yan khrod kyi stong 'dang ring mo zhig tshur la drangs te/ sems song gang gi drung du da lta nyid nas slebs na ci ma rung snyam pa'i dran gdung rnal ma'i zab tshad de brjod yod pas/ dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod du zas bcag gnyid brjed kyis sgug yod pa ni smos ma dgos/ tshig rkang pa bzhi mo 'di'i nang gi nam mkha'i dgung / khu byug 'phur/ skyod ces pa'i tha snyad de tsho re res kyang skabs de'i sems khams la rang rang sa nas ma bcol ba'i phan pa 'ga' zhig sgrub kyin yod/ tshig rkang 'di dag gi brjod bya rdzod byed dpe dang gtan tshigs yod tshad 'di ltar gson thugs rgyas shing sems la zug pa zhig yin pa'i rkyen gyis/ rdzi gsang rno la tshor snang skyen pa'i glu ma 'dis kyang tshig de dag kha la len skabs ldem ldem 'khyug 'khyug 'phur ma mtshang la 'phar ma lding gi stangs stabs lta ba mig gis mi bzod pa de dang / 'bar ba yin la —32—
'khrol ba'ang yin pa'i skad gdangs khyad mtshar de 'dra'ang rang thugs kyis shor song ba 'dra/ slar yang / la dang lung pa brje dgos byung yang / dga' rogs yul du 'gro bsam/ zhes dang / 'phur 'gro ya/ 'phur 'gro ya/ dga' rogs yul du 'phur 'gro ya/ zhes bris 'dug pa ni gom stabs myur yang slebs mi thub pa dang / gshog pa med pas 'phur mi thub pa'i gnas lugs ni ngos zin tshar yang a 'thas che bas sngar gyi stong 'dang de'i rnga ma la u tshugs kyis 'tham pa tsam ste/ rmi lam skyed po zhig las sad ma thag rmi lam yin pa shes kyang yang bskyar cung zad gnyid pa'i re ba byed pa dang phyogs mtshungs/ nga'i mdun lam gang du 'dug ces pa dang / dga' rogs yul du 'phur 'gro/ zhes pa'i glu tshig 'di gnyis su zhig gis bris pa yin nam/ bod rigs rtsom pa po'i khrod du ni 'di 'dra'i glu tshig 'bri thub mkhan sgyu rtsal pa sman bla skyabs ma gtogs gzhan da sngon kho bos mthong thos byung myong med do// 'khrab ston pa zhig la glu tshig yod tshad rang kho nas rtsom 'bri byed dgos pa'i re ba bton na cung zad 'os 'tsham min yang / glu tshig gi nang don dang rtsom rig gi sgyu rtsal bcas la ni do snang cung zad cig cis kyang byed shes dgos kyi/ rang gi phugs bsam dang 'tsham min dang / brjod pa 'dra 'brel yod med gang la yang mi lta bar khyi phyogs dang slo stong nang bzhin bya mi rung ste/ tshig skyon dang don skyon yod pa'i glu tshig re res glu dbyangs re re'i bla srog 'phral du len nges par ma zad/ tshabs che na glu pa —33—
rang gi gdong la 'byar ba'i sna de'ang rtsabazhar byas nas mi tsho gcig gi ring la mi sngun na 'gro srol med pa bzo srid do// grags can glu ma zla sgrol lags su nye char a ri'i gsar 'god pas/ bar skabs shig ring khyed kyi glu ska da gcig kyang go rgyu mi 'dug pa khyed la ci byung song zhes bcar 'dri zhus pa'i lan du mos/ nga la gzhan ci yang byung ma song mod glu tshig yag po de 'dra rtsab nas rag gi mi 'dug glu tshig rang sems la 'gro ba zhig ma byung phyin de la gdangs rtsom pa'i sems shugs dang kha la len 'dod kyi spro snang rtsab nas slebs rgyu med pa ni nga'i gshis ka yin zhes gsung song ba lta bu ste de 'dra'i 'gan khur zhig cis kyang yod dgos/ da lta nga tsho'i gsar rtsom glu tshig khrag kyang de 'dra'i yid tshims pa zhig ma red/ 'ga' zhig snyan ngag gi rtsom ltar sgam brling che drags pa/ la la rtog ge'i gzhung ltar gtan tshigs nag 'gros su bkod pa/ kha cig chos pa'i gdams pa ltar bslab bya gyu ru lugs su bris pa/ gzhan dag chab srid kyi 'bod sgra ltar la rgya'i kha g.yang rkyang bsgrags pa sogs 'dug de dag mi legs te/mkhas dbang 'ju skal bzang gis/ gdams ngag ston la bla ma'i gong na med//bslab bya gnang la pha ma'i yan na med// snying gtam 'chad la grogs las lhag pa med// snyan ngag mkhan po da dung gzhan nas 'tshol// zhes gsungs pa bzhin glu tshig la glu tshig rang gi khyad chos shig yod dgos kyi bslab bya dang snying gtam tsam gyis ga la chog yang glu tshig mang che shos ni gdod ma'i lugs ltar rkang pa —34—
do mnyam gyi sgrog las thar thub kyin med pas dus rabs dang mi 'tshams/ 'ga' zhig gsar pa'i phyosas su bskyod khul byas kyang gzhan rtsom la lad mo byas drags pas mi rigs rtsom yig gi bro ba bsdad med/ lhag tu a mdo'i rtsom pa po tshos gzab gzab ma byas na mi yong bar 'dug ngas 'di lta ra bshad don khyed tsho la re ba phran bu mthong bzhin yod pas yin/ nged tsho khams phyogs la cha bzhag na dmangs khrod kyi glu tshig re gnyis bsdu sgri ga byed skabs kyang yi ge'i thob thang go brda 'phrod pa zhig 'bri mkhan ha lam med pas nang don dang sgyu rtsal sogs ni gleng thabs bral/ gnas yul gyi bu mo'i nang gi glu tshig phal cher la brjod bya 'dems sta ngas/ tshig sbyor dam lhod/ rkang pa gcod mtshams/ yig ska da dang kha skad gang la yang phyogs lhung ris chad med pa'i legs cha che tsam 'dug pa 'dis brnyan 'khor gnas yul gyi bu mo bskrun pa'i rmang gzhi sra brtan btsugs yod 'duggnyis pa 'char 'god byed stangs la glu dbyangs kha cig rgya skad bod skad shan sbyar gyis blangs 'dug pa 'dis mdzes pa bla lhag cig bsnan yod de/gcig nas glu ma rang nyid rgya rgyug bod rgyug gi byang tshad de dus gcig tu rang shugs kyis phyi la thon yod pas mi sems 'gugs shugs che ru song ba dang /gnyis nas nyan mkhan bod rgya su zhig yin kyang skad yig gi bkag rgya med pas bag phebs te rang sa nas rol chog gsum nas bod rgya'i bar gyi glu gar sgyu rtsal — 35 —
na snal ma dang / t+na /la ma bshig na spu nyag dang / spu nyag bzhig na thal rdul dang /thal rdul de dag kyang tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas bshib] na mthar gzhi med du ('gyur/de yi tshe na thams cad gar song cha med nam mkha' la sprin dwangs pa ltar 'gyur/zhes dang / bem po'i sdod lugs la gnas skabs gsum yod pa las/ gsum pa'i(skabs su rdul gyi rang bzhin cung zad kyang med par rdul phran 'byung rung tsam dang / 'byung rung de'ang cad bcad na sems kyi bag chags la thug pas bag chags zad na gtan med du 'gyur/ zhes stabs bde mdog kha po zhig gsungs 'dug kyang / thugs rtsegatad sa yag po zhig yod med blo dogs che ste/ gzhi med du ma gyur tsam gyi rdul tha ma de gzugs kyi chung mtha' yin na de la snam bu bshig pa'i tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas ji ltar gshig rgyu yod/ chung mtha' min na de nyid snam bu bzhig pa'i tshul de ltar bzhig kyang gzhi med du ci la 'gro/ de bas chung ba'i gzugs shig yod dgos pas ma mtha' yang dum bu gnyis su bzhig bzod los dgos/ 'dis khyed tsam du ma zad gcig du bral gyi dbu ma'i rigs pa de'i dbu la yang thog phab pa yin/ che chung kho na'i cha nas cha shas yod med jibrtag dpyad gtonge ba de 'khrul yod zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yang 'di yin/ rdul phran gyi rtsab 'byung rung dang / 'gyung rung gi rtsab bag chags dang / bag chags kyi rtsab sems nyid la thug pa bden na/ sems gtso smra ba'i grub mtha' de ma 36—
dpyad na rang byung tshan rig gi zhib 'jug bya yul rtsis dngos rdzas gsum 4/nga la yang sangs rgyas chos gzhung khrod du mi rnams ha las 'ong ba dang / nyon 'thor dgos pa dang / ya mtshan 'os pa dang / yid 'phrog 'gro ba'i legs bshad ci yang mthong rgyu mi 'dug yod/ med bzhin yod mdog sto na pa la dgos pa gzhan zhig yod pa yin na ni/ da res kho bos rdzun rkub gtol nyes shor song bas dgongs dag zhu'o// chos gzhung gi sems dang sems byung gi rnam gzhag dag la ni/ lha sgang dang rtog bzo cher ma 'dres shing tshod dpag dang rigs skam tsam yang min par dus rabs rim byon gyi rnal 'byor pa tshos/ kha nang du phyogs nas tshod lta gnang ba'i nyams myong dngos ma shas che bas/ phyis kyi sems khams rig pa'i gzhung lugs dag la yang ngo gnongs mi dgos pa zhig yod/ 'on kyang de la mngon gsal dod pa'i zhan cha gcig rang mthong rgyu yod pa ni/ rnam gzhag mang po zhig ngo po'igag nas min par dge sdig gi cha nas byas 'dug pa 'di red/'dzin stangs dang rigs rgyun gcig nyid la/ shes rab dang 'chal ba'i shes rab/brtson 'grus dang le lo/ dad pa dang log lta/ byams brtse dang zhen chags/ nges 'gyung dang zhe sdang sogs kyi dbye ba phyes yod pa lta bu red/ rnam gzhag de dag dge sgrub sdig spang gi nyams len gnang mkhon tsho la rin thang che ba tsam ma gtogs/ sems khams chos nyid la zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la ni de tsam phan mi thogs/ gang ltar tshan rig pa ni sems khams zhib 'jug la gom pa slo ma 37—
thag pa lta bu dang / sangs rgyas chos rig ni sems khams zhib 'jug gi gzhung lugs dang / chos lus/sa nyams bzhes ni sems nyid 'dul sbyong gi rnal 'byor sha stag yin pas de'i cha nas sangs rgyas chos gzhung la legs bshad dang / slob sbyong byed dgos sa gang 'tsham re yod par smra na de ni 'gro ba sems can tsho'i rna la 'gro ba'i gtam yin no// de yan chad kyis sangs rgyas chos gzhung nas bshad pa'i gzhi kun rdzob snang ba'i rnam gzhag la dpyad zin cing / dpyad pa'i tshul yang rgyal ba'i dbang po'i bka' gsung las/ sangs rgyas chos lugs la dbye na/ sa ngas rgyas chos kyi tshan rig dang / tra/ngas rgyas chos kyi lta grub/ sangs rgyas chos kyi nyams len bcas sde tshan gsu ma du dbyer yod/ ces phebs pa ltar na gong bshad de deg ni sde tshan dang po ste/ chos rig dang tshan rig gnyis ku'i thun mong gi zhib 'jug bya yul du 'jog dgos par 'dug pas nub dar mtshan nyid rig pa dang / phyis dar tshan rig gi rig tshan so so'i zhib 'jug gi bsdoms tshig sna tshogs dang 'grig min gyi cha nas gtso bor dpyad yod/ de yang deng sang bod nang du chos rig dang tshan rig gnyis ka la spyan ma longs tsam a+thi+-i mkhas pa ni/ khams bla rung mkhan chen tshul khrims blo gros mchog dang / a mdo rme ba sprul sku bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ dbus 'bri gung mkhas dbang dkon mchog rgya mtsho gsum las gzhan su yang mjal rgyu mi 'dug cing / mchog sprul bstan rgyam lags kyi gsung rtsom nye char lag son ma byung bas/ mkhas dbang gzhan rnam — 38—
mthun pa'i re ba nam yang ston mi rung ba sogs shes pa'i ched du bris pa lags/des na sa steng gi mi yod tshad kyis bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang / bdag gzhan brje ba dang / bdag bas gzhan gces sogs tshul bzhin nyams su len thub na yag po yong shas che yang / mi 'di tsho'i kha ngo dang bzo lta la bltas na sku nyid kyi thugs re de rmi lam dang sgyu ma la rlom sems byas pa tsam du zad cing / rmi lam phyi nang nas kyang rmi rgod dang / sgyu ma'i nang nas kyang sgyu lhod la rlom sems byas pa red snyam/'jig rten pas 'dzam gling zhi bde dang / 'gro ba mi'i thob thang rang dbang dmangs gtso'i lam lugs/ khrims dang srid kyi stangs 'dzin sogs don du gnyer yang / chos lugs pa'i dgongs pa lta ra mtha' gcig tu btsan po dang gnyom chung cha mnyam/ phyug po dang dbul po cha mnyam sogs dgos zer gyi med/btsan gnyom dbul phyug su yin yang rang rang la dpags pa'i thob thang re dang 'gan 'khri re yod ces shod kyi yod/ khrims mthun gyi sgo nas phyug yo phyug po'i lam du 'gro chog pa ni mi chos ring lugs kyi thob thang yin/ phyug po'i 'bad 'bungs la rtsis med kyis med po dang cha mnyam bzo dgos pa ni lha chos ring lugs kyi dgongs pa yin/ de gnyis mi mtshungs bzhin du mtshungs pa bsgre ba'i thal 'gyur 'phen pa ni 'phen mkhan nyid kyi blo skyon yin/ chu 'di'i phar kha nas 'jigs su rung ba'i 'dre zhig gis bsgugs nas bsdad yod rgyu red snyam nas
spun gsum dang / gser mo ljongs thog gi bu mo spun bzhi zer ba de tsho'i cha lusas de mi min 'dre yi srol zhig e yin snyam/ kho mo tshos de dag ñtsā 'dra'i sngon thon dang deng rabs kyi dar srol yin par rlom yang bod rigs mi mang gis dang du len mi srid/ de tsho'i gyon ltangs dang 'khrab stangs de tsho mthong dus mi mang gis bu mo smyon ma tsho zer ba la'ang khag mi 'dug snyam 'ong / glu tshig yi ger phab pa 'ga' zhig la dgos nges kyi dag cha de tsam byung mi 'dug de rigs la snang chung gnang na mdzes ma'i lus la sna nag pa'i skal ngan du mi 'gyur ba'i nges pa med pa ma zad/ shi ma gson du yod pa'i bod pa'i skang yig gi ske la mtha' ma'i rdog brdzis btang ba'i sdig nyes kyang 'khri srid/de min rgya ska da kyi sgo nas glu dbyangs len pa 'di rigs la bod mi mang pos bas ma tshul 'ur chil ler 'dug mod gus pas ni bod mi yin na rgya glu mi len pa'i re ba zhu rtsis3med/ de la rgyu mtshan gnyis yod pa las dang po ni/ bod mis bod kyi ngo bo mtshon pa'i glu dbyangs rgya skad kyis len pa des bod kyi ngo bo la mi gnod pa'i steng du bod rigs ngo sprod dang dril bsgrags kyi nus pa zhig thon bzhin yod 'dug pas yin/ rgya mi rang dbang rtsom pa po grags can wang gis/ yu gur pa tshos rgya yi skad yig phyir 'bud ci thub byas pa'i mjug 'bras su rang nyid sngar bzhin kher rkyang du lus nas mi rigs gzhan pas da dung yu gur mi rigs zhes pa de rgya gzhung gis dril bsgrags byas pa nang bzhin kla klo dang —40—
mun nag gdug rtsub kyis khungs/ pa'i rjes lus mi rigs shig tu rtsibazhin yod/ bod pa tshos rgya yi skad yig lag cha zhig tu brtsis te dang len byas pas rgya yig gi larme nas rtsom 'bri mkhan gyi bod pa skor zhig thon nas bod dang bod pa'i rig gzhung rgya yig gi 4 ma nas 'grem ston byas pa'i dbang gis rgya rigs mi mang tshos bod la 'dzin pa'i lta tshul rtsab nas 'gyur yod la/ rgya nag nang khul gyi dpe tshong khang che khag gang du song yang bod skor gyi dpe deb sna tshogs kyis dpe sgrom gang nas bsdad 'dug pa mthong rgyu yod ces gsungs pa lta bu red/ rgyu mtshan gnyis pa ni rgya glu blangs na dpal 'byor gyi khe phan phran bu rag srid pa de yin/ dpal 'byor dmigs yul du byas te sgyu rtsal gnyer ba ni gzugs po 'tshong mkhan gyi bud med ltar yi gar 'ong ba'i bya ba zhig min yang / yod tshad dpal 'byor gyi rjes su rgyug bzhin pa'i dus 'dir kho tshos kyang zhar dang zhor la phyogs der mig zur lta tsam re byed pa la ni nga tshos kyang bsam shes thub los dgos/ deng sang 'dzam gling na glu pa glu ma rnams ni kha gdangs pa tsam gyis dngul lo'i char nga/ 'bab pa'i mi yin zer yang nga tsho'i glu pa glu ma tsho la de 'dra'i yong sgo nam yang med/ 'od 'khor dang sgra thagasas gsar pa re phud skabs khe skyed mi dgos ma malongs min 'dang rgyag che rgyu red snyam/ bod rigs mi grangs mang po med pas bod mi stong phrag re'i khrod na cha snyoms kyis 'od 'khor re brin pa'i dbang du btang na 'od 'khor stong tsho bzhi lnga tsam red/ da —41—
dung dbus gtswang pa tshos am glu mi nyan la/ a mdo pa tshos dbus bzhas mi nyan pas khrom ra de bas kyang rab gcig gu dog tu phyin yod/ rgya glu'i 'od 'khor zhig bzos rjes mi khri tsho re'i khrod du 'od 'khor re las 'tshong ma thub pa'i dbang du btang rung bsdoms pa sa 'od 'khor 'bum lhag brin 'gro ba red/da dung grangs nyung mi rigs kyi khrod du'ang rgya glu'i khrom ra gang 'tsham re jiyod/lhag don du snying na dgos pa'i don ngag gzhan zhig ni/ de ring brnyan 'khor gsar pa zhig khrorme tsal bton na de nyid brku bathus kyi brnyan 'khor brdzus ma zhig kyang nyin de rang du brgya cha brgya tham pa thon 'ong ba 'di red/( dngos yo dang rig gnas kyi bdag ngabang la rtsi 'jog spu tsam mi dgos pa'i khram pa 'i rgyal khab dang khram pa'i lung pa 'di la mtshon na/ dka' las yod tshad skya bas brgyab tshar rjes dngos grub yod tshad gzar bu'i kha nang du shor 'gro bzhin yod/nub yo rob kyi yul gru na yod pa'i grogs po zhig gis/ rma khug dang po'i brnyan 'khor cha tshang zhig sa nyi ma lha sa ru mngag nyo byas te pha gir 'byor dus 'gro 'gro gcig kyang mi byed la/ brtag dpyad gtong skabs da gzod brnyan 'khor brdzus ma zhig yin pa shes rtogs byung song zhes sems pham pa'i ngang nas brjod byung ba lta bu red/ de bas glu ma skal bzang me tog la rgya glu mi len pa'i zhu ba 'bul mi shes kyang rgya glu ni rgya glu rang las des bod klu'i go nam yang mi chod pas ma 'ongs par nga tsho bod pa tsho la dmigs te bod glu mang tsam dang de yang —42—
yid lams rgya mtsho dra4 zhu skyo ma pa'i snyan dbyangs/—bod glu khe gtsang gi 'khor thags mang tsam 'dom gnang yong ba'i re ba ha cang che la/ bod kyi gar stegs thog tu 'dzegs nas nyan mkhan bod rigs mi mang gi rna bar rgya glu btsan sgrog gi brnyas bcos de rigs ni nam yang mi kunang rogs zhes zhu rgyu yin/ na ning a 'dzoms pad blo zer ba'i rgya bla zhig gis rang nyid phyogs bcu ra sgrog ched glu dbyangs kyi 'du 'dzoms shig bsdus 'dug pa'i thog tu glu pa mang po zhig gdan 'dren zhus pa'i khrod na skal bzang me tog kyang yod pa 'dra/ skabs der rang re bod kyi grags can glu pa de tshos rang tshugs med la bro ba'ang med pa'i bran glu dang snyigs glu de 'dra'i mang po zhig blangs 'dug pa ni ngo ma sems pham 'ong ba zhig red/ kho tsho'i lag tu pad shag phran bu re thob na kha nang du skyag pa blugs kyang bldad rgyu yin pa 'dra/ rlabs che ba'i bsam/ blo pa che ge mo'i zhal nas/ rdzun gtam ni mi su zhig yin yang bshad srid la bshad kyang chog 'on kyang snyan ngag pa sa/cig pus rdzun gtan nas bshad mi srid la bshad kyang mi chos/ de ye rgyu mtshan ni kho snyan ngag pa yin pas red/ ces dang /gangs can gyi mtshan nyid smra ba'i snyan ngag pa dge chos lags kyi zhal nas/ ri mo mkhan dang / rol mo mkhan/ glu mkhan/ snyan ngag mkhan rnams kyi gshis ka de phag cher mthun po zhig red 'dug de tsho'i rigs ngo ma de ni chos kyi gshis lugs la ltad mo lta shes mkhan nam de dang nye ba zhig red ces gsungs/ 'o na rgyal sras pad blo la bstod glu 'bul mkhan gyi rang re'i glu pa de tsho la'ang gshis —43 —
lugs la ltad mo lta shes pa'i snyan ngag pa'i gshis ka de yod pa e yin/ yin na lo tshos srog la babs kyang rdzun mi lab pa'i snyan ngag pa'i dam tshig de srung bzhin e yod/ yod na kho tsho tshang ma rgyal sras pad blo la de 'dra'i dad pa dag snang can rkyang rkyang e yin/ de ltar rgyu ma phu 'ded du bsaca/ blo btang na nga tsho'i glu pa de tsho glu pa ngo ma zhig e yin na snyam pa'i sems khral langs 'ong bar 'dug sems pham dgos pa'i skyo gar de'i khrod nas dga' 'os pa'i don dag gcig kho na ma/thong rgyu yod pa ni/ glu ma ska la bzang lags kyis skabs der rang rigs spyi la bcangs pa'i zhen pa dkar po'i snyan dbyangs shig las/ che la gnyan pa'i mi ngo phye brag pa der dmigs pa'i sprel lad gang yang 'khrab dgos byung mi 'dug pa 'di red/ phyin chad kyang bla chen dpon chen de 'dras sgor ldag 'ga' res bslu brid kyis ②spyad byed pa'i nyen kha che bas gzab gzab mdzad dgos/ 'on kyang rang gi sems khong gi mi sna la bstod glu ma 'bul zhes zhu ba ni ga la yin/ de min khyed kyi glu dbyangs nyan mkhan gyi bod pa sems ldan khri stong mang pos khyed la bcangs pa'i re ba che shos shig ni/ khyed nam yang mi mang gi phyogs su bzhengs te mi mang gi skad sgra mtshon pa'i mi mang gi glu ma ya rabs shig bca' rgyu de yin/ gal srid gtsang rgyal mkhar meru sku 'khrungs pa'i glu ma sku zhabs ma tshe brtan sgrol ma ltar sger spyod dbang 'dzin pa'i sger spyod kyi srid jus dril sgrog byed spyad kyi stabs bde'i kha par du gyur pa yin na/ nyin de nas —44—
yi da khams rgya mtsho drag cu skyom pa'i snyan dbyangs / ———— ————bzung ste khyed kyi kha sgo skye 'bras dang rig rtsal gyi mtshar sdug yod tshad mi rigs 'di yi dgra gshed du babs nas khyed nyid mi yul 'dir bzhugs pa las dag zhing du gshegs song na spus gtsang ba de 'dra chags rgyu red/ sku zhabs ma tshe brtan sgrol ma lags su bod rigs gzhon skyes tshos shi rgyu med pa'i rgan mo dmar po de zhes zhu ba ma gtogs mtshan rjen par 'bod mkhan mi 'dug ja 'di byed kyis mkhye/ na par mdzad dgos/ khyed mi mang gi phyogs nas ba'engs skabs thob 'os pa'i mtshan snyan dang go skabs mang po zhig blos satong gnang dgos 'byung ba ni smos med lags mod/ bod mi sa ya drug gi snying dbus su khyed nyid nam yang gson por bzhugs nges pas des khyed kyi thugs dgongs gang 'tsham zhig rdzogs na 'os/ sgyu rtsal gyi bdag mo khyed kyi rgyu rtsal klog nga/ yo zhig gi sems khong gi re ba yod tshad rjen par zhus tshar song / da mjug tu smon 'dun zhig yod pa ni 'khrab ston sgyu rtsal gyi rmang gzhi ha cang legs pa'i bod rigs/ gzhon nu ma skal bzang me tog khong phyi yi rgyal khab cig gi glog brnyan slo ba gling gang rung zhig tu glog brnyan 'khrab ston slob sbyong gi go skabs shig rag thub na ci ma rung / nga tsho bod la da sto ches mkho ba ni glu dbyangs tsag tsig re len mkhan zhig min par 'jig rten yod tshad lus thog tu bsnams nas phebs pa'i skyes bu de 'dra yin/ nga tsho la med cing gzhan pa tshor yod pa'i dngos po dang bsam pa'i dpal yon ni rtsimi thon mod ches 'gram chu shor dgos pa zhig ni/—45 —
sa'an pa tshor so so'i mi rigs kyi 'khrab ston ma khan po dag giṭa/ so po'i mi mang gi dngos yod kyi 'jig rten mtshon pa'i ngo mtshar ltad mo ste sems kyi zas mchog la ci dgar rol rgyu yod pa 'di red/ phyir sdod rang rigs spun zla'i khrod du da skabs glog brnyan 'khrab ston mkhan gyi gzhon skyes re gnyis 'thon bzhin yod 'dug kho tsho'i 'khrab ston la lta mkhan gyi mi tshos slone brnyan 'khrag ston byed skabs bod pa tshor mi rigs gzhan las lhag pa'i dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos shig 'dug ces gdeng 'jog 'thob bzhin yod zer/ gtam de gcam gsag min par don la gnas na ci 'dra'i dga' ba la ang / des na dmigs gan rka gyi grod myos/ kyang ngamigs bsal gyi khyad chos 'dzoms pa'i bod pa'i bu mo da lta glu gar 'chab ston pa skal bzang me tog nyid/ ma 'ongs par glog brnyan 'a/khyab stom pa skal bzang me tog tu 'gyur ba'i0smon 'dumyo snying dbus na bcangs te sgug par 'do da do//pa ṇa chen ra rdzir i ngags pa'i lo rgyus dang //tsan dan sol bar bsgyur ba'i gtams rgyud des//ji srid nga khas pa'i kha 'di ma phye ba//de sring blun po'i blo ni lkub/sa par bstan//me phag zla 2 pa 'i tshes 22 nyin shar dung ri dkar po'i nye 'dabs su bris/—46—
bod yul tshol zla bsum/ — ———go yul chol kha gsum/dus rabs bcu tshim pa'i dus stod tsam na/ byang phyogs hor gyi rigs las byung ba'i jing se/ra rgyal r+ya dbang thang gnam gyi mthongs la bsnyegs te chen po sung gi rgyal khams ga nas bcom pa dang / e sha ya gling hril po rgyal khrims yug gcig gis khebs la nye bar ma zad/ shar yo rob kyi sa cha mang po zhig la'ang rkang brkyang lag brkyang byed rgyu byung ba'i mnga' thang gi dregs pas smyos pa lta bur m+mu/ dus der mtho bod kyi yul 'dir btsan r+ya rgyal khrims zhig cing / 'bangs gyen log byung nas lo grangs bzhi brgya la nye ba zhis/ phyin te/sgo kun nas nyams dmas par gyur pa'i skabs dang khel bas/ hor rgyal khi btsan yol la drag r+ya dpung gis ya lan slog ma shes pas ci bya gtol dang bral/ de lta na'ang / ga pos rang dang 'jam pos mi thub ces pa'i dpe ltar/bod khams gling ngakhu na mkhas pa'i grags pa can gtsang sa skya spo 'i bla ma kun —41—
dab/'a rgyal mtshan shes bya rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa gang de/ mtha' mi hor gyi gseb tu phebs te thabs dang thugs dz+re zung du 'brel 'tshe med zhi ba'i 'a/ma gyi stobs thugs kho na la brten nas/ 4 hor rgyal e che go dan gyi gdug rtsub drag po'i dbal kha re zhig zhi bar byas/ bdag nyid chen po gang de yi dngon po bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pas gnam gyi bu se chen gyi sgo gsum dbang du bsdus te/rgya'/ khab chen po'i dbu yi mchod gnas su phebs grub pa'i dga' ston du/ bod sgang pa'i lha sde mi sde sa cha yul ris dang bcas pa pha nor bu la dbang bcabazhin rang nor rang gis bdag tu bzung chog pa byung / bod shing sgo can yongs kyi bdas po nga pal ldan sa skya par gyur pa'i skabs der/ bod yul stod smad bar gsu ma du phye nas so so'i khyad chos dang bstun pa'i ming re btags pa 'di lta ste/mnga' ris/ gung thang nas sog la skya bo yan chad du dbus gtsang dam pa chos kyi tshol la/ sogi la skya bo nas rma chu'i khugs pa yan chad du mdo stod mgo nag mi yi chol /ba/ rma chu'i khugs phu pa nas mchod rten dkar chung yan chad du mdo smad gyi 'i nga rta yi tshol kha zhes pa'i ming de/ dus de nas bzung da lta'i bar du bod mi yongs kyi kha na chu 954/ rgyug che ba'i tha snyad cig tu gyur 'dug go/de yang ngabus ba/tsang mnga' ris dang bcas pa'i yul gru 'di ni bstan pa/ lnga dar gyi durnga5 su/ chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum dang ma khan slob chos gsum du grags pa rnams kyis bstan nga/'i rtsa ba btsugs shing / phyi dar bstan —48—
pa'i chu mgo lo chen rin chen bzang po dang / lha bcig r+ya ra me mdzad sogs rgya bod kyi lo paṇa gnam gyi skar tshogs bzhin byon nas/ dam chos bsgyur bshad kyis gtan la phab cing sgo ma sprub kyis nyams su blangs/ sa dwags dge rnying la sogs chos brgyud dang grub mtha' 'dra la mi 'dra ba du ma yang thog mar dbus gtsang gi phyogs nas dar khyab byung zhing / skyed shod lha sa'i gtsug lag khang /bsam yas chos 'khor chen mo/ rwa sgreng rgyal ba'i dben gnas/ rdo rnge gdan dpal ldan sa skya/ bo dong e yi chos sde/ byang ngam ring chos sde/ gtsang sna ra thang chos sde/ lho rtsed thang chos sde so gas dang / mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas gsang phu ne'u thog gi chos grwa sogs dbus khul gyi sngon gyi gdan sa chen po drug dus phyis kyi chos sde che shos 'bras se dga' gsum dang gtsang stod bkra shis lhun po bcas ri bo dag ldan pa'i lugs kyi grwa sa chen po bzhi ru grags pa rnams kyang dbus gtsang gnyis su yod pa bcas/ phyogs der sngon gyi dus su bshad sgrub las gsum gyi phrin las rlabs po che dar ba de yi phyed tsam yang mdo stod smad gnyis na ma byung bar snang bas/ skabs der dbus gtsang dam pa chos kyi tshal kha zhes brjod pa ni don gyi gnad la 'khyud pa'i gtam yin no//mdo stod khams kyi yul ni lho rgyud rgyal mo dngul chu/ chab mdo'i zla chu/ sde dge'i 'bri chu/ byang gi rdza chu ste chu bzhi dang / tsha ba sgang / smar khams sgang / 'bri zla zal mo sgang / rma rdza sgang / phrom 'bor sgang / mi nyag rab sgang bcas sgang drug —49 —
si sa cha rnams te/ deng gi sho star lho gsum/ smar brag char gsum/ lgang nang rdza gsum/ dkar brag dar gsum/ 'ba' li rgyal gsum/ sde dge mi nyag sogs la zer zhing / skabs der bar khams su yang 'bod par snang / yul de ga'i mi phag mo che rang bzhin bzang la ngang tshul brtan/ smra ba nyung zhing g.yo sgyu chung / gzhung rgyu da drang zhing phyi thag ring / pha ma dang rgan rabs la gus shing de dag gi gros la lha ga par brdzi mi dbang chen dang btsan po dag gi mdun du rnga ma g.yug bzhin brla 'tshong ba'i srol ye nas med/ gtam dang bya ba gang la yang ngo lkog dang mdun rgyab mi byed/ mi rgyus med la gtam lan tsam 'jal ba dka' yang she nye 'brel gyi ched du kha rje dang dbang thang gtong phod/ rku lag tu bzhag kyang mi len zhing rdzun kha la bslabs kyang mi shod/ sems khong du bde sdug chu yi gnyer ma bzhin mang yang gdong la dga' skyo'i rnam 'gyur mi mngon/ nang phan tshun ci tsam ma mthun yang phyi dgra dang thug tshe gcig rgyab gcig gis 'tsho/ mgo rna ba la ba6srung che bas las ci la thug kyang pus mo sa la mi 'dzugs/ dpa' snying stobs dang blo khog med na mi mi dgos khyi gral du yang mi bsi lar ci byas kyang blos thub kyi grogs la rtsis thang che ste/ grogs bzang po'o don du lus srog 'ben du 'jog dgos kyang dka' ba spru tsam med par byis pa rtsed mo'i grwa ru 'jug pa dang 'dra/ mdor na/ phyi gzugs drug lus kyi kho lag rdzogs shing nang snying stobs slobs pa'i rtsal thugs rgyas pa'i khams pa'i mi spus tsam/ mdo dbus gnyis char — —50
zad yu la chol kha gsum /du mthong ba dkon pas kho tshos kyang yid smon gyi gnas su brtsomyong ba ste/ 'bras ñtsha ngas kyi chos rje legs pa chos 'byor pas/ khams go po'i yul du sku 'khrungs pa'i rab 'byams pa bsod nams seng ge la/ rgol ba 'dis ni shar mdo kham sa sgang gi stag phrug gi rang gshis gsal bar bstan 'dug ces 'thab myo mi thub pa med pa'i khams pa'i snying stobs la don gyis khas len gnang /: brag sgom pa bstan pa rab rgyas kyi mdo smad chos 'byung du'ang / mdo khams stod kyi lugs gnyis kyi 'byor par bsams tshe/ a mdo'i yul ni gleng rin med pa lta bur snang /zhes khams kyi snod bcud gnyis la tshad mtho'i gdeng 'jog mdzad/ gtsang myang stod phyogs su sku 'khrungs pa'i kurma bco lnga pa cha/kha' khyab rdo rje 'da' kha'i bka' mol du/ kho bo la rang dbang yod na phyi ma khams kyi yul gru zhig tu skye ba len tseng 'dod de/ khams pa'i mi blo stobs dang gzhung drang de 'dra mchis tshe da gzod bya gzhag rlabs po che bsgrub nus pa yin/ zhes smon pa'i yul du mdzad/mkhas dbang dge mdun chos 'phel gyi lam yig las/ ngor e waṃ chos sder khams kyi kun mkhyen go rams pa'i rigs lam gli rjes shul ni da cha lus mi 'dug kyang zhal thugs de yi lhag ma da dung cung zad mthong rgyu 'dug ces brjed thor btab/ nye rabs gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang cegi mtho rim sras mo sku zhabs shig rgya phebs kyi 'grul lam khams nas gnang ba'i tshe na'ang / khams pa'i mi de tsho gzugs stobs che zhing rang bzhin drang la ha las dgos pa'i snying —51—
stobs can sha stag 'dug de tsho dang bsdur na/ rang re'i dbus gtsang gi mi rnams gnyom chung nus med kyi ngang tshul shas che bar snang / zhes bris 'dug pa lta bus mtshon no//bod shar byang gi mtha' na gnas pa'i a mdo'i yul rnams la gyi ling rta yi chol kha zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bod la mtshon na yul gru 'di dag rjes lus dang mtha' 'khob kyi gnas yin pas/ dam pa lha chos dang 'jig rten mi chos gang thad nas bltas kyang nyag ha cang phra zhing 'bur du thon pa ni ci yang med mod/ tha snyad snga ma gnyis kyi zla bor brjod bde ba'i ched du dud 'groto yi bstan pa dar sa zhes pa'i tshig 'di bla thabs su bsnan pa e yin snyam/ yang na rgan rabs rnams kyi ngag rgyun du/ mdo smad zi ling gi rta pho zhes bzhon rta skas 'dzegs la ma brten par zhon mi thub pa 'gros dang gom pa glog zhags 'khyug pa lta bu yod ces thos myong ba de bden pa yin tshe/ a mdo yul na mi spus la gleng rin med kyang rta spus sa cha gzhan las cung bzang ba yin shas che/de dag ni kha sang gi lo rgyus la phyi mig tsam bltas pa yin la/ 'dir brjod nyadod pa'i ska da cha dngos ni de ring gi gnad don zhig ste/ bod sa dum bu gsum por dam pa chos kyi chol kha zhes sogs sngon chad kyi 'bod srol rnying pa de tsho rang 'jags su bzhag na 'os shing 'tsham pa zhig yong min gyi thad nas bsam 'char 'ga' zhig 'don rgyu de yin/—51—
de yang /0 bod mi spyi bo gnam bstan yongs nas dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing khams dang / lha ldan dag pa'i gnas mchog mi yul du babs pa'i yid dga' chos 'dzin sogs bstod bkur bsngags gsum gyi yul du gyur pa'i gnas mchog de ru/ da lta khyed rang dngo4ge su phyin pa yin tshe/ khyed kyi mig lam na mya ngan med pa'i dga' tshal dang / me tog rkyang rkyang las grub pa'i 'jig rten sogs ngo mtshar can de 'dra gang yang mthong rgyu med/ de las ldog ste/ gna' bor lha dang snyan ngag gis grub pa'i zhing khams lha sa ru da lta shul du lus pa ni/bdag po bor ba'i khang stong gog po zhig dang / gzungs 'jug brus zin pa'i 'bag sku brdzus ma kha shas/ khang stong de dang 'bag sku de tshor brten nas phyogs gla len mkhan gyi ser gzugs bshad kha 'ga' zhig yod pa tsam du zad/ sngon chad dga' ldan gser khri'i 'os mi gangs seng dkar mo srab med du 'phyo ba'i gnas mchog gsang chen rgyud grwa stod smad gnyis su/ da lta kha dog yin na nag po yin pas khyab pa'i grong chog bla ma khyu zhig gis pha shul bus 'dzin gnang / de min ri bo ltar brjid cing rgya mtsho bzhin 'khyil ba'i chos kyi grwa phal mo che ni shul tsam yang ngos zin dka' la/ 'ga' zhig yod pa rnams kyang me shi zin pa'i du ba'i lhag ro 'dra ba re mal na lus 'dug kun gzigs bla ma'i thugs bskyed las gtsang stod bkra shis lhun po kho nar klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor lo gral ma tsam zhig mchis mod/ da skabs gnas de na'ang nying sha nying gis za mkhan mang —53—
phyir rtog ———— wawa——— —wawa—rma da// gzhan mkhar grong ngam rdzong sde dag tu yod dgos pa'i deng rabs kyi yar rgyas rnamig la 'gro ba ci ya nga med pa'i thog tu mi dgos pa'i chal chol mang po nang 'dren nam gsar gtod byed rgyu rnyed 'dug pa/ dper na/ za khang las mang ba'i chang khang tshong khang las mang ba'i bro khang / ca ga 'tshong khang las mang ba'i gzugs po 'tshong mkhan/ las ka byed mkhan las mang ba'i 'khyams nyul byed mkhan sogs yin/( mang mang gi bsam blo dang bya spyo da yod tshad rlung yan gyis ded pa'i sdong lo skam po bzhin dmigs yul dang kha gtad med par spur bzhin pa dang / rang kha 'bu khung dang 'dra bo gso ba'i thabs la yul de ga'i mi rnams blo rig bkra zhing hur brtson che ba lta bur snang mod/ don du blo rgya lag mthil las chung zhing blo phug mchan khung las thung bas gzi brjid du brtsichog pa'i grub 'bras ni nam yang ston rgyu med/ mi che chung thams cad la gdong thug tshe gus gus zhum zhum dang kha yag ngo bstod 'dom gang ba re 'chad nges kyang / kha phar 'khor gyi rjes su mchan dri bro ba'i gtam yan la rdzogs mtha' bral/ dus rtag par brdza brdzu dang 'phra 'phrul kho na 'khrab pa las/ snying dmar bstan pas nang mi dang khu tshur bstan pas phyi mir 'gro ba zhig rang bzhin gshis la ma grub/stabs legs nas thog tu slebs na rang 'gul gyis 'bab mi shes la lam 'chugs nas 'og tu tshud tshe ji ltar yang 'gul mi nus/ mchog dman kun la ma gros gcig mthun du yod pa'i sems khral zhig ni/ gdug rtsub dang cing spyod che — 54 —
ba'i khams pa ro cog dang a mdo sprang gog gnyis po'i 'dre lag lha lung dkar mo 'dir brkyangs nas/ nga tsho'i za skal 'thung ska la 'phrog mi yong ngam snyam pa'i sems ngal dang phrag dog ri las lci ba 'di ste/ don 'di la dmigs pa'i gtor bcom gyi las 'gul spel ba la ni pho mo rgan gzhon gyi dbye ba med par phyar ba gru 'degs gnang rgyu'i chod sems ci bas brtan/ kha nas 'o ma las dkar zhing bu ram las mngar ba'i skad cha snyan la 'brel chags pa re bshad shes pa'i sgyu rtsal rang chas kyi tshul du yod pa tsam las/ de min phyi nang gsang ba gang la yang dam pa'i lha chos lta ci 'jig rten mi chos kyi dri mas kyang cher ma gos par/ phyi logs nas dar ba'i ngan spyod sna dgu'i phrod du rang tshugs shor nas smyo 'khrab byed bzhin pa 'di/ gangs can bod mi'i sem sa khong gi sham bha la dbus dang gtsang gi da lta'i ngang tshul ma bcos pa lags pas/ deng phyin chad yul 'di la dam pa chos kyi zhing khams zhes gzhi med la sgro 'dogs byed pa'i mtshams bzhag ste/ khong rnam tsho mchod chang mchod rgyur mnyes po zhe drag yod pas/ myos byed chang gi pha sa zhes brjod na 'os shing 'tsham la rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan du'ang 'gyur bar snang ngo //smyug 'dzin pa'i lte thag gang du bcad pa'i pha yul mdo khams stod kyi 〉pa ༵༵༵ ༷༷ pasbyo rnyi /rdzu sa k+ṣiṃ sdum snang chishāmisna 〉pa lha/ pho —55 4
mo su yin la ma stos par lams pa phal mo che gzugs po che la tsho zhing rgyags pa de 'dra nī dngos gnas 'dug 'on kyang lkog lko sa sud sud du mgo dkar kha che'i za khang 'dra'i nang du 'tshong thub na ma gtosas/ da lta khrims mthun gyi sgo nas mi sha brin pa'i tshong ra 'dzam gling na med pas/ tsho zhing rgyags pa 'gro ba mi yi yon tan du 'jog dka' tshod red/ khams kyi mthang ni stag tshang zhig dang khams pa'i pho rgod tsho ni stag phrug khyu zhig dang 'dra bas yul 'di ni ngo ma dpa' bo mod pa'i sa cha zhig yin/ ya kha la 'byar ba'i snabs dbyi mi shes pa'i byis pa tshos kyang ced spyad yag shos gri dang rdo byed srid la/ kha nang du so mu tig tsam zhig lhag med pa'i rgan po thang khug dang 'dra ba tshos kyang gri ring re lag rten du bzung nas 'chi rogs shig e rnyed la re sgrug byed bzhin yod/ skyes pho rab cig yin na gri khar 'chi dgos/ zhes pa'i legs bshad 'di pha mes bka' drin tshos bzhag pa red la bu tsha bsod nams can tshos 'dzin pa'ang red/ de bas kyang dga' 'os pa zhig la/ deng sang 'dzam gling du tshan rtsal yar rgyas dang bod yul du dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas phyin pa dang stabs bstun/ khams pa tsho'i mi srog gcod pa'i lag ga'ang stabs bde deng rabs can chags bzhin yod de/phyug po'i gces phrug tsho'e khyim phug tu ring mda' re sbas shing skyed par thung mda' re drangs/ 'phrul mda' legs shos de tshor rgya sgor khri tsho du ma gnas yod skad de/ kho tsho la mtshon na/ nang gi nor bu dang phyi yi lcags ri kha rje dbang thang —56—
dang bcas pa de nyid kho na yin pas / rin song chen po de 'dra'ang sprod rin yod pa zhig red/ yul lung kha shas su mi khyim ci 'dra'i dbul po zhis yin kyang bya bda' zer ba'i 'phrul mda' mi gsod thub tsam zhig yod pa de 'dra re ma nyos na sde gral du mi tshud pa'i khrims kyang yod skad 'dug mtshon cha de tsho yul me spun zla kho na'i thog tu bed spyod byed rgyu las dmigs yul gzhan ci yang med pa kha gsal gting gsal yin stabs// sa gnas srid gzhung bis kyang dmi gas bas la gu yangs kyi gzigs skyong gnang bzhin pa red/ dper na/ kham sa 'jo mda' rdzong gi sde shog gnyis nyin kha shas ring phan tshun me 'phen 'thab 'khrug byas te bsnad skyon je cher song rjes// rdzong m+pi gnad yod mi sna zhib dpyod du babs skabs me mda' de rnams so sor sba dgos pa las mngon gsal du bstam na mi 'grig tshul sngon brda btang ba lta bu yin zhing / de tsam ma zad/ dgos gal byung dus mi gsod me mda' gzhung gis g.yar po gnang ba'i lo rgyus kyang khungs thub yod/ da dung mu mthung dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas ngang srid jus gu yangs phyin na/ 'phrul mda' dang 'bar mdel sogs kyang mkho sgrub byas te bed spyod btang na go rim mang po brgyud mi dgos par gtsang dag byed sla mo yong bar nges pas/ gzhung dmangs dog rtsagacig sgril gyis de'i phyogaṭaṭa su 'bad brtson dgos par snang bas dgongs 'jags 'tshal/ tshe srog la rtsed chas snying dz+re po zhig gi mthong tsam yang med pa'i pho rgod de tsho de 'dra'i 'chi ba la dungs shing — 57 —
