pa'i tha snyad 'di gnyis nub dar mtshan nyid rig pa'i 'jig rten lta tshul mi 'dra ba gnyis kyi ming yin par grags/ de yang tsho/ grangs nyis stong lnga brgya tsam gyi yar sngon du/ sa dbus rgya mtsho'i byang 'gram yo rob lho ma'i yul gru rge red si ru khre le si zhes pa'i mi zhis gis dngos gtso smra ba'i srol gtod/ de nas lo brgya phrag tsam gyi rjes su kuna' rabs rge red si'i mi bo che gsum gyi ya gyal pho la tho zhes pas sems gtso smra ba'i srol gtod/ 'dzam gling shar phyogs su gna' bo'i shes rig gi pha sa rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul la mtshon na/ skabs der sangs rgyas chos/ lugs ni ston pa shākya thub pas srol gtong ma thag pa tsam yin pas ma lag tshang ba'i rig pa'i gzhung lugs chags thub med/ bram ze'i chos lugs dar zhing rgyas pa'i sgang yin yang / 'jig rten lta tshul thad du drang srong dag gis mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul gyi lam nas lha sgrung gi rnam pas 'grel bshad ya mtshan pa das brgyab pa tsam las/ don dngos la brtag dpyad dang bsam gzheg ge srol da dung tshugs med pa 'dra/ des na rge red si ni nub lugs tsam ma zad 'dzam gling gi mtshan nyid rig pa spyi'i 'byung khungs su bshad chog par snyam/ dngos gtso la dbye na/ gna' rabs bab chags dngos gtso smra ba/ nye rabs 'gyur med dngos gtso smra ba/ deng rabs rtsod sgrub dngos gtso smra ba gsum/ sems gtso la phyi yul sems gtso smra ba dang / rang snang sems gtso smra ba/( 'jig rten gsar gtod smra ba gsum yod/ da dung dngos gtso dang sems gtso gang la yang mi gtogs — 115—
'gro rgyu lta ci/ snying chu 'dren pa/ sgang lde'u len pa sogs lag len dka' tshad dkon tshad rgyun chad de/ deng sang za stabs mi bde ba'i khrog sman gyi sdeb sbyor tsam las gzhan ci yang lus med pa 'di ltar red/ des na dbu ma 'jug pa tsam min par bka' mdo rgyud bstan bcos dang bcas pa zhal phye nas mjal ba yin mod/ 'jig rten phun tshogs la phan nges pa'i nom pa 'di 'dug snyam pa zhig ma shar/ gzhung lugs kyi ngos nas de ltar yin pa ltar lag len gyi steng nas bshad na yang / bod brgyud nang bstan pas bod pa'i 'tsho ba dang kha rgyab thad nas bod mi tshor khur po lhag ma zhig bkal ba tsam las 'gan khur spu tsam yang blangs med/ 'das pa'i mi lo stong phrag gcig tsam gyi ring la rang re'i chos pa tshos spyi tshogs phan bde'i bya gzhag gzhan dag dag lta ci ste/ ches bsgrub 'os pa'i shes yon gong 'phel gyi thabs lam tsam la yang / tha na mi ser dkyus ma'i bu phrug dkyus ma gcig kho na la yig rmongs sel ba'i rogs ram gnang myong ba'i lo rgyus shig mthong lam na e yod/ kho tshos kho tshor glo snying brang gsum gtad nas dmar dmar smug smug yod dgus mchod pa 'bul mkhan gyi dad ldan mi ser tshor lha mdun du phyag 'tshal du bcug pa dang / ri skor mtsho skor sogs su mngags pa/ gto dang zlog pa 'phen par skul ba/ ma ṇi grangs med cig gsog rgyu'i dam bca' 'jog tu bcug pa tsam kho na yin/ de'i dbang gis mi ser gyi blo ngor chos zhes pa de'ang de 'dra zhig tu 'char bzhin yod pa red/ mi
phru gu de gnyis kyis nga tshor blo gtad sa nas snying phug med/ gal srid khong rnam gnyis kyi bzhugs khri'i thog tu 'jam bzhad ra tsa gdong nyag tshang dang / zhing skyong dri med mgon po tshang lta bu zhig bzhag yod pa'i dbang du btang na a tsa ma de nas nga tshos ci byed dgos red/ rjes phyogs su de 'dra zhig 'jog mi yong ba'i nges pa spu tsam med pas da ni bsam blo tan tig gtong dgos pa'i dus la slebs yod/ da dung lo rgyus thog tu phyir bltas shig gnongs dang / bod pa tshang gi las dbang yong tshad thag gcod gnang ba'i bod rgya bar gyi chings yig don tshan bcu bdun la tha ma'i ngos len gyi mtshan rtags kyang lha 'dres lam ston 'og tu bskyon pa ma yin nam/ bod gzhis byes gnyis su gyes dang mi gyes kyi tha ma'i thag gcad kyang lha 'dre'i lam ston 'og tu byas pa ma yin nam/ kho bos nam yang brjed mi thub pa'i mthong ba khyad mtshar zhig la/ hor khang bsod nams dpal 'bar gyi rnam thar las/ kho bo gzhon dus lha sa'i rtsam gnyer las khungs kyi gnyer pa'i 'gan khur ba'i lo de'i dpyid rdza'i smon lam gyi ring der/nyin zhig gnyer tshang gi 'og shod mar rdo dang / bud shing sogs me 'jug sla ba'i dngos pos byur bur khengs pa der/ glo bur du me skyon chen po zhig shor te nyen tshabs shin tu che bas de 'phral gnas chung grags ldan dang / spyan g.yas ra mgo can gnyis gdan 'dren zhu bar rgyug pa yin zhes bris 'dug tshig gsal po mi dran kyang don de 'dra zhig red/ me la chu mi gtor bar 'dre gdan 'dren zhu
dor zhi gdong drug snyems blos/ sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' bzhi'i nang nas sems tsam pa de sems gtso smra ba dang / gzhan gsum po dngos gtso smra ba yin zhes bshad yod/ klu tshang shes rab bstan dar sogs smra ba la rab tu dga' yang smra rgyus shin tu phongs pa'i byis pa las ngan skor zhig kyang dor zhi tshang gi rkub tu 'ur 'drog byed kyin 'dug grub mtha' gzhan gsum dngos gtso smra ba yin zer ba 'di la blo rtsegatad sa sgo lnga'i dbang shes phyi rol yul gyi dmigs rkyen la brten nas skye ba 'di gcig pu las gzhan ci yang mi 'dug ste/ khyed dpon slob lhan rgyas kho na ma gtogs dngos gtso smra ba'i don de tsam la 'dod pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i slob dpon zhig 'dzam gling shar nub gang du'ang mjal rgyu med/dngos gtso dang sems gtso zhes pa'i sems de 'du shes sam gtso bo'i yid rnam la ngos 'dzin dgos pa las dbang shes tsam min la/ ang dang po dang gnyis pa'i go don yang gang zhig gang gi nyer len byed min gyi ngo bo'i thog nas 'jog dgos pa las/ dmigs rkyen dang gzung don lta bu nyi tshe ba'i rgyu 'bras tsam gyi thog tu ga la yod/ dus da lta'i bar du skye ba snga phyi khas len pa'i dngos gtso smra ba'i grub mtha' zhig gang du'ang yod par ma thos mod/ khyed rnam pas rang rkya thub pa'i sems nyid thog mtha' med par khas 'ches pa'i dngos gtso smra ba'i grub mtha' mang po de 'dra zhig rnyed pa ngo mtshar che'o// lho nub mi rigs slob gling gi slob dpon chen mo 'bum skyabs lags kyis kyang / rtsod sgrub mtshan nyid —118—
rig pa'i dpe deb cig tu/ sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' bzhi'i nang nas mdo r+yā pa de lhad med pa'i dngos gtso smra ba red/ ces bris 'dug mod rang gi slob dpon gyi ngan shan thebs pa tsam du zad/ sems tsam pa sems gtso smra ba yin zer ba 'di'ang khyed cag la gtan nas me rung ste/ spyir sems tsam pa'i grub mtha' de la rnam bden rdzun gnyis dang / rnam bden pa la gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam pa dang / sgo nga phyed tshal pa/ sna tshogs gnyis med pa gsum/ rnam rdzun pa la dri bcas dri med gnyis bcas kyi dbye ba yod mod re zhig bzhag ste/ sems tsam zhes pa'i tsam sgra de'i rtsaba'i go don rang la bsam na yang bod 'dir 'grel bshad rgyag stangs rbad de mi 'dra ba gsum yod/ gtsang chos 'khor sgang pa sher rin pas/ sngo ser sogs phyi yul gyi snang ba thams cad nang gi sems nyid dngos yin par 'dod la/ dwags rnying gi mkhas pa phal mo ches 'dod tshul de nyid 'thad par ba rta nag gi mkhas pa go rams pas/ sems nyid gcig pu ma gtogs sngo ser sogs don snang ma lus pa dpyad na gtan med du 'dod la/ sa lugs 'dzin pa phal mo che de'i rjes su 'brang bar byed/ rje yab sras kyis gtsos pa'i dge phyogs kun zhal gcig grag gis/ gzugs sems gnyis po ngo bo gcig la rang ldog tha dad pa'i don du smra/ de ltar gsum las khyed cag dge ldan pa'i grub mtha' skyong dgos pas/ gzugs sems gnyis kyi bar na gtso phal dang ang rim ci zhig brtsi rgyu 'dug bsam blo thongs shig sems tsam zhes pa'i tshig tsam —119—
la re nas sdod dgos pa khyed cag mkhas pa'i gral du 'tshang ka rgyag pa 'di ni ma legs pa zhig go/ khams bla rung chos grwa'i mkhan po mkhas dbang tshul khrims blo gros lags kyi zhal nas/ sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' bzhi po gang yang nub dar mtshan nyid rig pa'i lugs gsum po gang gi khongs su yang mi gtogs gsungs/ rgyu mtshan re re bzhin du bgrang skabs/ dngos gtso smra ba'i khongs su gtogs min gyi dogs pa tsam yang skye ba'i gzhi med/ ces gsungs 'dug pa ni shin tu bden la/ spyir sems tsam pa sems gtso smra ba min pa'i sgrub byed du/sems tsam pa la gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag yod cing / nub kyi sems gtso pa la de med pa'i phyir/ zhes bkod gnang 'dug pa 'di ni ma nges pa zhig ste/ sems gtso'i 'jog mtshams gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag khas len min gyi phyogs su med par gong du bshad zin to// bye brag tu sems tsam rnam bden pa nyams myong sems gtso smra ba min pa'i grub byed du/ nyams myong sems gtso smra ba rber khe yis/ rigs pa'i mtha' 'jig rten byed po'i lha la bcol 'dug cing /sems tsam rnam bden pas de 'dra'i lha khas mi len pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs 'dug pa'ang don med pa zhig ste/ de gnyis bar la bsgrub bya snang ba sems su 'dod min gli khyad par gsung rgyu med na sgrub byed kyi rigs pa mi 'dra ba yod tshul tsam bshad pas ci zhig phan/ snang ba thams cad sems yin na sems can med pa'i sa phyogs su snang ba gtan med du 'gyur ro// zhes gzhan pas gnod —120—
byed 'phangs pa na/ tshad rdul nus rig pa dang / nyams myong sems gtso pa dag gis lan ma thebs mod/ sems tsam pas rigs pa rnam dag gi sgo nas lan btab yod/ ces gsungs pa de'ang bden dka' ste/ sems tsam pa la snang ba sems su sgrub byed kyi rigs pa rnam dag yod na grub mtha' de dbu ma pas ji ltar tshar bcad pa yin thugs bsam bzhes shig da dung dbu ma pa'i lugs la'ang snang ba sems yin chog pa'i gnas skabs yod/ ces sosas khungs mi 'khyol ba'i skad cha mang po zhig khyed kyis gsungs 'dug mod kho bos re re bzhin bkag pas mi longs par 'dug grub mtha' bzhi ka rgyu gnyis smra ba min pa'i sgrub byed du/ rgyu gnyis smra ba'i slob dpon re ne rdo gar thus/ mi lus 'phrul chas dang / dud 'gro la rnam shes med par 'dod cing / sangs rgyas/ pa sus kyang de ltar 'dod mi srid pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa 'di'ang rgyu gnyis smra ba'i 'jog mtshams ngos ma zin pa'i skyon yin la/ rgyu gnyis smra ba yin na re ne rdo gar thu zhes pa des gang bshad khas len dgos pa'i shes byed kyang khyed la med/grub mtha' de dang de dngos gtso dang sems gtso sogs gang yin dpyad pa'i tshe/mdon 'jig rten gyi 'byung khungs sems dang dngos po gang zhig 'dod min gyi cha nas dpyad dgos pa las/ nub phyogs kyi dngos gtso ngas dang / sems gtso smra ba'i mkhas pa bye brag pa 'ga' re'i 'dod tshul chung tshagasari re dang 'gris/ min gli sgo nas dpyad pa brjod pa la dgos nus ci yang med/ de lta ra byas na —— 121—
bod snga ma rnams kyis 'dod pa'i sems tsam pa de spyir sems gtso pa dang / bye brag tu nyams myong sems gtso smra ba'i lugs su snang ste/ rnam par shes pa tsam zhig rigs gzhan la tshos med du grub pa dang ji/ don du snang ba thams cad gang zag so so'i sems kyis bsags pa'i bag chags kyi dbang gis snang ba ma gtogs/ sems las logs su tshugs thub tu med cing / sems kyi bag chags byed pa na ma dgag rang yal du 'gro bar 'dod la/ sems gtso smra bar 'jog pa la de bas lhag pa'i cha rkyen ci yang brtsergyu med/ grub mtha' gzhan gsum dang dge ldan pa'i 'dod lugs kyi sems tsam pa dang bcas pa ni/ bshad tshod tsam gyi dbang du byas na rgyu gnyis smra ba'i lugs yin te/ bem po shes pa'i nyer 'bras dang // shes pa bem po'i nyer 'bras gang yang mi 'dod par be+em shes gnyis ka thog med nas da lta'i bar du gshib nas 'ong bar bshad pas so// song tshod la ni spyir sems gtso smra ba dang / khyad par du 'jig rten gsar gtod smra ba'i phyogs su song yod de/ bem shes gnyis kyi bar la kha 'bral thabs med pa'i 'brel pa zhig mthong rgyu yod kyang / rgyu gnyis smra bas ni de'i skor la 'grel bshad cung zad kyang byed ma thub pas/ da gzod las 'bras kyi rnam gzhag kha gsab brgyab ste de gnyis kyi 'brel ba la gsal bshad byas yod/ las 'bras kyi rtsab sems la thug pa'i dbang gis sems gtso par song zhing / las 'bras kyi 'thad pa rtog btags dang / lha sgrung tsam las rigs pa'i lam nas brjod ma — 122—
thub pa'i dbang gis 'jig rten gsar gtod smra bar song ba red/ 'jig rten bkod pa po tshig zin la khas ma blangs kyang / las 'bras kyi thugs nas 'jig rten bkod pa po'i lam dang lugs srol mang po rang shugs su thon 'ong ba yin te/ sngar bshad zin pa ltar sdig pa gsog mkhan tsho shi tshar rjes su zhig gis sa 'og tu khrid nas nyes chad gcod 'ong ba dang / dge ba sgrub mkhan tsho nam mkha'i dbyings su 'bad med lhun grub kyi 'tsho ba rol chog pa sogs ming las 'bras su btags kyang don byed po'i bkod sgrig las 'gro sa meng pa nge 'dra mang po yod pa red/ dper na snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig pa'i skabs su/ 'jig rgyu rang steng nas tshang mi dgos par 'jig pa'i dus la sleb dutras 'jig byed kyi nyi ma drug rang gar gzhan zhig nas thon 'ong ba lta bu red/ gzhan pas dkon mchog mnyes na lha yul dang / ma mnyes na dmyal khams su lhung 'gro bar bshad mod/ dkon mchog khong dge ba byas na mnyes shing sdig pa bas gas na mi mnyes/ par bshad pas gnad gcig tu babs yod/ phyugs kyi cha/chod sbyin sogs dalom mchog mnyes byed du bshad pa ni/ dge sdig ngos 'dzin tshul ma 'dra ba tsam las dge sdig khas len min gyi khyad par min/ mdor na gong gi sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' de gsum pos 'jig rten 'di ci zhig yin zhes pa dang / 'jig rten 'di gang nas byung zhes pa'i dri ba gnyis la rgyu gnyis smra ba'i lugs ltar la'o btab pa dang/ 'jig rten 'di ji ltar yin zhes pa dang / 'jig rten 'di ci'i phyi ra — 123ga
phyir rtog byung zhes pa'i cadri ba gnyis la 'jig rten gsar gtod smra ba'i lugs ltar lan btab pa yin par shes dgos/ drang por bshad na dri ba phyi ma 'di gnyis la lan tshul bzhin thebs mkhan zhig chos lugs pa dang / mtshan nyid rig pa pa/ phyis kyi tshan rig pa gang gi khrod du'ang byung mi 'dug dkon mchog smra ba'i chos pa tshos 'jig rten dkon mchog gis bskrun par bshad pa tsam las/ dkon mchog rang nyid ji ltar byung ba dang / bskrun pa'i dmigs yul gang zhig yin pe bcas bshad rgyu med/ las 'bras smra ba'i chos pa tshos/ las 'bras la brten nas bem shes gnyis kyi 'brel ba tsam zhig bshad pa las/ bem shes gnyis kyi ngo bo'am rdzas rgyun de ji ltar byung ba dang / ci'i phyir byung ba'i thad du lan ci yang btab med/ ngo bo la 'grel bshad bya rgyu med na khyad par la cig bshad khul byas kyang ci zhig phan/ he rgul lta bu'i sems gtso pa tshos/ 'du shes ni ma gzhi nas yod pa zhig yin pa la/ dngos po ni de'i grib ma tsam zhig tu nges zhes dang / mar khe si lta bu dngos gtso pa tshos/ ma gzhi nas yod pa'i dngos po las 'du shes byung ba yin/ zhes pa tsam zhig las sems sam dngos po de ma gzhi nas yod don ci zhig yin pa dang / yod tshul ji ltar yin pa'i skor bshad mi 'dug tshan rig pas kyang / 'jig rten 'di'i 'byung khungs 'gas gtor chen mo yin rabs bshad pa tsam ma gtogs/ nus pa'i rba klong ji ltar byung ba dang / 'gas gtor chen mo ci'i phyir byung ba'i tshul shod kyin med/ yin na'ang dri ba dang po gnyis —1244
la lan 'debs pa'i skabs su/ dayon mchog smra ba tshos dkon mchog gi khungs lha sgrung dang/ las 'bras smra ba tshos las 'bras kyi khungs rtogs btags dang / rgyu gnyis smra ba tshos rgyu gnyis kyi khungs 'ol tshod tsam las ma 'das pas de gsum la dad pa dang ham pa las brgal mi rung zhing / sems gtso'i mtshan nyid smra ba tshos dngos po'i byung rim nyams myong gi lam nas dang / dngos gtso'i mtshan nyid smra ba tshos 'du shes kyi 'phel rim lo rgyus kyi lam nas dang / tshan rig pa tshos 'gas gtor chen mo gtan srol gyi lam nas bsgrub yod stabs/ de gsum por rigs pas dpyad pa bya chog pas de'i cha nas bar khyad chen po zhig shor yod par snang ngo //gnyis pa khyad par gyi cha nas tshan rig gi grub don dang mthun min gleng ba la/ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i bka' slob cig tu/ phyi dngos po'i sdod lugs kyi skor la sangs rgyas chos gzhung las tshan rig pas bshad pa dag don la gnas pa yod/ ma gzhi chos gzhung nas kyang rdul phran gyi rnam gzhag/ sogs gsungs yod kyang tshan rig pas bshad pa nang bzhin khungs 'khyol po de 'dra med/ sems dang sems byung gi ngos 'dzin byed stangs spyi dang/ lhag par du tshor ba bde sdug gi 'pho 'gyur dang / chags sdang gi bsam blor gdong len byed thabs sogs sems khams 'phrod bsten gyi skor la da gzod tshan rig pa tshos sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung gi nang nas legs cha mang po zhig len rgyu yod pa red/ ces phebs 'dug — 125 —
la 'di ni sku nyid sangs rgyas chos lugs pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas chos lugs de'i dgongs pa'i gnad ma shor zhing / dngos yod kyi gnas tshul la bsnyon mi 'ding ba'i thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba'i gsung zhig tu snang ste/ a mdo dge 'dun chos 'phel lags kyis / don dam par sangs rgyas chos lugs la sha tsha zhing snying nye ba zhig yin tshe gtso phal mthong ba'i dgongs pa gu yangs mo zhig bzhes na legs pa yin gyi/ lung tshig phra mo yan chad ma nyams par 'dzin khul gyi lkugs pa u tshugs byas pas mi phan zhes gsungs pa ltar red/ 'on kyang rang re'i r+ya khas pa gzhan phal mo che zhig ni de las ldog ste sdig pa mig btsums kyis mtha' gcig tu chos gzhung gi rnam gzhag yod tshad la 'gebs srung byed rkyang dang / de'i ched du rdzun dang g.yo 'phrul gyi bya byed sna tshogs khab 'gro 'bigs 'gro spyad nas de nyid bstan pa la bya ba rlabs po che byas pa yin par rlom bzhin 'dug dper na gser rta mkhan po tshul khrims blo gros lags kyi zhal nas/dngos khams tshan rig la snga rabs rdul phran smra ba dang / nye rabs ltos bcas smra ba/ deng rabs tshad rdul smra ba bcas cung gleng rin yod pa'i lugs gsum yod pa las/ dang po ni bye smra'i grub mtha'i cha shas tsam dang / gnyis pa ni mdo sde pa'i grub mtha'i cha shas tsam/ gsum pa ni sems tsam pa'i grub mtha'i cha shas tsam yin/ kho bos mi lo nyi shu'i ring la zhib 'jug dang 'dri cad byas pa las shes rtogs byung ba ni/ tshan rig pa kho tshos gsar gtod dang gsar rnyed du rlom — 126—
pa de dag nga tsho'i ngor dkyus ma'i shes bya tsam zhig las ha las 'ong ba dang / ya mtshan dgos pa cung zad kyang med pa 'di red/ ces sogs rang rtug gser mgo dang / rang rna lha khang gi skad cha nyan mi 'dod pa mang po zhig gsungs 'dug pa lta bu red/ 'dir khong gi skad cha de tsho'i rngan mtshang rnam sa re re bzhin du brus na/ bye smra'i lugs kyi rdul phran gyi rnam gzhag dang / dngos khams pa'i lugs kyi rdul phran gyi rnam gzhag gnyis la/ rdul phran zhes pa'i ming tsam zhig thun mong du yod pas thugs tshim bzhin yod na ma gtogs don gyi bar thag ni gnam dang sa las kyang ring ba zhig yin/ bye smra sogs sangs rgyas pa tshos rdul phran gyi go don che chung [ribo na'i cha nas bshad pa las rigs dang nus pa'i phyogs su bsam blo 'khor thub med/ de'i dbang gis cha bcas dang cha med/ thug bcas dang thug med/ yod pa dang med pa sogs 'dra min bco brgyad smra dgos byung yod la/ smras pa de dag gi khrod du khungs 'khyol ba ni gcig kyang mthong rgyu med/ rigs kyi cha nas 'byung ba bzhi dang / 'gyung 'gyur bzhi ste rdul rdzas brgyad dam dgu las med par 'dod cing / 'di ni dngos po'i rtsom gzhi sa chu me rlangs bzhi ru 'dod pa'i nub lugs kyi lta ba rnying pa de rang yin/ khyed kyis bye smra'i lugs kyi dngos po'i rtsom gzhi 'byung ba bzhi po de 'byung bzhi mtshan nyid pa la go mi dgos pas gna' rabs kyi nub phyogs pas bshad pa de dang mi 'dra/zhes gsungs 'dug kyang 'byung bzhi mtshan nyid pa la go dgos par mngon pa — 127—
mdzod las bshad yod de/ me la rlung rdul yod pa'i rgyu mtshan du me lce g.yo ba dang / chu la me rdul yod pa'i rgyu mtshan du dngos rdzas rul ba dang / rlung la sa rdul yod pa'i rgyu mtshan du thal ba spur 'gro ba sogs bkod yod pas so// rdul phran de'i che chung gi tshad phra rdul ther 'bum gnyis la nye ba zhig phreng bar bltar na da gzod sor mo gang zhes bshad pa de'ang tshod dpag tsam las shes nas smras pa min/ dngos lugs kyi mthong ba dang yang mi 'grig ste/ rdzas 'gyur spyir btang ba'i gzhi rgyu'i tshad yin na phra ches pa dang / bar rdul dang glog rdulda sogs kyi tshad yin na rags ches pa'i phyir ro// bar stong dang 'then thugs kyi rnam gzhag de dag kyang dam bca' ltar snang zhig bsgrub pa'i ched du gang byung gang dran du smras pa kho na yin/ mthar rtsaba'i dam bca' sbo lug pa'i tshe rnam gzhag de tsho'ang sbo lug pa red/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi zhal nas/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'o// zhes pa tsam las rgyun dang skad cig ma'i khyad par gsal por ma gsungs/ de nyid bye smra kha cig gis/ rags pa rgyun gyi mi rtag pa'i don du 'dod/ mdo sde pa sogs kyis phra ba'i mi rtag par 'grel yang mi rtag pa'i go don yag po zhig ngos zin med/ dper na brag rdo rlung gis zad pa dang / srog chags rgas nas 'chi ba/ skye dngos 'tshar nas longs pa sogs ni mkhas blun sus kyang shes pas rigs pas bsgrub mi dgos/ shin tu phra ba'i rdul phran skad cig dang po dang / gnyis pa'i bar la ngo bo'i thog nas 'gyur ba ci zhig phyin — 128—
yod mdo sde pa la bshad rgyu med/ sgrub byed du/ dang por mi 'jig phyis mi 'gyur/zhes bkod pa de ni byis pa btsas 'phral ma shi na phyis kyang mi 'chi/ zhes pa ltar rigs pa go chod pa zhig min/ dus kyi thung mtha' se gol gyi drug bcu'i cha gcig yin zhes pa ni go bde ba'i ched tsam las/ don du dus tshod thung mtha' zhig la go dgos/ zhes pa'i nyid kyi bka' mol de'ang blo la mi 'bab ste/ dus kyi thung mtha' gang yin dpyad pa'i tshe dngos yod gsal por gsungs dgos pa las go bder byas pas mi chog cing / thung mtha'i tshad de thung mtha' zhig yin zhes pa la ni go rgyu ci yang mi 'dug go /dngos khams tshan rig pas dngos gzugs yod tshad bar snang stong par 'phur skyod byed bzhin yod par bshad pa las/ tho bas bcom na 'thor 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis rdul phran du 'dod pa ma red/ ngo bo gser dngul zangs lcags sogs gzhi rdul mi 'dra ba brgya dang bcu lhag rnyed yod la/ sa chu me rlung bcas ni rdzas 'gyur gyi snang tshul tsam las gzhi rdul gyi gras su med/ dper na dbyang rdul gcig dang ching rdul gnyis bcas ma rdul gsum 'dus tshe da gzod chu yin pa dang / dbyang rdul gnyis 'dus tshe da gzod rlung yin pa lta bu red/ che chung gi tshad ni ma rdul dung phyur gcig bshibs na li smis gcig gam sor gang tsam yod zer/ mi rtag pa'i don yang rdul phran thams cad shin tu myur ba'i sgo nas 'phur skyod byed bzhin yod pa 'di rang yin/ tshe srog dang skye dngos rigs kyi 'phel 'gyur dang / rdzas 'gyur gyi 'gul — 129—
skyod sogs la ni yongs khyab kyi mi rtag pa'i don de mi tshang / mdor na rdul phran 'khor skyod kyi rnam gzhag 'di khas ma blangs na bar stong dang / 'then shugs/'pho 'gyur bcas la 'grel bshad rgyag thabs med cing / bye smra'i grub mtha'i nang du 'khor skyod kyi rnam gzhag zur tsam yang med pas bar stong sogs kyang ming tsam du gyur pa red/ lhag par du mkhas dbang khyed kyis nges par du mkhyen dgos pa zhig ni/ grub mtha' gong ma tsho'i lugs la bye mdo gnyis kyi rdul phran gyi rnam gzhag de thams cad khungs med rtog bzo 'ba' zhig tu khas len dgos pa 'di yin/ de'i tshul gsal por zhus na/ bye mdo gnyis kyis phyi don dpyad bzod du yod par 'dod kyang snam bu bshig na snal ma dang / bum pa bcag na gyo mo dang / nas 'bru 'thag na rtsam pa ru 'gyur 'gro bas snam bu dang / bum pa/nas 'bru bcas bden par grub ces smras na mi 'grig par bsam ste mthar rdul phran phyogs kyi cha med la thug pa red/ phyogs kyi cha med yin na rags pa ji ltar rtsom zhes dris pa'i lan du/ phan tshun thug reg med pa'i bar stong dang bcas pa yin zer/ 'o na bye ma ltar 'thor mi 'gro'am zhes dris par/ las kyi mthu dang rdzas kyi nus pas dam por sbrel yod zer/ gzugs mtha' cha med du khas ma blangs na 'di 'dra'i dri ba dris lan gang yang 'ong don med pa red/ phan tshun thug reg med pa'i dbang du btang rung dbus rdul gcig la phyogs rdul drug gis bskor ba'i tshe/ dbus rdul der phyogs rdul re re'i phyogs su gtad pa'i — 130—
ngos mi 'dra ba drus yod na dbus rdul cha med nyams thing / med na dbus rdul/ la gtad pa'i phyogs rdul drug gi ngos thams cad kyang phyogs gcig kho nar gtad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur ram zhes dris pa na/ dris lan tshig gcig ma thebs pas rdul phran cha med kyi dam bca' de rtsad nas shor song ba red/ bsgrub bya cha med kyi grub mtha' de shor tshar dus sgrub byed bar stong dang 'then shugs kyi skor de'ang rang shugs kyis rtsis med du song yod/ rgyu mtshan de la brten nas sems tsam pa tshos/ gzugs can gyi chos kun ma brtags nyams dga'i snang ba tsam las dpyad na snying po med pas khas mi len zer/ dbu ma pas tha snyad du phyi don khas len kyang rnam gzhag yod tshad rigs pa mi shes pa'i 'jig rten rgan po'i kha la nyan rgyu yin zer/ dge ldan pa'i mkhas pa tshos dbu ma'i grub mtha' der 'grel bshad gzhan pa zhig bskyon bzhin yod kyang de la snying po med pa'i tshul 'og tu 'chad/ mdor na gzugs mtha' rdul phran cha med dang / bskor ba bar dang bcas pa/ dpe la g.yag rnga ne'u gseng sogs bye mdos bshad tshad gtam tshad sems tsam pa ltar na khyad gzhi med pa'i khyad chos 'ba' zhig dang /dbu ma pa ltar na tha snyad 'joms pa'i tho ba ru ngos 'dzin bzhin yod/ 'o na dngos lugs pa rnying pa tshos rnyed pa'i kun khyab 'then shugs dang / rdzas 'gyur gyi ma rdul/ dngos ngo'i 'gul skyod 'di dag kyang khyad gzhi med pa'i khyad chos sam/ yang na tha snyad 'joms pa'i tho ba ru zhal gyis bzhes rgyu yin nam/ de min — 131 —
na khyed skabs 'dir dbu sems kyi lta grub rgyab tu g.yug nas bye mdo'i rjes su phebs rgyu yin/ dbu ma pas kyang tha snyad du rdul phran dang / bar stong / 'then shugs gsum khas len snyam du dgongs na/ khas len pa'i khungs gang du yod/len dgos pa'i gal 'gag ci zhig la thug sgrub byed kyi gtan tshigs ci 'dra yod/ sems tsam pa'i rigs pa la skyon spong gang 'dra byed/ kun rdzob la rigs pa'i 'thad pa mi bcug pa'i rang gi grub mtha' la 'gal slong ji ltar byed/ phyi don bden grub 'gog byed kyi rigs pa gsar pa ci zhig 'god rgyu bcas re re nas gsungs shig dang ltad mo yod/ sngon gyi dbu ma pa tshos de dag khas mi len kyang / deng sang nga tshos dngos lugs pa'i legs cha blangs nas khas len chog snyam du dgongs na/ de ni sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' la dngos khams tshan rig gis kha gsab brgyab pa tsam las/ sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha'i nang du dngos khams tshan rig yod pa'i don du mi 'gro/ lar khyed kyis dbu ma'i lugs su bzhed pa'i rdul phran de cha bcas yin nam cha med yin/ cha bcas yin na chung mtha' ru ji ltar 'thad/ cha med yi na na rags pa ji ltar rtsom/ dpyad pa mi 'jug na 'di la ci la 'tshang sogs mang po zhig 'dri bar 'dod do//stos bcas tshan rig mdo sde pa'i grub mthar 'dus zhes pa la ni de bas kyang snying po med de/ mdo sde pa'i grub mtha'i nang du yod pa'i e'an san ḍan gyi ltos bcas tshan rig de/ g.yas g.yon ring thung sogs kyi tha snyad phan tshun ltos — 132—
nas 'jog dgos par bshad pa 'di e yin/ 'di min na sang du'ang mi 'dug pas khyed rang mig 'khrul par zad do// 'di yin na g.yas pa g.yas par 'jog pa la g.yon pa zhig yod dgos pa dang / ring po ring por 'jos pa la thung ngu zhig yod dgos pa'i gnas lugs 'di shes mkhan mi bcu gnyis sam/ yang na mi gnyis dang phyed ka las med pa'i 'dzam gling 'di mi zad khur ba yin rgyu red/ngo bo ltos nas grub pa dang / tha snyad ltos nas 'jog pa'i khyad par tsam yang mi phyed pa'i ltos bcas smra ba khyod ni smra ba la dga' ba zhis go /khyed kyis e'an san ḍan gyi ltos bcas tshan rig 'di da dung bden rdzun thag chod med/ gal srid bden pa yin na ni mdo sde pa'i grub mtha'i nang du 'dus zhes gsungs 'dus/ 'o na rdzun pa yin na mdo sde pa'i grub mthar bsdu mi 'dod pa e red/dngos gnas byas na ltos bcas tshan rig 'di bden rdzun ci yin khyed kyis thag gcod gnang 'os par 'dug ste/ khyed ltos bcas tshan rig mdo sde pa'i grub mtha'i cha shas tsam du bzhed pa'i phyir/ yang na khyed dbu ma'i slob dpon ri 'dra ba zhig gis mdo sde pa'i grub mtha' de bden rdzun thag ma chod par phyis byung tshan rig pa'i kha la re dgos pa e yin/ yang dor zhi sogs kyis/ rten 'brel gyi lta ba dang / ltos bcas smra ba'i lta ba gnyis don gcig red zer/ ngo bo stong nyid dang don gcig red zer ram/ rang bzhin rten khyung dang don gcig red zer/dang po ltar na ltos bcas smra bas bdag med rtogs zin pas mi ring bar — 133 —
bdag 'dzin kyang spang nas sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ltar na rten 'brel gyi don rgyu la brten nas 'bras bu 'byung ba dang/ bu bskyed pa'i cha nas pha ru 'jog pa 'di gnyis khron yim pas/ 'di gnyis gang zhig la stos bcas smra ba'i go don yod pa yin nam/ so nam ma byas na ston thog med pa dang / bu med pa'i mi la pha rgan mi zer ba'i gnas lugs 'di 'dzam gling gi mi kun gyi sems la nges pa'i rgyun shes shig yin pa las tshan rig pa e'an san ḍan gyis gsar du rnyed pa'i gsang ba zhig min lags/ gang zag cig gi stobs shugs la brten nas dngos po chung ba'i nang du che ba bsdu thub pa dang / dus tshod thung ngu'i nang la ring po 'gro thub pa'i rigs lam zhig ltos bcas tshan rig pas rnyed med la/dngos gzugs shig gi 'gul skyod dang 'then thugs la brten nas dngos gzugatraṭa gzhan gyi tsho tshad dang bongs tshad 'gyur 'gro ba'i rigs lam zhig traṭangs rgyas chos gzhung du bshad med/ sangs rgyas chos gzhung du/ dngos po chung ba rnams che bar bsgyur/ dus tshod thung ngu rnams ring por bsgyur/ kha zas mi 'im pa rnams zhim par bsgyur/ long ba mig ldan dang / zha bo rkang bzang du bsgyur ba sogs med pa dang ma yin pa mang po zhig yod pa dang yin par bsgyur thub pa'i tshul zhig bshad yod la/ de ltar bsgyur thub pa'i rgyu mtshan ni sangs rgyas mthu rtsal che bas yin zer/ de ltar na dmyal ba zhing khams dang / 'khor ba myang 'das su bsgyur mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin bsam dgos shing / yang rdul phran —134
dang lhun po mi 'gal ba dang / skad cig dang bskal pa mi 'gal ba'i tshul zhig bshad yod la/ de dag mi 'gal ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ chos rnams cir yang ma grub pa'i gnad kyis gang yang 'char chog pa dang / bden par ma grub pa'i dbang gis sna tshogs su snang du rung ba 'di yin zer/ de ltar na 'jig rten bkod pa po'i dkon mchog dang / dge sdig gi 'bras bu 'chol nas smin pa sogs snang mi chog pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin dpyad dgos/ da dung mkhan chen mchog gis/ sgra yangs 'jug gi ltos bcas smra ba'i bstan don rdul phran nus shugs kyi skor de'ang sangs rgyas chos gzhung du bshad zin/ zhes gsungs 'dug mod sha yi mig gi spyod yul du ni mi 'dug go /tshad rdul nus rig sems tsam pa'i grub mtha'i cha shas yin pa'ang mi 'thad/ gal te 'thad na tshad rdul nus rig nor 'khrul gyi lta tshul du khas len dgos te/ sems tsam pa'i 'dod pa de log rtogs yin par dbu ma thal 'gyur bas bshad pa'i phyir/ tha snyad dang don dam gang gi dbang du byas kyang gzugs sems gnyis la yod med kyi dbye ba 'byed mi rung bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyed nam yang phar 'gyur tshur 'gyur dang / rkang pa gnyis 'dzugs kho na gnang bzhin 'dug mod des rigs lam gyi chu mi thub/ sems tsam pas gzugs snang gi rtsab sems kyi thog tu bsgos pa'i bag chags yin par 'dod pa las/ nam mkha'i dbyings su khyab pa'i nus khyams yin par mi 'dod/ khyed kyis rdul phran gzhi med du gtan la 'bebs skabs snam bu bshig — 135 —
na snal ma/ dang / t+na /la ma bshig na spu nyag dang / spu nyag bzhig na thal rdul dang /thal rdul de dag kyang tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas bshib] na mthar gzhi med du ('gyur/de yi tshe na thams cad gar song cha med nam mkha' la sprin dwangs pa ltar 'gyur/zhes dang / bem po'i sdod lugs la gnas skabs gsum yod pa las/ gsum pa'i skabs su rdul gyi rang bzhin cung zad kyang med par rdul phran 'byung rung tsam dang / 'byung rung de'ang rtsad bcad na sems kyi bag chags la thug pas bag chags zad na gtan med du 'gyur/ zhes stabs bde mdog kha po zhig gsungs 'dug kyang / thugs ce'igatad sa yag po zhig yod med blo dogs che ste/ gzhi med du ma gyur tsam gyi rdul tha ma de gzugs kyi chung mtha' yin na de la snam bu bzhig pa'i tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas ji ltar bshig rgyu yod/ chung mtha' min na de nyid snam bu bshig pa'i tshul de ltar bshig kyang gzhi med du ci la 'gro/ de bas chung ba'i gzugs shig yod dgos pas ma mtha' yang dum bu gnyis su bzhig bzod los dgos/ 'dis khyed tsam du ma zad gcig du bral gyi dbu ma'i rigs pa de'i dbu la yang thog phab pa yin/ che chung kho na'i cha nas cha shas yod med drubrtag dpyad gtonge ba de 'khrul yod zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yang 'di yin/ rdul phran gyi rtsab 'byung rung dang / 'byung rung gi rtsab bag chags dang / bag chags kyi rtsab sems nyid la thug pa bden na/ sems gtso smra ba'i grub mtha' de ma 'dod na yang pang du len dgos rgyu red snyam/ de ltar rigs pas brtags shing —136—
dpyad na rang byung tshan rig gi zhib 'jug bya yul rtsis dngos rdzas gsum 4/nga la yang sangs rgyas chos gzhung khrod du mi rnams ha las 'ong ba dang / nyon 'thor dgos pa dang / ya mtshan 'os pa dang / yid 'phrog 'gro ba'i legs bshad ci yang mthong rgyu mi 'dug yod/ med bzhin yod mdog sto na pa la dgos pa gzhan zhig yod pa yin na ni/ da res kho bos rdzun rkub gtol nyes shor song bas dgongs dag zhu'o// chos gzhung gi sems dang sems byung gi rnam gzhag dag la ni/ lha sgang dang rtog bzo cher ma 'dres shing tshod dpag dang rigs skam tsam yang min par dus rabs rim byon gyi rnal 'byor pa tshos/ kha nang du phyogs nas tshod lta gnang ba'i nyams myong dngos ma shas che bas/ phyis kyi sems khams rig pa'i gzhung lugs dag la yang ngo gnongs mi dgos pa zhig yod/ 'on kyang de la mngon gsal dod pa'i zhan cha gcig rang mthong rgyu yod pa ni/ rnam gzhag mang po zhig ngo po'i cha nas min par dge sdig gi cha nas byas 'dug pa 'di red/'dzin stangs dang rigs rgyun gcig nyid la/ shes rab dang 'chal ba'i shes rab/brtson 'grus dang le lo/ dad pa dang log lta/ byams brtse dang zhen chags/ nges 'gyung dang zhe sdang sogs kyi dbye ba phyes yod pa lta bu red/ rnam gzhag de dag dge sgrub sdig spang gi nyams len gnang mkhon tsho la rin thang che ba tsam ma gtogs/ sems khams chos nyid la zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la ni de tsam phan mi thogs/ gang ltar tshan rig pa ni sems khams zhib 'jug la gom pa slo ma — 137—
thag pa lta bu dang / sangs rgyas chos rig ni sems khams zhib 'jug gi gzhung lugs dang / chos lugs nyams bzhes ni sems nyid 'dul sbyong gi rnal 'byor sha stag yin pas de'i cha nas sangs rgyas chos gzhung la legs bshad dang / slob sbyong byed dgos sa gang 'tsham re yod par smra na de ni 'gro ba sems can tsho'i rna la 'gro ba'i gtam yin no// de yan chad kyis sangs rgyas chos gzhung nas bshad pa'i gzhi kun rdzob snang ba'i rnam gzhag la dpyad zin cing / dpyad pa'i tshul yang rgyal ba'i dbang po'i bka' gsung las/ sangs rgyas chos lugs la dbye na/ sa ngas rgyas chos kyi tshan rig dang / tra/ngas rgyas chos kyi lta grub/ sangs rgyas chos kyi nyams len bcas sde tshan gsu ma du dbyer yod/ ces phebs pa ltar na gong bshad de deg ni sde tshan dang po ste/ chos rig dang tshan rig gnyi sa ku'i thun mong gi zhib 'jug bya yul du 'jog dgos par 'dug pas nub dar mtshan nyid rig pa dang / phyis dar tshan rig gi rig tshan so so'i zhib 'jug gi bsdoms tshig sna tshogs dang 'grig min gyi cha nas gtso bor dpyad yod/ de yang deng sang bod nang du chos rig dang tshan rig gnyis ka la spyan ma longs tsam a+thi+-i mkhas pa ni/ khams bla rung mkhan chen tshul khrims blo gros mchog dang / a mdo rme ba sprul sku bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ dbus 'bri gung mkhas dbang dkon mchog rgya mtsho gsum las gzhan su yang mjal rgyu mi 'dug cing / mchog sprul bstan rgyam lags kyi gsung rtsom nye char lag son ma byung bas/ mkhas dbang gzhan rnam —138—
gnyis kyi bka' rtsom kha cig dpyad gzhir bzung ste nor 'khrul gyi rigs la yo bsra nga gi tshul du cung zad tsam zhig zhus pa yin/ 'di'i man chad chos lugs kyi thun mong min pa'i rnam gzhag gtso che bas tshan rig sogs dang dpyad bsdur bya rgyu cher med stabs/ nga tsho'i sngon chad kyi rtags la brten pa'i rtsod rigs kyi 'gro phyogs de rang gi thog nas dpyad pa bya rgyu las ma 'das so zhes gsal bshad dang 'brel/ skabs su bab pa don dam stong nyid kyi rnam gzhag la dpyad par bya ste/ de yang rgyal ba'i gsung rab yongs kyi mthar tshug gi 'bab so dang / nang nga/'i grub mtha' bzhi char gyi bla srog gam gzhung shing lta bu ni don dam stong nyid kyi rnam gzhag 'di yin la/ gal srid stong nyid kyi lta ba'i skor 'dir rig pa'i gzhung lugs/ kyi thog nas khungs skyel yag po zhig byed thub pa yin tshe/ sngar bshad kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag kha cig la nor 'khrul 'ga' re yod na yang gnad 'gag de tsam med mod/ dad pa dang dag snang gi lhad ma zhugs pa'i gzu bo'i blos brtags shing dpyad na/ rnam gzhag 'di dag la yang blo rtsegatad sa yag po zhig yod pa'i bzo mi 'dug gang zag gi bdag med kyi ming tsam zhig sangs rgyas pa spyi la ma bgos thun mong du yod kyang don mdzub mo 'dzugs sa 'di'o zhes pa'i rtsod med yongs grags shig rgya bod gang du'ang byung myong med/rgya gar la cha/tshon na/ bdag phung de nyid dang gzhan nyid brjod du med par 'dod mkhan/ phung po bdag tu 'dod masprun/ de la yang phung po lnga char bdag —139—
tu 'dod mkhan/ sems gcig pu bdag tu 'dod mkhan/ཿ de la yang yid shes bdag tu 'dod mkhan/ kun gzhi bangag tu 'dod malan/ gzhan yang bdag rtag par 'dod mkhan sogs grub mtha' khyu zhis byung yod la/ de kun kyang 'di nyid kho na bden gyi gzhan ni gti mug go zer mkhan sha stag yin/ bod gangs can pa'i mkhas grub rim byon tshang ma kha dbu ma sna dbu ma gsung bzhin bzhugs yod na'ang / dbu ma'i lugs kyi gang zag gi bdag med ngos 'dzin bya tshul ni yod tshad kha kha so so red/ de yang 'dod tshul chung tshags khag bzhag nas gnad 'gag che sa nas gleng na/ bong snga rabs pa dang phyi rabs pa'i 'dod pa gnyis las/ thang sag pa'i rjes 'brang bod snga ma rnams kyis ni/ nga ra 'dzin gyi yul du gyur pa'i nga'6khu bdag de ma brtags 'khrul ngo'i snang ba 'ba' zhig las /rigs pas brtags na 'di zhes ngos bzung med pa de gang zag gi bdag med kyi don yin/ nga'o bdas/ go snyam du 'dzin pa de gang zag gi bdag 'dzin gyi don yin/ nga dang bdag ces bya ba de 'khrul snang tsam las don la med do snyam du yid la byed pa de gang zag gi bdag med bsgom pa'i don yin/ nga bdag gi 'dzin pa rtsad nas rgyun chad pa de gang zag gi bdag med rtogs nas gang zag gi bdag 'dzin spangs pa'i don yin zer/ a mdo dge 'dun chos 'phel lags kyis/ dbu ma'i lugs la khas len med ces smras nas bsdad na 'grig ces gsungs 'dug pa ltar bod snga ma 'di dag gis gal dang 'gag la thug dus — 140—
rto4 se pa'i tshi ga mang gi tshos lusas kyi 'jib rtsem / rigs pa de tsam khas mi len par u tshugs lta bu zhig gnang nas bzhugs srol yod pa yin 'dug rje btsun tsong kha pas kyang gzhan gyi lta grub gang la yang skyon 'dogs kho na byed cing / gzhan pas tshun la gnod byed ston dus skyo na spo/nga gcig kyang mi byed par kho bo cag la grub mtha' med ces g.yol thabs byed nga/ 'di nī ha cang thabs rdug gi las ka red/ ces bka' bkyon ya nga nas yang du gnang yod / gal srid rigs pa'i 'gro stangs khas len mkhan zhig yin tshe/ gang zag bdag med ngos 'dzin de 'dra zhig bya srol ga la yod/ bdapo/ dang gang zag yod med brtag dpyad gtong dus rnyed rgyu med tshe yang na gtan nas med pa'i rtags dang / yang na 'tshol ma shes pa'i rtags red/ de lta min na gzhi gang du yo da pa dang / tshul ji ltar yod pa btsal na ci la mi rnyed/ nga'o bdag go snyam pa'i bsam blo de 'khrul pa dang bdag 'dzin yin na/ nga me da bangs med snyam pa'i bsam blo de tshad ma dang bdag med sgom pa'i blo yin dgos/ de ltar na nga dang bdag med dgos shing / de la 'dod zer na nga med zer mkhan khyod rang su yin smra dgos so// dpal ldan sa skya'i mkhas pa chen po g.yag pas kyang nga'o snyam pa'i blo de ngar 'dzin yin pa'i zhal bzhes la brten nas rje 'jigs bral zhabs la rtsod pa shor bar grags te khong la thugs khag med do// nga'o snyam pa'i blo de ngar 'dzin dang / sems can no snyam pa'i blo de bdagaji'adzin yin na/ ngar 'dzin zad pa'i 'phags pa tshos mi ngo rang ngo mi phyed par thal ba sogs thog — 141 —
ltar tsha ba'i nyes skyon mang po zhig gzhan gyis bgrang yod la/ de dag la snga rabs/ pa'i mkhas pa sus kyange skyon spong shes med/ ma shes pa de'ang khong rnam tsho shes rgya chung ba'i dbang gis pho ma byas nga1 min par gnad la khel ba'i dbang gis bya thabs zad pa yin no// dbu ma phyi rabs pa ste ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan 'dzin rnam pas/ bod lnga rabs pa'i rnam gzhag yod tshad phyir mi ldog par tshar bcad rjes rang lugs 'di ltar bzhag yod de/ spyir nga'o snyam pa'i blo tsam ni sangs rgyas 'phags pa la yang yod patraṭa de ni ngar 'dzin dang spang bya min/ 'on kyang nga'o snyam pa'i bsam blo thugs drag po de 'dra skyes pa yin na da gzod ngar 'dzin tshang spang byar 'gyur 'grob yin/ dper na rkun po zhig la khyod rkun ma red/ ces/ brdzod na nga rkun ma yin snyam pa'i bsam blo zhig skye nges shing / de'i ska bas kyi nga'osnyaca/ pa'i blo de tshad ma dang yul de tshad grub yin/ rkun ma min pa'i mi cig la khyod rkun ma red/ ces brjod na nga rkun ma min snyam pa'i bsam blo zheg skye nges shing / de'i skabs kyi nga'o snyam pa'i blo de 'khrul pa dang yul de gtan mengo yin/ 'o na de 'dra'i nga'o snyam pa'i blo snga phyi gnyis por 'dzin lta ngas mi 'dra pa ce zhig yod ce na/ nga'o snyam pa'i blo snga ma de dang mi 'dra bar phyi ma de bam hris/ hris cig dang / de'i yul gyi nga de'ang 'brang theng theng zhig yod/ de 'dra'i khyad par de mi phal pa tshos ngos zin dka' yang kha nang la bskor na nyam/4/ rmyang yi/ thog nas go rgyu zhig yod/ mdor myo/ ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyi —141—
dmigs yul gyi nga tsam ni 'ching 'grol gyi gzhi yin pas mtha' gcig tu 'jos dgos shing / 'dzin stangs kyi yul de ni nga bden grub yin pas mtha' gcig tu dgag dgos zhes dang/ de 'dra'i rnam gzhag zhib cha can de klu sprub yab sras sogs kyi gzhung chen khrag tu gsal por med kyang / bla ma ngabu ma pes khrid 'ong ba'i mdo khams kyi 'jam dbyangs de la brten na sa rje btsun tsong kha pas gsar du rnyed pa yin zhes sogs kyang smras skad 'dug go /sgra mi rtag go snyam pa lta bu khyad gzhi dang khyad chos sbyar te 'dzin pa'i blo la dmisas yul dang 'dzin stangs kyi yul gnyis su dbyer rung gi /nga'o snyam pa'i blo zhig la yul mi 'dra ba gnyis btsan shed byas kyang phyer mi btub/ lta grub kyi khungs shing rta chen po'i gzhung lugs la ma thug par yi dam 'khyam po'i man ngag la gtugs pa 'dis rtags dang rten 'brel yod tshad 'khyug nas song ba red/ sgrub byed dngos stobs kyi rigs pa ma rnyed par sems 'dzin gyi nyams myo nga la zhal 'phen rdza/]nang dgos byung ba yang sdug rtags ma rnagatogs yag rtags shig ga la yim/ 'di dag kho bo mi sger gyi bsam 'char tsam yin/ gzhan bdag dang bdag 'dzin 'tshol stangs dang rnyed stangs khyad mtshar can de tsho la/ yar langs med nga/'i dgag pa zhig dbu ma klu sgrub dgongs rgyan du bris 'dug pa des chog par 'dug pas de nyid 'dir bkod na/ gal te nam rgyun gyi nga'o snyam pa'i blo 'di tshad ma yin na/khyod rkun ma yin no zhes brjod tshe nga'o snyam pa'i blo skyes pa de'ang tshad ma shugs — 143 —
che ru song ba tsam yin gyi bden 'dzin du 'gro don ga la yod/ gal te de bden 'a tshin yin na/ mi zhig gis sangs rgyas ni skyabs gnas ma yin zhes brjod tshe/skyabs gnas ga la min snyam pa'i blo skyes pa de'ang bden 'dzin ci'i phyir min/de bzhin 'di bum pa min zhes brjod tshe/ bum pa min na gzhan ci zhig yin/bum pa yin par thag chod snyam pa'i blo de yang bum pa'i bden 'dzin yin gyi tshad ma ga la yin/ji des na khong cag gi lugs ltar na blo shugs chung ba rnams tshad ma dang / blo de ga rang shugs che ru song tshe rlung log pa bzhin bden 'dzin du 'gro bar 'dug pas ya mtshan/ zhes so// 'di yar langs med pa'i dgag pa yi nagamin chuklu sprub dgongs rgyan gyi dgag yig mi 'jigs seng ge'i nga ro nas bzung ste/ deng sa nga gi log smra'i tshang tshing sreg pa'i lung rigs rdo rje'i me char gyi bar du 'ibatu klog dang ha go bar 'gyur ro// mdor na bdag dang gang zag sogs yo da pa myong ba mngon sum yin pas/ sangs rgyas pa tshos bdag dang gang zag yo/da med dam/ ya nga na bden grub tu yod med dpyod khul byed pa ni don me da nga/'i bya spyod yin la/ yod tshul ji ltar yin pa'i skor la gna' nas bzung ste mtshan nyid rig pa pa tshos dpyad pa byas yod cing / rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi ngos ma sa bshad na de nyid gal 'gangs che ba'i bya gzhag cig yin shas che yang /yod tshul 'di 'dra yin zhes da bar sus kyang gatrasgal por ma shod par snang ngo //gna' po'i rgya gar gyi bram ze'i chos lugs sogs mu stegs pa'i grub mtha' tshang — 144—
mas gang zag gi bdag tu smra ba na/ ston pa shākya thub pas de dag gi kha gtad du langs te gang zag gi bdag med smra ba'i chos lugs gsar pa 'di srol gtod pa yin pas/ lta ba'i thad nas gang zag gi bdag med 'di sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi snying lta bu yin/ ska bas de dag tu chos kyi bdag med kyi skor la skad cha ci yang med mod/ phyis su mkhas pa mang pos gang zag bden med du sgrub byed kyi rigs pa de dag dngos po gzhan dag la yang kha spo rgyu yod par ha go nas/ rnam rig pa dang ngo bo nyid med par smra ba zhes pa'i grub mtha' gsar pa gnyis btsugs te chos kyi bdag med kyi rnam gzhag rgyas par gtan la phab pa red/dbu sems gnyis kyi gzhung lugs phal mo che bod du 'gyur zhing / bstan pa snga dar gyi skabs nas bzung ste da lta'i bar gyi mi lo chig stong lhag gi ring la 'chad nyan sgom sgrub kyi 'phrin las kyang rgyun chad myong med/ 'on kyang gzhung chen de dag la 'grel bshad bskyon skabs bshad stangs rtsa ba nas mi 'dra ba gnyis byung yo/da/ bod kyi dbu ma pa snga ma tshos zer na/ snang zhing srid pa'i shes bya yongs rdzogs bdag 'dzin ma rig pa'i dbang gis byung ba'i 'khrul snang sha stag yin pa dang / brtags shing dpyad na chu shing la snying po 'tshol ba ltar dpyad bzod du grub pa rdul phran tsam yang med/ de yang rags pa'i dngos po rnams bcom zhing bsal na thal ba rdul du 'gyur 'gro la/ rdul phran zhes pa'i dngos po chung mtha' zhig kyang yod mi srid de/ bye mdos 'dod pa'i phra rdul de la shar bstan gyi cha — 145—
dang / nub bstan gyi cha gnyis su phye rgyu yod na ni chung mtha' ma yin dgos la/med na ni rang rang gi go sa non mi shes pas rdul phran gyi khyad chos brlags tshar ba red/ des na sa rdo ri brag sogs ma brtags ma dpyad na yod yod bden bden lta bu 'di dag kyang rigs pas dpyad na 'ja' la reg pa bzhin yal (8gro bas mi bden 'khrul snang du shes dgos/ nang gī sems la dpyad na yang de dang 'dra ste/ dga' yug chags sdang sogs rgyun ldan gyi shes pa 'di dag la zhib tu dpyad na dus shin tu thung ngu re'i nang du skye 'gag byed pa ma gtogs skad cig tsam la yang mi sdod pas/ dus snga phyi so so na yod pa'i shes pa gnyis po gcig tu snang ba 'di mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar 'khrul pa yin par ra 'phrod thub/ shes pa gcig la snga phyi cha shas so sor phye rgyu med pa zhig yod mi srid de/gal srid yod na de 'dra'i shes pa skad cig ma gsum rgyun chags su 'byung ba'i tshe/ shes pa skad cig dang ngo dang / gnyis pa gnyis dus gzhan gyis bar du chod na rgyun chags kyi don med/ bar du ma tshod na 'phrad dgos/ 'phrad na dus mnyam yin dgos pas skad cig gnyis mthud kyang gcig gi yun las mi longs par 'gyur ro// da dung skad cig gnyis pa der skad cig dang po la 'phrad pa'i cha gcig dang / gasgam pa la 'phrad pa'i cha gcig ste snga phyi'i cha shas gnyis su phye rgyu yod na snga phyi'i cha med nyams shing / phye rgyu med na dang po la 'phrad pa'i cha de phyi ma la 'phrad pa'i cha yang yin dgos pas skad cig dang po dang gsum pa —146—
gnyis kyang 'phrad par 'gyur/ zhes sogs rno la skyen pa'i rigs pa mang po brjod yo da/ de ltar brtasas dpyad byas na dpyad bzod kyi chos sna gcig med pas snang ba yod tshad gzhi med kyi 'khrul snang rkyang rkyang du khas len pa yin zer/deng sang kun gyi kha na rgyu ba'i tha snyad tshad mas ma grub zer ba de'i don 'di red/ 'o na sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi tshos nyid de don dam bden pa yang med dam zhes dris pa na/ med ces smra ma nus shing yod ces kyang zer ma shes pas de dag yod pa'ang ma yin med pa'ang ma yin zer/ yod med gnyis phung gsum khegs pa'i dngos 'gal min nam zhes dris pa na/༷ nga tsho'i blo ngor dngos 'gal yin kyang don la de ltar yin par ma nges zer/ yod med gang yang min pa'i gnas lugs de shes rgyu yod dam med ces dris pa na/ de ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas yin pas shes rgyu yod pa'ang khas mi len/ shes rgyu med pa'ang khas mi len zer/ deng sang yongs grags kyi khas len med pa'i grub mtha' zer ba de 'di red/ tha snyad tshad mas ma grub pa'i dam bca' dang / khas len med pa'i grub mtha' 'di gnyis la zhib tu bsam na dngos gnas dgod shor 'ong bar 'dug tha snyad tshad mas ma grub na tha snyad pa'i chos kyi bye brag kho'i blo de'ang tshad mas ma grub dgos pas des tha snyad tshad mas ma grub pa ji ltar shes pa yin nam/ snang ba yod tshad gtad so med pa'i 'khrul snang yin na/ yod tshad 'khrul snang du thag gcod byed pa'i blo de yang 'khrul blo yin dgos pas des — 147—
thag gang bcad la'ang gtad so ci zhig yod/ khos yod tshad 'khrul snang du thag bcad pa'i zhor la khos bshad tshad thams cad kyang 'khrul bshad gza' bshad rkyang rkyang yin par thag bcad pa yin pas rang gis rang la de sdug med pa'i mtshang 'bru khyad gsod byas pa yin no// sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang dkon mchog de'i chos nyid gnyis go rig thos gsum gang yang mi 'dug na med ces lab bzhag na los chog yod pa'ang ma yin med pa'ang ma yin zer ci dgos/sangs rgyas med na gdul bya sus 'dul/ chos 'khor sus bskor snyam nas zhed 3snang langs pa yin na/ gdul bya 'dul ba dang /chos 'khor bskor ba de tsho 'khrul snang red ces khyod kyis bshad zin pa min nam/ 'khrul snang la ni byed po mi dgos te/ dper na mig btsir ba'i skabs kyi zla gnyis bzhin no// khas len med na kha rog 'dug mi bzhag par rtsod pa'i grwa ru ci la sleb yong ba yin sus shes/rigs pa la g.yol ba'i ched du ma dpyad/ cung zad dpyad pa/ shin tu dpyad pa'i rnam gzhag gsum mam/ tha snyad gzhir bzhag dang / don dam gzhir bzhag gi gnas skabs gnyis su dbye ba sogs par pur mang po zhig byas yod mod/ yod tshad rang mgo rang g.yog gi las ka yin/ gnas skabs zhes pa dus tshod ston pa'i tshig yin gyi phra rags ston pa'i tshig min pa 'di nyid kho nas de tsho'i de nyid lhang la phud tshar/ dngos po gcig nyid thog mar yod par rtogs pa'i tshad ma skye/ bar du med par rtogs pa'i tshad ma skye/ mthar yod med gang yang min — 148—
par rtogs pa'i tshad ma skye chog na 'jig rten 'dir mi chog pa dang mi rung ba ci yang mi srid/ khyod rang thog mar mi yin par rtogs pa'i tshad ma dang / bar du khyi yin par rtogs pa'i tshad ma dang / tha mar 'dre yin par rtogs pa'i tshad ma kho bo'i rgyud la skye byung zhes smra bar 'dod do// rang rgyud grub mthas bslad ches pas rang skyon mthong mi thub pa ma gtogs snga rabs pa'i grub mtha' 'di las nor tshabs che ba zhig phal cher mi srid pa'i tshod yin/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi chos rje legs chos pas/ yid la sgom tshe ci yang mi 'char zhing // ngag gi lam nas gang yang mi smra bar// lus kyi rnam 'gyur kho nas 'dzin dgos pa'i// grub mtha' 'di ni khyod kyi bgo skal yin// zhes snga rabs pa'i yod min med min gyi lta ba dang / khas len med pa'i rtsod pa la shags 'debs gnang ba 'di ci 'dra'i gnad la khel ba zhig red ang /dz+re btsun tsong kha pa yab sras kyis/ bod snga rabs pa'i grub mtha' des chu mi thub par gzigs nas rang lugs gsar pa zhig bzos yod pa ni 'di ltar/chos kyi bdag med ces gsungs pa de bum pa ka ba sogs gtan nas med gsungs pa ma red/ de tsho bden grub kyis med gsungs pa red/ yod pa dang bden grub kyis yod pa gnyis dang / med pa dang bden grub kyis med pa bcas la khyad par ha cang chen po yod/ 'on kyang khyad par 'di ngos zin mkhan rdze tsong kha pa khong tsam ma gtogs gzhan bod pa nyung nyung yin/ rags pa'i rtsom —149—
gzhir gyur pa'i rdul phran de bye mdo gnyis kyis bshad pa ltar phyogs kyi cha med min par cha bcas yin/ shes pa skad cig dang po dang gnyis pa'i bar du dus gzhan gyis bar du ma chod kyang de gnyis 'phrad mi dgos/ gzhi gang la sbyar yang yod pa ma yin na med dgos shing / med pa ma yin na yod dgos/ dgag pa gnyis kyis rnal rma go ba 'di rigs pa smra ba spyi'i lugs yin/ yod pa'ang ma yin/med pa'ang ma yin/ gnyis ku'ang ma yin/ gnyis ka ma yin pa'ang ma yin/ zhes smra ba ni kha na rogs dang / de ltar bsgom pa ni snying langs rogs las don snying dang grub 'bras lpu tsam med/ gzhan lugs rigs pas tshar bcad rjes rang lugs rigs pas bsgrub shes dgos kyi/ nga la khas len med ces brjod de lag stong mchan la bcug nas sra tho ser 'chi rgyur sgug bsdad na mi 'grig ces sogs skad cha gsar pa mang po ngar ngar jig rdzig dang bcas bshad 'dug la/de dag gi khrod nas snga rabs pa la 'phangs pa phal mo che gnad du bsnun yod kyang / rang lugs kyi rtsaba'i grub mtha' de tsho ni yid du 'ong ba zhig gtan nas ma red/ yod pa dang bden grub gnyis la khyad par chen po zhig 'jog khul byas pa 'di nor ba thams cad kyi rtsab yin/ yod kyang mi bden pa'i dngos po zhig btsal kyang rnyed rgyu med/ yod 'dzin las lhag pa'i bden 'dzin zhig 'jig rten su la yang med/ su la yang cha rgyus med pa'i bden tshad de rang bzo yin/ de 'dra'i bden grub de med par rtogs kyang dgos nus smu tsam med de/ des nyon — 150—
mongs skye ba'i sgo cung tsam yang mi khegs pa'i phyir/ malas dbang dge 05chos 'phel gyis/ grogs por mtshan mar zhen pa'i bden 'dzin dang // grokus kyis phan par rtogs pa'i tshad ma gnyis// sred pa bskyed la khyad par ci 4/nga med// dgra bo bden par zhen pa'i dngos 'dzin dang // dgra yis gnod ngo༈ra nges pa'i tshad ma gnyis// zhe sdang bskyed la khyad par ci yang med/ ces gsungs pa 'dis khyed cag gi grub mtha' de'i snying dmar dmar po de khrom bsgrags byas nas bstan mi 'dug gam/ da dung ha ma go na zhe sdang can gyi mi zhig la/ khyod rang dgra bo'i thog tu zhe sdang langs pa yin nam/ yang na bden grub kyi thog tu zhe sdang langs pa yin/ zhes bka' 'dri zhib/ gnongs dang blo skyed yod pa'i lan zhig 'bul rgyu red/ gzugs kyi chung mtha' dang / phyogs kyi cha bcas gnyis yin zhig 'dod pa m+pi rigs pa mi shes pa'i ngan rtags yin/ kho bo la yid ma ches na/slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ drug gis gcig char sbyar ba na/ zhes pa'i tshigs bcad gcig gsungs 'dug pa der thugs bsam bzhes dang go rgyu chen po yod/gal srid rdul phran thug med du zhal gyis bzhes rtsis yin na ni/ dbu ma tshang si pha nor drag shos te gcig du bral gyi rigs pa 'di chu la g.yug dgos/ rgyu mtshan ni rdul phran ji ltar bshig kyang du ma mi 'dor bas du ma mi bden pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad rgyu med song bas red/ shes pa skad cig dang po dang gnyis pa gnyis ma 'phrad na bar ma chad zer ba 'ong mi srid cing / dus kyang thug med du —151—
'dod na gcig du bral gyi rigs pas go mi chod pa snga ma dang mtshungs so//mdor na ri bo dge ldan pa'i mkhas pa dag gis gsungs na/ bod snga ma tsho'i 'dod pa'i tha snyad tshad grub min pa dang / khas len med pa'i lta ba lta bu'i log rtogs rdzab chen de 'dra ni mu stegs rgyang 'phen pa'i rgyud la'ang skye ma myong zhing /gal srid kho tshos lta ba de nyid lag len du btab pa'i dbang du btang na ni/ tshe snga phyi dang las rgyu 'bras sogs kyi rnam gzhag lta ci ste/ so nams zhing las sogs tshe 'di'i 'tsho tshis tsam yang 'grub thabs med pas rigs log de gras ni phyogs grir 'chi ba'i man ngag de'i yan med pa zhig red 'dug ces dgag pa brgyab yod/ de bzhin bod snga rabs pa'i mkhas pa rnam pas kyang / dge ldan pa tshos tshad ma'i lugs la yan lag las logs su yan lag can gyi rdzas khas blangs pa 'dis gang zag gi bdag med gtan la 'bebs byed kyi rigs pa yod tshad chu la bskyur ba red/ dbu ma'i lugs la snang ba zur du bzhag nas bden grub logs su 'tshol khul byas pa des chos kyi bdag med gtan la 'bebs byed kyi rigs pa yod tshad rlung la bskur ba red/ lugs 'dis dgag bya 'tshol stangs dang gnyen po bsten stangs de tsho ni dgra bo bskyur te grib ma la 'thab 'dzing byed pa yin pas bskal pa brgya yi bar du 'bad brtson byas kyang grub 'bras cung zad tsam yang yod mi srid/ ces sogs skyon 'dogs rkyang byed de/ lta ba'i skor la thug dus bod snga phyi gnyis po khyi dang ra 'grogs pa nang bzhin chags —157—
bsdad yod/ deng sang kha cig gis/ sngon byon mkhas grub rnam pa'i bar la tshig gi 'dzin mtshams mi 'dra ba phran bu yod pa ma gtogs phugs kyi dgongs/ pa gcig yin/ tshig gi 'dzin mtshams mi 'dra ba de ni grub mtha' phan tshun byi dor dang /rgyal ba'i bstan pa la dag ther gnang ba'i dgos ched rmad du byung ba yod/ ces sogs jo bzang gi gsung bzang 'ba' zhig phab kyin 'dug 'di dag chos kyi gnas lugs ci yang mi shes pa'i mi nag tsho'i chags sdang gi sgo 'gog pa'i ched du gsungs pa'i dgongs pa can gyi gsung 'dra yin na ni der zad/ de lta min na gasnyang de dag la snying po med de/ grub mtha' gcig gis gcig la nyes med nyes 'dogs dang / nag med nag 'dzugs byas pas phan tshun byi dor byas par mi 'gro zhing / rgyal bstan dkar 'jam yug gcig tu gnas pas la dum bu gnyis su bgos te 'thab rtsod byas pas bstan pa dag ther du ji ltar 'gyur/ na/dzes mtshon phyi bka' mol gsung mkhan khong rnam tsho'i nang khul du yang don du nang 'grig ci yang byung med/ snga rabs pa'i khrod du sdod pa'i mthun thabs smra ba tshos ni/ rje bdag nyid chen po nyid kyi thugs la ni yod min med min gyi lta ba kho na bzhugs pa yin yang / lta ba de'i skal pa med pa'i gdul bya dman pa dag gi ngor gnas lugs med dgag tu gsungs pa yin zer/ skad cha 'di ngos/ len zhu mkhan gyi dge ldan pa'i mi gcig kyang byung myong med/ dge ldan pa'i khrod kyi mthun thabs smra ba tshos/ snga rabs pa'i skyes chen rnam pas spros bral dang blo — 153—
'das sogs grekhungs pa de tsho zhib cha ma thon pa'i grub thob kyi skad cha tsam red/dgongs pa'i gtad so rang re'i stong rkyang med dgag 'di rang yin zer/ snga rabs pa zhig la mtshon na de ni nam yang khas len thabs bral ba'i skad cha red /des na kho bos yod snga phyi'i dgongs pa 'gal med du 'grel mkhan gyi mi sna de tsho ni kha (5ga ring lugs/ pa dang / 'gan khur med pa'i bya spyod spel mkhan red bzhag ces kha rdung gtong snying 'dod/ 'o na lugs de gnyis las gang zhig ma 'grig pa yin zer na gnyis ka ma 'grig pa yin/ de yang bod kyi mkhas pa rim byon gyi khrod du klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs pa 'tshol mkhan kho na ma gtogs/ klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs pa de 'grig min gyi phyogs su bsam blo gtong phod mkhan mi gcig kyang med pas lan song ba red/ khong rnam pa la yang thugs khrag khyon nas meng de/ klu sgrub yab sras kyi mkhyen dpyod la ha mi las mkhan zhig dang / da bu ma'i rigs pa la ngo mi mtshar mkhan gyi mkhas pa zhig 'jig rten 'dir byung ma myong la/ khong yab sras kyi dgongs pa bzhes stangs der rtsab rang nas ma 'grib pa'i nor 'khrul zhig shor yod snyam pa'i bsam blo su la yang 'khor myong med/ 'on kyang mi'i rigs kyi shes rab rim gyis gong du 'phel nas dus rabs nyi shu par sleb pa na/ da gzod sngon gyi mi rnams kyi blo yul las 'das pa'i blo skyed kha cig rag yod pa red/ sngon chad dus tshod ni phreng thags lta bu dang / skye 'jig can gyi dngos po sna tshogs ni dus tshod der brgyus pa'i phreng —154—
rdog lta bu'i ngos 'dzin yongs khyab kyis byed kyin yod/ gna' bo'i rgya sar gyi slob dpon rnam pas kyang lta tshul de nyid gzhir bzhag gi thog nas dus kyi thung mtha' ma'i shes pa gcig la snga phyi'i cha shas yod med kyi brtag dpyad gnang ba red/ cha shas yod na thung mtha'i don med cing cha med yin na rgyun rtsom mi thub par gzigs nas shes pa skye med du gtan la phab pa red/ gal srid ltos bcas/ tshan rig 'di byung med na dbu ma'i rigs pa 'di la lan 'debs sus kya/ nga nus re bral/ dge ldan pa'i mkhas pa tshos shes spo med zer bzhag na skur 'debs su 'gro bar dgongs te/ shes pa skad cig ma gnyis mthud nas rgyun rtsom skabs bar stong med cing thug 'phrad kyang med pa 'di klu sprub yab sras kyi dgongs pa yin gsungs kyang / bar stong dang thug reg gnyis ka med pa zhig//ji yong thabs rtsab nas med/ ltos bcas smra bas dngos po so so'i 'gul skyod las logs su dus tshod rang rkya bar med/ ces bshad pa 'dis gzhi nas shes pa gcig la snga phyi'i cha shas yod med brtag pa ni don med skor lo ga si bas ma blo yin par ra 'phrod pa red/ de bzhin yab sras kyis bem po la dpyod pa'i skabs su/ rags pa bshig na rdul du 'jig 'gro la/ rtsom ba/zhi'i phra rdu la de'ang phyogs kyi ga dang bcas pa yin na chung mtha'i don med cing cha med yi na na rags pa rtsom mi nus par dgongs te rdul phran skye med du gtan la phab nga/ red/ 4/la srid tshad rdul nus rig 'di byung med na dbu ma'i rigs pa 'di la lan 'debs — 155—
nus re bral/ dge ldan pas bem po gzhi med du khas blangs na skur 'debs su 'gro bar dgongs te/ rtsom gzhi'i rdul de cha bcas su yod pa klu yi/ dgongs pa yin rgyur byas kyang / steng 'og gi ngos so sor dgar rgyu yod pa'i chung ma tha' zhig ga la srid/ tshad rdul smra bas gzugs med nus khyams kyi klong nas bzugs can gyi gsob rdul thon par bshad pa 'dis da gzod bongs tshad kho na'i cha nas dpyad pa gtong ba de nor 'khrul gyi bsam blo yin par ra 'phrod pa red/1 kho bos ltos bcas tshan rig dang / tshad rdul nus rig gi sgra tsam thos ma thag gsar zhen g.yam rgyug byas te/ dbu ma'i rigs pa la khyad gsod byas pa zhig gtan nas min/ nga tshos gzhung chen khag tu rnam gzhag gang la yang dgag n+d+ra ba spang gsum gyi spros pa gra rgyas po zhe drag mdzad yod kyang / gang mtsham zhig la sleb dus dad pa dag snang 'dra sbyangs te sdod rgyu ma gtogs mtha' 'gro ba zhig rtsab nas byung mi 'dug la/ las ma dag pa'i kho bo la ni dag t+na nga ma skyes pa'i gong nas sun snang zhig skyes par gyur cing / ji ltar byas kyang mi bde bar lus pa'i skabs su rigs gsar gyi rnam gzhag 'di dag srog chad ka ma'i mi la sman bzhin du gnad la 'phrod par byung bas da gzod yid ches pa'i gnas su bzung ba lags so//gsum/ tshad ma'i lugs kyi mtho ris dang thar pa'i — 156—
rnam gzhag la dpyud pa/mkhas grub dge legs dpa/la bzang sogs mkhas pa kha cig gis/ mdo lung za zur re drangs nas tshad ma rig pa'i khungs sangs rgyas kyi gsung la gtug ci thug ma dzad yod kyang / gsung rab gang du yang tshad ma dang tshad min gyi rnam gzhag dang / rtags yang dag dang ltar snang gi rnam dbye gsal por ma gsungs shing / mtshan gzhi tsam ni 'jig rten 'tsho ba'i khrod du'ang yod pas khungs su mi 'gro/ des na rig bzhung 'di thog mar mu stegs rig pa can pa'i khrod du rang rdu thub cing / phyis su sangs rgyas pa'i mkhas pa tshos rang lugs zur du phyes par grags pa nyid don la gnas so snyam/ ngo bo shes pa yul la ji ltar 'jug pa'i tshul gtan la 'bebs pa yin pas/ rig gzhung rang ngos nas bshad na chos dang 'jig rten/ phyi pa dang nang pa sogs kyi dbye ba 'byed rgyu med/ 'on kyang slob dpon phyogs glang gi mdo yi mchod brjod la rnam 'grel mkhan pos tshan pa logs su bzos te rgyas bshad gnang ba de nas bzung / sangs rgyas pa'i lugs kyi tshad ma rig pa'i kha phyogs kyang 'khor 'das gnyis kyi phyogs su bsgyur te don dngos kyi brjod bya blo rtags gnyis ni de'i lag cha tsam du gyur pa red/skabs 'di'i dpyad bya yang tshad ma rig pa dngos de min par tshad ma grub pa'i le'u de'i nang don te chos lugs dang thad par 'brel ba'i gnad don kha cig yin/ de la thog mar dpyad 'os pa ni skye srid kye sko ra 'di yin te/ skye ba snga phyi — 151 —
yod pa tsam gyis chos lugs pa la rgyal kha thob pa ma yin kyang / gal srid med pa'i dbang du btang na ni 'jig rten steng gi chos lugs phal mo che gzhi rtsa'i cha nas tshar song ba red/ gna' bo'i rgya gar du skye ba snga phyi khas mi len pa'i grub mtha' zhig byung myong yod pa de'i ming 'dogs la rgyang 'phen pa zer/ grub mtha' de thog mar drang srong phur bus dmag 'khrug gi ched du lha yul du srol gtod cing / de rjes drang srong 'jig mig gis 'dod sred kyi ched du mi yul du dar spel btang ba red ces shod srol 'dug lha rnams kyis rang nyid gang nas shi 'phos te 'dir skyes pa dang / 'di nas shi 'phos te gang du skye bar 'gyur ba dang / de dag gi rgyu dang rkyen ci zhig yin pa bcas gsal gsal thing thing mthong bar bshad yod pas der drang srong phur bu'i chad lta'i grub mthas kha lo ji ltar bsgyur thub bam/ drang srong 'jig mig dang kho'i bu mo'i bar gyi 'brel ba de ya rabs bzang spyod kyi thad nas stangs 'dzin byas yod pa las/ skye srid dang rnam smin khas len min la rag las med/ 'di tsam la yang rtog dpyod med par rang snang gang shar gyis thog ma nyid nas dma' 'bebs dang khyad du gsod rkyang byed pa ni rang nyid drang po min zhes gsal ston byas pa kho na'o// tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ rgyu 'bras dang rjes dpag khas mi len zhing / lus cha med dang dbugs rtag par 'dod pa sogs med smra'i lta grub chag ro 'ga' zhig ched du bsal te/ der dgag sgrub rgyas shing rgyas pa zhig gnang 'dug pa skabs —158—
de'i phyogs snga de tshor phran bu re song yod shas che/ spyir ni rigs pa phal mo che cing hrul gnad ma zin pa 'ba' zhig las bsgrub bya la nges shes 'dren pa dag lta ci ste/ da res tog tsam 'dra chags po zhig gsungs song snyam pa'i don 'gyur gyi the tshom skyed nus shig kyang phal cher med pa'i tshod red/dper na/ lus las sems skye na lus yongs rdzogs las skye'am/ cha shas re re las skye/ yongs dzogs las skye na mdzub mo chad pa'i mi la sems mi skye bar thal/ cha shas re re las skye na rdul gyi grangs bzhin du sems kyang mang du skye bar thal/ zhes pa lta bu bsam gzhig gnad la ye nas ma 'byor ba dang /lus sems gnyis la rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel pa grub na lus ci tsam rgyags pa na sems kyang de tsam du gsal zhing rgyas par thal/ zhes pa lta bu rigs lam stabs bde thag chod pa dang / lus sems kyi nyer len nam/ yang na lus sems bdag nyid gcig yin na shi ba'i ro la yang sems gnas dgos par thal/zhes pa lta bu don med kha khral 'jal ba tsam dang / lus sems gnyis po yon tan dang yon tan can yin na sems kyi yon tan lus thog nas mthong thub par thal/ zhes pa lta bu khyab 'brel nges pa med pa dang / rgyu tshogs grangs tshang gi tshul du 'brel na dug gis shi ba'i ro la dug sel byas tshe gsal rig slar yang skye 'ong bar thal/ zhes pa lta bu mtha' dpyad yag po ma byas pa ste rigs lam mang shos 'di dang 'di 'dra sha stag red bzhag me ji tsam gyis thugs cher — 159—
'bar na du ba de tsam gyis drag tu 'phyur mi dgos pa bzhin rgyu dang 'bras bu'i 'brel ba grub phyin chad mtha' gcig tu 'phel 'grib rjes su 'gro lcog yod mi dgos/ lus sems bdag nyid gcig yin pa'i dbang du btang rung 'du 'bral med pas ma khyab pa ni ci gas gong dang de'i dmar 'bar ba nang bzhin red/ chang ma 'thung gi bar du myos pa'i nus pa ha mi go ba bzhin yon tan dang yon tan can gyi 'brel ba'ang rnam pa thams cad du gcig gyur du bsda da med/ gson lus sems kyi rgyu tshogs grangs tshang yin srid kyang dbugs dang /drod/ srog bcas yod tshad song zin pa'i ro thog tu bsam blo rang 'jags su log 'ong ba'i nges pa ga la yod/ skye dngos rig pa dang / tshe srog gi skye 'phel la cha rgyus phran bu yod pa'i deng gi tshan rig pa zhig yin na gong gi rigs pa de'i gras la bsam blo gtong rin cung tsam yang med cing / gzhan su zhig gis de dang de 'dra'i bgro gleng 'dra byas na kho tsho'i sems gting nas dgod rgyu yong nges red/ 'brog pa zhig gis thag pa'i sne gcig shel tog la btags/ g+ne gzhan zhig de chu la btugs nas glog 'bar min tshod lta byas skad 'dug pa de dang shin tu 'dra bas dgod rgyu ci la mi 'ong / dbyin ji'i skye dngos rib] pa ba rdar wun gyi skye dngos 'phel 'gyur gyi lta ba 'dis/'jig rten gsar gtod smra ba dang / 'gyur med dngos gtso smra ba'i grub mtha' shul med du btang ba tsam du ma zad/ mthar gtugs nas bshad na — 160—
nga tsho'i kru nga sring ring lugs 'di la yang rtsa 'dzin bya sa yag po zhis med pa'i brda lan gsal por sprad yod/ de yang 'phel 'gyur smra ba 'di la skye dngos rnams kyi ngo bo stabs bde can nas rlog 'dzing can du 'phel ba dang /rigs rgyud chig rkyang can nas sna mang can du 'gyur ba'i rtsa don gnyis yod cing 'phel dang 'gyur zhes pa'i ming tshig de gnyis kyi go don yang de yin/dang po 'dis skye med dngos rdzas kyi grub cha phun sum dze tshogs su phyin tshe skye ldan dngos por 'gyur ba dang / skye ldan dngos po'i grub cha phun sum tshogs su phyin tshe dma' rim gyi tshe srog 'byung ba dang / dma' rim srog chags kyis phyi yul dang 'brel gtugs mthun sbyor byas tshe da gzod mtho rim gyi srog ldan 'gro ba mi'i rigs 'di 'byung bar bshad cing / de dag gi 'phel rim yang byis pa nas rgan po'i bar gyi mi tshe bzhin rgyun chags su brtsi rgyu yod/ gna' bo'i spra mi ni mi dang dud 'gro'i dbye 'byed dka' ba'i mtshams tshigs dang /lus kyi nad 'bu ni srog ldan dang srog med kyi dbye 'byed dka' ba'i mtshams tshigs dang / 'phyo g.yeng gi dngos po ni skye ldan dang skye med kyi dbye 'byed dka' ba'i mtshams tshigs yin/ tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ srog chags tsam dang /srog chags dang / ches srog chags bcas kyi dbye ba 'byed rgyu yod par thal/ zhes gzhan la mi 'dod pa'i tshad du byas nas 'phangs yod kyang 'phel 'gyur smra ba'i lugs 'dir de 'dra'i dbye ba phyes na shin tu 'os shing 'tsham par snang / rtsod — 161 —
spru ba dngos/ btso smra ba tshos/ 'du shes 'i dngos ngo 'i 'jig rten yu na ring 'phel ba'i 'bras bu yin zhos pa dang /ri 'du shes smru sbyi tshogs ngal rtsol gyi grub 'bras yin zhes nga/ dang / 'du shes ni klad chen gyi nus mthu yin zhes pa dang /: 'du shes ni phyi rol yul gyi tshur snang yin zhes pa 'di dag yod tshad kyi khungs dang go ba yang 'phel 'gyur smra ba'i lta ba 'di rang yin/ byis pa dang / gzhon nu/rgan po gsum la rnam dpyod che chung yod kyang rnam shes yod med kyi dbye ba 'byed mi btub pa bzhin/ srog chags dang / rtsishing / sa rdo bcas la rkyen ldan rkyen med kyi tshur snang gi khyad par tsam las bsam gzhig rang rkya ba yod med gcig mtshungs yin/ rtsa don gnyis pa rigs rgyud chig rkyang can nas t+na mang can du 'gyur ba'i don/ dang po nyid nas dkon mchos gam las dbang gis mi dang dud 'gro so/gas rigs mi 'dra ba so sor gtan khel byas bzhag pa zhig min par dus yun ring por phyi rol yul gyi cha rkyen mi 'dra ba dang / nang phan tshun bar gyi 'dres sbyor sna tshogs bcas la brten nas rim gyis rigs rgyud gzhan 'gyur byung bar 'dod pa ste/ 'dis kyang rnam shes dang las dbang la bsnyo na 'byin byas yod mod zhib tu smra bar mi bya'o// skye ba snga phyi yod pa'i sgrub byed 'a / dpal ldan chos grags kyis/ skyes ma thag pa'i byis pa'i rigs pa de rigs 'dra'i rig pa snga ma sngon song yin te/ rig pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes rigs 'dra sngon song gis bsgrubs/ mkhan chen zhi 'tshos/ tshe 'di'i dbang du byas pa'i — 162
rnam shes skang cis dang ngo de rnam shes lnga ma 'i nyer 'bras yi na te/ji rnam shes yin pa'i phyir/ zhes nyer len sngon so nga gis bsgru bas / slob dpon dpa' ngos/ skyes ma tha rga pa'i n+ta ga bi phru gu de soms pa sngon song gi rnam shes rgyud ldan yin te/ khyod la bsla ba mi dgos par nu zho 'thung shes pa'i shes pa lhan skyes su yod pa'i phyir/ zhes goms pa sngon song gis bsgru bas/ legs ldan 'byed kyis/ da lta'i skye srid 'di sngon ma 'i yang srid ku na te/ sngon gyi srid pa dran pa'i gang zag yod pa'i phyir/ zhes myong ba sngon song gis bsgru bas pa bzhi yod pa las/ rigs pa dang po gsum ni khyab 'brel nges pa med pas nus pa ci yang mi 'dug bzhi pa tshe rabs rjes dran gyi risas pa 'di ni rtog pa 'og 'gyu tsam min par mig mthong la ga zin gyi gnas tshul gzhi la bzhus nas bkod pa yin 'dug pas dpyad dgos thing / dus da lta'i bar du dngos gtso smra ba dang / 'phel 'gyur smra ba sus kyang 'grel bshad blo yid tshims pa zhig brgyab thub med mod/ tshan rig gi shes tshad yong 'phel du phyin tshe nam zhig blo yul las 'das pa'i gsang ba zhig rnyed srid pa yin/ mi kha cig gis/ rmi lam gyi nang nas rjes phyogs kyi don dag sngon dpag byed thub kyang rmi lam gyi shes pa de ma 'ongs pa nas yar la bslebs pa zhis yin mi srid pa bzhin/ tshe rabs dran pa'i bsam blo de'ang gcig byas na 'de 'dra'i don das cig yin shas che/ skye ba snga ma'i lus kyi sha mtshan phyi ma'i lus steng du 'phos pa yod pa ltar na/ skye ba snga phyi gnyis kyi bar du brda 'phrin — 163 —
phyir rtog dang glog rlabs lta bu gzhi rgyu phra mo'i 'brel ba zhig yod pa yin yang srid/ spyir btang byas na bas ma gzhig gi lte gnas klad chen ni med du mi rung ba zhig yin na yang / dmigs bsal can gyi mi re gnyis la klad chen med kyang chog pa ltar skye ba snga phyi 'di'ang dmigs bsal gyi mi sna'i dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos 'dra e yin/ de lta min na 'du shes kyi 'phel rim tshad nges can zhig la thon dus/ da gzod rnam shes bem po la sa logs su mu mthud du 'tsho gnas thub pa yin rgyu red/ tshan rig pa'i khrod nas rnam shes yod shas che zer mkhan de tshos kyang don 'di 'dra zhig 'a/ the tshom skyes pa tsam ma gtogs/ nga tsho ltar rnam shes kyi thog ma gtan med du khas lem rtsis rang dag ma red snyam/ mdor na deng sang skye ba snga phyi dran pa dang / sri da pa phyir ldog gi cho ga rnam shes 'khyams pa'i nyams myong / lus sems brje spor gyi mthong snang sogs ngo mtshar che ba'i byung ba 'di dag yod tshad mi bajen rdzun bsgrigs sha stag red ces lag mgo gnam g.yug byas na mi 'grig 95 da lta'i rigs gsar gyis 'grel bshad mi phog pa tsam gyis lam seng mye rgyab lnga phyi min na ci yin zhes rang snang mtho drag rgyu'ang med/ ji srid mthong thag ma chod pa de srid du blo gzu bor gnas pas zhib 'jug byas te bsdad na/ nam zhig bden rdzun phu thag chod dus 'tsher snang med par khas len bya chos/ pa yin no//0mtho ris dang ngan song gi sde logs su yod med gleng zin cing / de dag — 164—
cog rga pa'i mig nang gi chos lugs/ 99jig :myu/ ——ge rgyu las 'bras kyi rnam gzhag la/ srog bcod pa nas bzung ste log nga/ra lta ba'i bar gyi mi dge ba'i las lam bcu po de chen pos dmyal ba dang / 'bring gis yi dwags/ chung ngus dud 'gro'i skye gnas su ltung ba dang / de gas ldog ste gzhan gyi srog bskyabs pa sogs dge ba bcu la brten nas bde 'gro lha mi'i lus su skye nges zhes mngon pa'i gzhung nas bshad yod/ de 'dra'i 'thob bya dang thob byed kye 'brel ba de dngos stobs kyi rigs pas mi 'grub pa'i phyir na yid ches pa'i pyang la brten dgos shing / lung gang zhig yid ches pa'i gnas su 'dzin 'os smon ni dpyad gsum gyis dag dang ma dag la 'jog dgos zhes tshad gzhung du bshad 'dug dpyad gsum gyis dag pa'i tshul la mkhas pa so so'i 'dod tshul shin tu mang zhing / mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang sogs mkhas pa kha cig ges/ dpe cha re re'i nang du 'grel bshad mi 'dra ba re re bskyon bzhin 'dug pa la bltas na khong rnam tsho la yang tig tig cig med pa 'dra/ mngon gyur bstan pa mngon sum dang mi 'gal/ lkog gyur bstan pa rjes dpag dang mi 'gal/ shin lkog bstan pa rang tshig snga phyi dang brjod bya dngos thugs mi 'gal/ zhes sogs bshad yams ci 'dra byas kyang don du ni nam rgyun rdzun bshad pa mthong thos med cing / da res kyi skad cha gong 'og lhu thug pa zhig byung song na cha 'jog bya dgos zhes pa de tsam zhig yin par snang ste/ de ltar na 'jig rten gyi rgan po ya rabs shig gi skad cha las lhag pa'i khyad chos ci yang mi 'dub/ci pas lung tshad ma — 165 —
phyir rtos wa wazer yang de ga tsam red/ rtogs dka' ba nges legs la mi bslu bar rigs pas grubacan sla ba mngon mtho la mi bslu bar yid che sa byed chog zer yang / dka' sla'i nges/ pa de ga rang yang bsgrub bya las sgrub byed min pa/sa phan ga 'a/ thogs/kha cig gis/ las 'bras zhes pa de ngal rtsol can gyi mi la grub 'bras thob pa dang / nag nyes bsags pa'i mi la khrims chad phog pa'i nges pa 'di tsam la zer ba yin gyi/ gzhan rwa zing nge ba'i rgyu 'bras shig nga tshos kyang 'dod kyin mel/'di khas mi len na khyod rang mgo rgyal ba yin zhes sgam mdog dang bcas smras 'dug de ltar na mar khe si dang ma'o tse tung lta bu khu/nga las 'bras smra ba yin par 'gyur bas da ni su la yang rtsod pa brgyab dgos mi 'dug go /des na las 'bras/ yod dang med ces rtsod pa de rgyal khab kyi mkhrims ltar lci yang mi yis gtan la phab nga/ min pa zhig dang / sa smyug gi 'brel ba ltar ngo bo thad lar mthong bar mi nus r+b+ya 'i mi mngon pa'i stobs shugs shig gzhi grub min dpyod pa yin gyi/ 'jig rten thog tu rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag med ces 'di na rtsod mkhan su yang mi 'dug pas don med kha rlangs phud nas ci zhig byed/ mthong rgyu rig rgyu med pa'i 'brel ba rnyog 'dzing can de 'dra zhig nga tsho'i mgo thog tu yod pa'i shes byed ni cung tsam yang 'god nus med/ med pa'i dbang gis las 'bras smra ba tshos kyang lung la skyabs bcol zhu dgos thug pa red/ lung la skyabs bcol zhu min ni rmongs dad byed min la thug yod/ las 'bras med zer mkhan tshos ma — 166—
mthong ba'i phyir med zer ba yin pa'i dbang du btang na/ yod zer mkhan tshos yo da par gsungs pa'i phyir yod ces zer ba yin/ ma mthong ba'i phyir med zer na gcig tu khrel ba'i rgyu ru ma nges te/ ri bong gi mgo la thug rgyu rig rgyu can zhig ma mthong ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis der ra med zer ba ma gtogs de lhag gi gnas lugs shig su la yang 'chad rgyu med pa'i phyir/ yod gsungs pa tsam gyis yod par khas len dgos pa 'di cung zad ngo mtshar che ste/: gsu nga mkhan de nyag sked bu long ma ltar btsan drag che ba la tshod cig mi 'dus pas so// cung zad zhib tu 'chad na las kyi 'bras bu la rnam smin dang / rgyu mthun/ bdag po'i 'bras bu bcas gsum gsungs yod/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu zhes pa de tshe snga mar da ge ba bsgrubs na tshe phyi mar lha yul du skye 'gro ba dang / tshe snga mar sdig pa bsags na tshe phyi mar dmyal bar lhung 'gro ba'i ngang tshul 'di la zer/ rgyu mthun la gnyis las/ myong ba rgyu mthun ni/ tshe snga mar sbyin pa btang na phyi mar phyug por chags nges pa dang / tshe snga mar rku ma brkus na phyi mar dbul por 'gyur 'gro ba'i tshul lugs 'di la zer/ nam rgyun las dag dang r+ya dag zer ba dang / 'di dang de'i rnam smin zhes mang mang gis gleng ba phal mo che rnam smin dang myong ba rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu'i cha nas yin par snang / 'di gnyis la lung kho na las rigs pa'i sgrub byed ci yang 'god rgyu med/ byed pa rgyu mthun ni tshe snga mar srog gcod byed mkhan de tshe brjes na yang srog gcod la dga' mkhan zhig tu — 161 —
'gyur srid zer/ sa skya paṇa chen gyis// rigs pa nangs par 'chi yang bsla bas /tshe 'dir mkhas par ma gyur kyang // skye ba phyi mar bcol ba yi// nor la rang nyid len dang ma tshungs// zhes gsungs pa ltar gal srid tshe snga phyi zhes nga/ zhi ga yod pa'i dbang du btang na 'di la gnas lugs cung zad yod 'os pa tsam yin/ 'on kyang deng gi byis pa 'di dag gi gnas bab yod tshad khor yug dang slob gso la rag las 'dug pa mthong dus 'di la yang the tshom skye 'ong bar 'dug skye ba snga ma'i gnas yul tsam yang dran rgyu med par nag thom mer chags tshar 'dug pas/sngo na ma'i dga' kha khyer phyogs da dung ma nyams par bsdad yod zer na khrag po los yin/ bdag po'i 'bras bu zhes pa ni mi yis besod nams bsags na yul la g.yang 'khor zhing / mi yis tshogs ngan bsags na yul gyi bcud 'dzad 'gro/ zhes pa ste snod bcud dbyer med kyi lta tshul rnying pa zhig yin par snang /'khor ba thog med du 'dod pa dang / dge sdig spang blang smra ba 'di la nang 'gal zhig kyang 'dug ste/ thog med nas bsags pa'i las la 'dzad pa'i r+ya tha' mi dmigs na da gsar du dge ba ma byas kyang nyung du 'gro rgyu dang / sdig pa bsags kyang mang du 'gro rgyu med pa'i phyir dge sdig 'dor len byed pa la dgos nus lhag po ci zhig yod/ las 'bras spyi yi rnam gzhag la bgro gling de tsam gyis chog par bya yang / log lta zer ba'i ma 'dra 'dra zhig 'dug pa 'di la ni dmigs bsal gyis cung zad cig ma zhus na mi bzod pa zhig red/ rang re'i — 168—
khrid bzhung rnams su// mi/ dge bcu las los lta lci// zhes gsungs yod la de'i don tshe snga phyi dang las rgyu 'bras zer ba 'di tsho zer tshod tsam las bden rgyu rang dag ma red snya ma pa'i bsam blo skad cig ma ceg skyes na/ de ma thag tu tshe tshe rabs rabs su bsags tshad bsgrubs tshad thams cad 'o zo kha sbubs pa ltar nag gor rer 'gyur 'gro ba yin zer/ de ltar na mi dge bcu dag phar bzhag ste mtshams med lnga las kyang rab cig lci tshod red/ las byas pa chud mi za/ myo/ byas pa dang mi 'phrad/ dkar nag 'chol nas/ mi smin sogs drang bden tshul mthun gyi ska da cha de tsho yod tshad log lta 'dis gyur mid btang tshar bzhag shugs myos thub kyi bsam blo gtong stangs tog tsam 'grig min byung tshe lam seng kha rje dbang thang yod tshad gzhung bzhes bzo 'gro mkhan zhig gis da dung gnas lugs/ dang rgyu 'bras gleng 'ong na tshig pa mi za'am/ las/ 'bras med snya ma pa tsam gyis dge mchad 'gro na las 'bras yod snyam pa tsam gyis sdig mchad mi 'gro ba ci yin nam/ sdig pa kho na la 'di tsam gyi kha ngo ster gnang ba'i ston pa sangs rgyas khong gal srid zhal bzhugs yod pa'i dbang du btang na/ da res drang tshugs zin ma byung zhes ngo zhol rngam ston bya dgos nges red 'dug go/ bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du// legs par brtags la nga yi bka'// blang bar bya yi gzhan du min/ zhes pa'i lung 'di kha sha la btags nas 'gro 'dug r+ya khan de tshos thugs bsam drang mo re bzhes dang / gzi brdzid khog stong zhig ma — 169 4
gtogs don dngos su [bong gis nga tshor bsam blo'i rang dbang sprad 'dug gam/khor yug gi gnas bab nya rdza'i nang gi nya las kyang skyo bzhin du da dung nga tshor zhed po zhig yod ces dga' krog krog tu 'dug dgos sam/ brtag dpyad dang nyams zhib yongs rdzogs yag sa bzang ṭarga kho na nas byed dgos pa las / skyon dang dri ma'i skor dran tsam yang mi tshog pa'i lugs shig la bsam/ blo'i rang dbang zer rung ngam/ nga tsho la tshe snga phyi dang las rgyu 'bras med na dga' rgyu dang / yod na sdug rgyu cung tsam yang med mod/ nyes pa khab tsam ma bsags kyang chad pa ri tsam re gcod 'ong na nga tsho44 mgo bo sgur mi thub/ de bas bdag legs su 'dod pa'i mi tshos nyi ma de ring nas 'os langs byas te/ dge mkhyu gsod byed mkhan gyi log lta 'di las gral nas phyir 'bud gtang rjes/ 'dra mnyam gnyis phan gyi khrims lugs gsar pa zhig gtan la mi 'bebs ka med red 'dug go/ston pa tshad sgrub kyi skabs su// mi shes ston par byed pa la// 'khrul par dogs pa can rnams kyis// des bshad nan tan bya ba'i phyir// shes ldan 'ga' zhig 'tshol bar byed// ces ston pa tshad mar sgrub pa'i dgos pa ni bstan pa ma nor ba zhig dang mjal ba'i ched yin gsungs/ 'on kyang dngos gzhi'i skabs su de las ldog ste/ bstan pa bden bzhi'i gnas lugs ma 'khrul ba sngon du bsgrubs zin rjes gzhi nas ston pa tshad ma'i skyes bu ru thag gcod gnang 'dug dge chos lags kyis// rigs pa'i dpyad pa shing rta'i srol la brten// shing rta chen po rigs pa'i — 170—
