stobs kyis bsgrubs/ / rang thag chod na su yi rjes su 'brang // rang thag ma chod su la yid rton byed// yang dag rigs pa nges don lung las rnyed// drang nges khyad par dri med rigs pas 'byed// rigs pas shes na nges don ci la 'tshol//rigs pas ma shes nges don ga la rnyed// ces phan tshun gcig gi dpang po gcig gis yong thabs med par gsungs pa 'di thin tu bden te/ bstan pa rnam das tu thag ma chod pa de srid du ston pa tshad ma zhig rnyed mi srid cing / bstan pa rnam dag tu thag chod tshar dus ston pa tshad ma 'tshol mi dgos pa'i phyir ro//skyon cha gtan nas med pa'i dge rgan zhig dang / nor ‘mabyul ye nas med pa'i rig gzhung zhig rnyed na dag mi 'dod mkhan su zhig yod kyang / skyon yon 'dres mar gnas pa 'di dngos po kun gyi gshis lugs yin 'dug pas thabs dang bkod pa thon dka' rgyu red snyam/ bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag gi thad du/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab zer ba 'di la blo rtsegatad sa ci yang med pa'i tshul dbu ma'i skabs su bshad zin/ 'khor ba bden med du rtogs na 'khor ba don gnyer gyi blo spong 'gro zer ba 'di'ang yongs su 'khrul pa yin te/ de ltar na myang 'das bden med du rtogs tshe myang 'das don gnyer gyi blo'ang ci'i phyir spong mi 'gro ste rgyu mtshan mtshungs pa la zlog tu med pa'i phyir ro// da dung sems kyi rang bzhin ni 'od sa/sal ba zhig yin tshul dang / dri ma rnams ni glo bur ba zhig yin tshul sogs 'thad pa med pa'i rnam gzhag mang du ga'adug mod / snying gi —11 1—
phyir rtog———— ————————dkyil du sngar nas bsnun zin pa yin pas da yan lag re re bzhin du gsod pa'i ngal ba bsten ma 'dod do//bzhi/ 'dul sngags lugs kyi sdom dang dam tshig gi rnam gzhag la dpyadapa/sa ngas rgyas chos lugs ni gna' rabs rgya gar gyi spyi tshogs khrod nas mgo 'bus shing / bram ze'i chos lugs kyi 'og cha/sa lag chags pa zhig yin stabs/ chos 'dul ba'i lugs kyi bca' khrims kyi nang du yang skabs de'i rgya gar ba'i yul chos dang / bram ze'i chos kyi cho ga mang po 'dres yod pa smos ci dgos te/ che sa nas bshad na khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba'i ngang m+mu 'di yang phyi rol mu stegs pa'i lugs srol yin pa lta bu red/ ston pa sangs rgyas rang nyid kyang thog mar mu stegs pa'i rab byung tshor mig dper blta sa te cha lugs bsgyu ra ba zhig yin la/ phyis su lta ba'i thad nas tog tsam ma mthun pas zur du don dgos byung yang rtags dang cha lugs gsar brje gnang med par ma zad/ nyid kyi rjes gong tshor yang mu mthud cha lugs de nyid rgyun 'dzin byed du bcug pa red/ thog ma'i char rab tu byung ba'i tshad de skra bregs shing gos brjes te khyim tshang dang kha bral nas sdo da pa de tsam zhig ma gtogs/ deng sang nang bzhin sdom pa len pa'i cho ga dang / gtong ba'i sa mtshams sogs rnyog 'dzing chen po 'di — 172—
rtodzire padzimig nang gi chos gags kyi 'jig rten/'dra med/ rim bzhin dge slong bzang sbyin gyis dge sbyong gi cha lugs ma dor bzhin du mi tshangs par spya da pa dang / rdza mkhan nor can/gyis rku ma brkus pa/ nya pa'i khye'u lnga brgyas ma yin yin mdog gi rdzun gtam pa/ dge slong mi sdug pa casgom mkhan kha shas kyis rang srog rang gis bcad pa sogs gnad don dza drag can mang po 'phro rim 'phror pon pa na/ da gzod phyogs gcig nas sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen dang cho ga'i brgyud rim mang po zhig bzos te mi ci min 'di min de 'dra rab byung pa'i gral du 'tshang rgyu sngon 'gog byas pa dang / phyos/sa gzhan zhig nas bca' khrims gsar pas rab byung pa tsho'i kun spyod kyi tshad gzhi gtan la phab pa red/ las don de sku tshe gang por rgyun 'khyongs dang / 'thus sgo tshang du btang ba'i mthar dge slong pha la 'dul khrims nyis brgya nga gsum dang / dge slong ma la sum brgya re bzhi/ thun mong gi las brgya rtsagacig dang / gzhi bcu bdun sogs ma lag tshang ba'i lam srol 'di nyid chags thub pa byung / gal srid ston pa khong sku tshe de bas ring ba zhig bzhugs yod na/ da lta'i 'dul khri'o/sa 'di dag las kha cig rtsis med dang / la la kha gsab sogs mu mthud bcos bsgyur gnang yod nges red/ 'dir kho bos brjod 'dod pa'i skad cha ni/ 'dul ba'i bca' khrims de ston pa shākya thub pas dbyings chod kyis mar bka' phab bzhag pa zhig min par/ rgyal khab kyi khrims lugs lta ra thog mar dus dang khor yug nges can zhig gi shugs rkyen 'og gtan 'bebs gnang bzhag pa zhig yin — 173 —
nga1sa/ da dung g.yang dus dang khor yug la bstun mas bsnon 'phri spor bcog byed chos pa zhig ma gtogs/ dge mtshan dang don snying yod med la ltos pa med par mtha' gcig tu mdze pho mdung bzung byed mi dgos/ zhes pa 'di yin/ de bzhin dge tshul slong gi sdom pa len pa'i cho ga de yang bsta na pa'i sgo ru 'jug nga/'i dam bca'i mdzad sgo tsam zhig yin gyi/ 'bogs chog la brten nas sdom pa zhes pa'i dngos po rdog rdog cig rgyud la skye 'ong rgyu dang 'thob 'ong rgyu ci yang med la/ de dang 'gal ba'i gnas tshul lhag na dam bca' shor ba yin pas smad par 'os pa'i gnas tsam ni los yin ma gtogs/ dngos su rdza bum bzhin du chag 'gro rgyu dngag/ shing lo bzhin du grug 'gro rgyu de 'dra gang yang yod pa ma red/sdocha/ pa phyor ༷so nga na dmyal bar lhung 'gro zer ba 'di ni de bas kyang dpyad mi bzod pa'i rdzun btam yin te/ sdom pa gtan nas bsrung r+ya myong ba'i khyim pa tsho dmya 04 par lhu nga ma song myo// grwa log tshos khyim pa las sdug ja 'i las ka ci yang ma byas pas dmyal bar ci la lhung 'gro/ sdom pa bsrung e thub bltas pa der dge ba ched kyang sdig pa yod mi dpe/ 'dul ba'i chos ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig las//byams dang 'jam dbyangs sogs 'a/'ang dbang ba min/ zhes sogs zer ba chi glen rtags/ mkhri'ika sa 'dzin gyi skad cha las ma 'das/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten bkod nga/ po yi na na ma 4togs khong gcig pu la dmigs bsal gyi dbang cha de 'dra yod don ci yang medag/ rgya gar gyi 'dul khrims de rgya gar gyi yul chos la — 174

phyir rtogthos tshos chang dang bud med la spyad na sdig pa yod pa ma cigatogs mi gzhan pas spyad na sdig pa med pa zhig yin na/ ston pas rang gi slob ma tshor bsam bzhin du zhe gnag byas par 'gyur zhing / de ltar na su zhig nye sad bcar tshe de nyid phung la sbyor ba'i sbrul gdug lta bu'i ston pa wo/ nga thugs rje can zhig tu ji ltar na 'grub/ de bas bkag pa thams cad ye bkag dang / gnang ba thams cad ye gnang / bcas pa thams cad spyi snyoms su bcas pa yin par khas len dgos zhes gsungs/ de la sa skya paṇa chen gyis sdom gsum rab dbye'i nang du dgag pa 'di ltar btang yod/ nyam sa len ye bkag ye gnang yin na theg dman par gre/nga bkas/ theg che'o rnga/ra bkag pa dang / theg chen par gang gnang theg dman par yang gnang 'os pa la de ltar min pa'i rgyu mtshan ci red/ bcas pa 'gro ba spyi la bcas pa yin na/ mi yod tshad gzan sham gyon nas song zhig ces gsungs rigs pa la/ de ltar ma gsungs par tshul khrims 'chal ba'i mi tshos gzan sham gyon bsdad na gnod pa ma gtogs phan pa med ces gsungs don ci yin nam/3 sangs rgya/sa longs spyod rdzogs sku dang / byang sems nye ba'i sras chen brgyad sogs skya chas spra sa nas bzhugs yod pas kho tshos kyang gzan sham ma gyon pa'i sdis/ltapa de khur dgos pa e red/ nyan thos tshos chang dang bud med la longs spyad na sdig pa chen po yod kyang r+p+pa ngas thub na dge ba yang chen po yod/ des na ston pas rang gi slob ma tshor chang dang bud med bsten mi chog par bzos pa — 116—
des slob ma tshor phan pa ma gtogs gnod pa med/ dper na zhing kha yod na sad dang ser ba'i gnod 'tshe 'byung srid kyang ston thog gi re ba yod pas zhing kha gtan nas med pa las drag gi red/ de bas mi dbul po la sa zhing sbyin par btang na de nyid phan btas/sa pa las gnod bskyal bar brtsimi rung / zhes sogs la bshad lung bshad mang po zhig gnang 'dug 'on kyang dge sdig gi byed po sangs rgyas yin par thal ba'i rtsaba'i rigs pa de la skyon spong cung tsam yang ma thub pa ni sa zhing sbyin pa'i dpe de rang las kyang shes thub/ phyis kyi sa skya'i mkhas pa ngag dbang chos grags zer ba des kyang / 'di'i thad du 'bri gung pa la rigs/ pa tog tsam yod/ ces lan ma thebs pa'i ngos len zhu dgos byung 'dug pa ltar red/ 'bri gung pa'i ye bkag ye gnang dang / bcas rang gnad gcig gi grub mtha' des kyang paṇa chen bla ma'i rigs pa de tshor tshul mthun gyi la na thebs pa'i re ba med/ gal srid sdom pa zhes pa de rang byung gi dge ba zhig yin na ni/ 'bri gung chos rje'i dgongs pa ltar de'i gnang bkag gi dbang cha sangs rgyas la yod don med cing / sa skya pa'i bzhed pa ltar sangs rgyas kyis gsar du bzos bzhag pa zhig yin na ni/ 'jig rten pa'i khrims ltar ngo bo dge sdig gang yang yin mi srid do// thugs rig rno thag chod pas sdom pa'i rnam gzhag la nang 'gal ni gsal por mthong / thugs dad che thag chod pas rnam gzhag 'di mi bden nam snyam pa'i thugs bsam ni bzhes ma phod/ de'i dbang — 177—
jigis sa 'bre'i chos rje rnam pa gnyis ka thugs 'o brgyal po byung 'dug ste/ chos lugs kyi rnam gzhag phal mo che zhig dang / chos pa tsho'i rigs lam mang po zhig la zhib tu dpyad na 'di 'dra sha stag tu snang ngo / rab byung pa'i chas gos gzan sham 'di yang sangs rgyas pa'i thun min gyi khyad chos ci yang min/ spyir stod smad so sor ras yug lheb gyon byed pa 'di rgya gar ba'i yul srol dang / bye brag tu ngur smrig gi kha dog ni mu stegs pa'i rab byung gi mtshon byed tsam yin/ phyis su rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i dgongs 'char ltar phyi rol pa dang mi 'dra ba'i le'u zhig bcos pa 'di tsam zhig sangs rgyas pa'i gsar gtod red/ des na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku thams cad gna' dus kyi rgya gar ba ltar na bza' stod g.yogs smad g.yogs can rkyang rkyang yin pa dang / thag ring bde ba can na bzhugs 6 'i mgon po 'od dpag med pa khong yang sku la chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing ser ltem mer bzhugs yod pa dang / bstan pa nub pa'i tshe na skra la gri mi 'jug cing gos kyis tshon mi len par bshad cing mos pa bcas ni bshad pa tsam dang mos pa tsam du zad/ gzan sham 'di yul gyi dbang du byas na tsha ba'i khul gyi cha lugs dang / dus kyi dbang du byas na mi lo stong tsho kha shas yar sngon gyi cha lugs dang / rang bzhin gyi dbang du byas na rgya gar mi rigs kyi cha lugs yin pas deng sang gi nga tsho la 'tsham po zhig ni ma red/mdor na chos 'dul ba'i bca' khrims kyi nang du srog mi gcod pa dang / ma —178—
byig par mi len pa sogs bsngags par 'os pa mang po yod pa smos med thog me la mi reg pa dang / shing la mi 'dzegs pa lta bu skabs de'i bram ze dang khyim bdag dag gi ngo ma tshog pa ra bcas r+p+pa tsam las don dngos su dgos pa dang rgyu mtshan de tsam med pa'ang cha/nga po yod/ lhag par du tshangs spyod kyi sdom khrims 'di mi'i rang gshis dang rtsab nyid nas mi mthun zhing / rang dbang sis rnyed pa'i 'dod bde tsam la ni ngo bo'i cha nas nyes pa ci yang brtsorgyu med pas dngos gams byas na 'di'i tshab tu sha mi za ba lta bu zhig byas bzhag na bsrung sla zhing phan thogs mig mthong 9zag zin yin pas/ dge mtshan che bar snang mod ma byung bar 'dug go /tshangs spyod kyi dgos pa mthar thug ni chos bsgrub pa la stabs bde dang / sems shugs bskrun rgyu de yon yin nga/sa rang don du 'dod chung chog shes dang / spyi pa'i rtsadon la thug dus khyim pa rnams dang mi la dra ba'i gtong phod can 'ig dang/ gdong mchong byed nus mkhan zhig yin na tshangs par spyad pa la don po byung ba yin/ de min mo sdom bsrung ba'i yus che tsam las bzang spyod kyi khyad par gzhan gang yang bstan rgyu med pa'i grwa btsun sku zhabs rnam pa ni/ rgya nag gong ma chen mo'i pho brang nang ma'i btsun mo srung mkhan gyi nyug rum pa zer ba'i skyes pa las ngan de tsho dang 'dra bas snying po ci zhig yod/'on kyang de dag ni gzhan pas btsan po dbang yod byas te 'bras bu phyungs pa yin pas snying rje bar 'os la/ 'di ni don med rang sngug rang gis nyos pa yin —179—
pas yi mug pa'i gnas so//gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la theg pa gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos mang po yod pa smos ma dgos mod/ ches mngon gsal dod shos shig nī dge sdig dang rgyu 'bras kyi 'gro lugs gang yang brgyud mi dgos par gnad don yod tshad bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten nas thag gcod byed chog pa 'di red/ de yang nga tshos shes gsal ltar/ gsang sngags lugs la bla ma rnam par dmigs bsal gyi go thob chen po zhig yod de/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ zhes bla ma rnam pa dkon mchog gson po yin pa ma zad/ kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ zhes bla ma rnam pa ni ming don mtshungs pa'i byed po zhig kyang red/ mdo lugs la/ ngas chi khyod la thar pa'i thabs bstan gyi// thar pa rang la rag las shes par nyis/ zhes dang // thub rnams sdig pa chu yis mi 'khrud cing // 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag gis mi sel la// nyid kyi rtogs pa gzhan la spo min yang // chos nyid zhi ba bstan pas grol bar 'gyur// zhes sogs yid du 'ong ruba'i rnam gzhag 'ga' zhig yod mod/ gsang sngags kyis de dag yod tshad rtsis med du btang gzhag yod/ gsang sngags lugs la bla ma ni thar lam ston pa po min par thar pa ster ba po dang / slob ma ni thar lam sgrub pa po min par thar pa slong ba po red/ de'i rgyu mtshan gsang sngags lugs la bla ma'i gnang ba ma thob na slob ma la nyams len gyi thob thang med cing / bla ma'i gnang ba thob na slob ma la —180—
nyams rtogs kyi char pa 'bad med lhun 'grub tu 'bab yong ba yin/ gsang sngags lugs la sdig pa chu yis 'khru rung zhing sdug bsngal phyag gis sel chogchos nyid zhi ba ston mi dgos par rtogs pa gzhan la spo thub/ gsang hra gas lugs kyi dbang bskur de sdig pa chu yis 'khrud rung zhing sdug bsngal phyag gis sel chog pa'i dpe yin la/ gsang sngags lugs kyi byin rlabs ni chos nyid zhi ba ston mi dgos par rtogs pa gzhan la h+phu thub pa'i lung yin/ gsang sngags lugs kye bla ma la mtshan nyid gang yang tshang mi dgos te/ slob mas 'jon na khyi so la'ang ring bsrel 'khrungs 'ong ba yin/ gsang sngags lugs kyi slob ma la yon tan gang yang 'dzoms mi dgos te/ glen dad dpe med cig yod na de ga rang gis 'grig pa yin/ gsang sngags lugs kyi bla ma tshos 'gan khur gang yang len mi dgos te/ rang snang gang shar dang / ci dran gang 'dod gnang nas bzhugs chog gsang sngags lugs kyi slob ma tshor rang dgang spu tsam yang med de/bla mas rgyobs gsung na brgyab rkyang dang / lcobs gsung na lceb rkyang byed dgos/gsang sngags lugs kyi dam tshig de'ang bla mas mar gnang nas slob mas yar bsrung dgos pa zhig yin/ bla ma'i thugs la ma babs na dam tshig gzhung bzhes gnang tshog la/ slob ma'i blo la ma babs rung dam tshig yar slog zhu sa med/ slob ma'i byed stangs ma 'grig na slob ma dam nyams yin la/ bla ma'i gnang stangs ma 'grig rung bla ma dam nyams min/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi te lo nā 1ro'i —181—
rnam thar dang / bod gangs can ljongs kyi mar pa mi la'i rnam thar la sa gong gi rnam gzhag de tsho yod tshad ra sprod byas bzhag yod/ de yang te los nā ro par dka' chen bcu gnyis dang / dka' phran bcu gnyis te dka' ba mi 'dra ba nyer bzhi sku lus gcig gi thog tu spyad du bcug par grags pa de tsho don dngos su rku ma brku ba dang / jag pa brgyab pa sogs ma rabs tha shal ñtsha bya ba 'ba' zhig bsgrub tu bcug pa red/ yin na'ang bka' 'bebs mkhan bla mar song stabs bka' gsung ci bsgrub ma zhus sa ma thug pa red la/ bla ma'i ci gsung chos yin stabs sdig pa byas kyang dge bar 'gyur song ba red/ mthar te los nā ro pa'i snying khar dog rgyag mun rub pa lta bu zhig bzhus pas nā ro pa dran med du brgyal/brgyal ba las sangs pa dang dpon slob dgongs pa dbyer med du gyur tshar 'dug skad/ de ma gtogs khong rnam gnyis chos 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas bla slob chags pa zhig min te/ te los tshig gcig ma gsungs la// nā ros tshig gcig ma nyan te// byin rlabs rtogs pa 'phos pas grol/ zhes gsungs yod/ de bzhin mar pas mi lar mkhar zla gam zlum po gru bzhi bcig tu bcug pa sogs yi chad chen po brgyad dang snang chung grangs med pa'i sgo nas tshar bcad pa de'ang bltas tshod la mar pas rgyu 'bras med pa'i bya ngan sha t+ta ga spel ba dang / mi las don dag med sa nas dka' sdug grangs med cig myangs song ba lta bur snang mod gsang sngags lusas la de ltar min par bya gzhag rlabs po che zhig gi gzhi things song — 181—
ba red// da dung grub chen ga ge mos glu zhig blangs pas grong khyer 'bum phrag bcu gnyis kyi skye bo thams cad grub pa thob ces dang / rtogs ldan che ge mos gar zhig 'khrab pas bya dang ri dwags yod tshad 'ja' lus su dengs zhes dang / kha chang snod la gtug ma thag mchog gi dngos grub brnyes zhes dang / nyal po byed bzhin mkha' spyod du 'phur song / zhes sogs ngo mtshar rab tu che ba'i rnam thar mang po mjal rgyu yod/ nyin bsgom na nyin 'tshang rgya/ mtshan bsgom na mtshan 'tshang rgya/ skal ldan las 'phro can la bsgo ma mi dgos par thos pa tsam gyis grol 'gro ba'i gdams ngag zer ba 'di 'dra los yin snyam/ skyabs 'gro'i bsam blo ji tsam thugs che na bran g.yog gi 'du shes de tsam gyis thugs che ba yin/ zhes pa 'di mdo lugs kyi skyabs 'gro la sbyar na cung zad mi 'phrod pa lta bu zhig red bsam bzhin yod/ 'on kyang gsang sngags lugs kyi bla ma la skyabs su 'gro ba ni dngos gnas bla ma'i bran g.yog rgyug pa rang red bzhag kun gyis shes gsal ltar mi la ras pa ni gsang sngags lugs kyi slob ma de yan med pa zhig red la/khong bla ma mar pa la skyabs su song rjes mar pa'i g.yog la rgyug dgos pa dag a cang cang ste/ mar pa'i 'dug rogs bdag med ma'i yang ba 'jo ba'i 'jo stegs dang / yos brngo ba'i brngo stegs yan chad zhabs phyi zhu dgos thug pa red/sdig rgyal glang dar mas rab byung kha la mi nyan mkhan tsho rta zhon pa'i zhon stegs byed myong skad 'dug pa bden min ci shes/ de ma gtogs bdag me da ma lta bu — 183—
phyir rdzogmi ong bkyag brgyab nas ba 'jo zhing yos brngo mkhan gyi nag mo ham pa can de 'dra gzhan 'jig rten 'dir e yod na snyam/ nam rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod du nga tshos bla mar phyag dbang zhu ba zhes mgo thog tu bla ma'i lag pa 'jog tu bcug pa/zhabs bkyag zhu ba zhes rang nyid gan rkyal du 'gyel ba'i thog tu bla mar rdog brdzi byed du bcug pa/ chags med rin po ches// gos dum skra sen chab bsil yang // dad can mang pos khyer dang btung // ja snyigs phos pa thams cad kyang //mig la byug dang ske la byug ces gsungs pa ltar bla ma'i kha 'khrud lag 'khrud rang gi mgo dang lus la byug pa/ rang gi kha mig sna gsum gyi nang du bla mar mchil ma 'deb tu bcug pa/ bla ma'i skra sen bsreg pa'i du bar snom pa/ tha na bla ma'i gcin skyag yan chad byin rlabs kyi rdzas su brtsis te za zhing 'thung ba sogs kyang gsang sngags lugs kyi bla ma bsten tshul dri ma med pa red/ da dung deng sang lag len byed mkhan med pa tsam ma gtogs bla ma yab yum snyoms par 'jug pa'i sbyor mtshams su slob mar lce ldag byed du bcug cing / lce thog tu yong ba'i khrag nag gi thigs pa de nyid 'dzam gling na dkon pa'i dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhig yin rabs kyi bshad pa brgyab pa sogs mi chos las 'das pa'i cho ga phyag len mang po yod pa red/ mdor na gsang sngags lugs la bla ma'i zhabs phyi yag po zhus te bsdad na gzhan gang yang byed mi dgos par rang gar sangs rgyas 'gro ba red la/ bla ma dgyes po ma byung phyin gzhan tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong — 184—
ci tsam byas kyang phan thogs med par rdo rje dmyal ba'i mthil du 'byar 'gro ba red/ gsang sngags lugs kyi dam tshig thams cad kyang bsdu na bla ma'i sku gsung thugs gsum la zhags tog phangs pa med par bsgrub pa 'di'i nang du ('dus pa yin/ de bas gsang lnga gas lugs kyi bla ma ni ye shu'i lugs kyi lha chen las kyang sku gsod dang dbang thang ldab 'gyur gyis che zhing / ye shu'i lugs kyi lha chen de 'jig rten 'dzugs skrun gnang mkhan gyi dkon mchog cig yin na/ gsang sngags lugs kyi bla ma de 'jig rten longs su spyo da mkhan gyi dkon mchog de red ces bshad chog da dung phyag las gnang stangs kha shas kyi thad nas bsam na 'jig rten gtor bshig gtong mkhan gli dkon mchog cig red ces zhus na'ang mi 'grig pa med pa'i tshod red/ ska da grags chod pa'i rgya gar grub chen brgyad cu zer ba'i mi de rnams kyi 'gro lugs 'dug stangs la gcig ltos dang /kho tsho'i khrod du mi gsod mkhan/ dmag rgyag mkhan/ rku ma rku mkhan/ skyag rdzun shod mkhan/ chang rag 'thung mkhan/ sho rgyan 'gyed mkhan/ gzhang 'tshong mkhan/phyugs bsha' mkhan/ nya bzung mkhan sogs bya ba sdug rigs ngan tshad byed mkhan rkyang ma gtogs ya rabs tshul mthun gyi 'tsho ba rol ba'i mi mang po bgrang rgyu med/ bod du'ang jo bo bka' gdams pas btsun tshugs phran bu zin pa ma/ gtogs gzhan sngags rgan rnam pas yos brngo brngo dang / khrag dkrug dkrug gnang grabs byas yod/ ra chen rdo rje grags kyis ngan sngags bsags te — 185 —
sa thob kyi sems dpa' bcu gsum bsgral / 'brug smyo na kun dga' legs pas dga' rogs lnga stong brgya med nyi shu rtsalnga bsgrigs/ de lta na'ang lo tshor sdig rgan dang 'chal po'e ming shas 'ong rgyu lta ci ste// da dung gzi brjid dang ngo mtshar che ba'i tshad du bcis nas kun la gsang mthor sgrog paṇa ṭi ta sham thabs sngon po can gyis/ chang dang bud med 'khrig pa rin chen gsum// rin chen gzhan ni rdo shing rin chen nyid/ ces dang / pho brang zhi ba 'od kyis// sbyor ba dar bas/ sgro la ba dar bas ra lug nyal thag bcad/ཿ ces gsungs pa ltar yul khams kyi pho tham sa cad bsgral te mo thams cad dang sbyor ba'i rdo rje slob dpon yang byon myong zhing / de la jiyang yag sa dang bzang sa nas 'grel bshad bong bu'i 65 'byog 'dra ba re bskyon rgyu yod na gzhan lta ci smos/ mdor na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i rtse mo gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la brten nas grub pa'i sa mthor gathegaye nga/'i rnal 'byor pa smyo pyod can de tsho dang / deng sang 'dzam gling thog tu mi gsod me rgyag gi la sa 'gul spel mkhan ñtsha 'jigs skul drag spyod ring lugs pa gnyis po kun slong dang kun spyod gang la yang ngo po'i thog nas dbye ba 'byed dka' ba zhig red 'dug 'on kyang 'grel bshad bskyon t+ta ngas mi 'dra ba phran bu yod pa ni/ nang pa'i grub chen rnam pas khong rnam tsho'i 4zhal gyi nang dang phyag si 'os/ nas shi ba'i se mas can thams cad khong rnam tsho nyid kyis 'dren 'gro bzhin yod gsungs pa dang / 'jigs skul drag spyo da pas kho pa tshos bsad — 186 —
rem bzhin ba che'i lha mo al las 'dren 'gro bzhin yod ces zer ba 'di red/don 'di dag kho bos gas nga snga gas kyi rgyud mye rin po che rnams/ dpang du bzhagrtsod med yongs grags kyi grub thob mang po'i rnam thar dpe ru bzung nas smra 4khu pa yin gyi/ rang nyid lnga gas la mi mos pa'i dbang gis gzhi med kyi sku ra 'debs dang / gsang sngags 'chal bar spyod pa'i mi ngan kha shas kyi bya pyod bag tsam la brten nas yongs rdzogs nag 'byams su brtsis pa gtan nas min te/ mi bden snya ma pa'i mi yod tshe kho bo dang lhan du bgro gling gi la/ma nas bden rdzun brdar sha gcod pa'i las su zhugs mdzod dang da gzod ha go bar 'gyur ro// lung 'di rje sog bzlog pas ma/dzad pa'i brgal lan nges don 'brug sgra'i nang du yo da snyam yang yid la ma 'ongs pas sems bzang can gyi klog pa ngo zhig gis rogs ram gnang ba'i re ba zhu/lnga/ phar phyin lugs kyi sku dang zhing lams kyi rnamyos kramazhakra/ 0〈 dpyad pa/gur phyin gzhung gi gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam 4zhag rgyas spro sa can de dag theg chen gyi mdo sde rnam sa la brten nas mdzad pa yin ya nga / thes chen gyi sde snod tshad mar 'os min ni shin tu the tshom gyi gnas su lhung yod de/ de ya nga sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' gong 'os kun la rtsod pa med pa'i rgyal/ ba'i bka' — 187 —
ni nyan thos 'u gas kyi sde sno da nasum po ste deng sang yongs grags su theg dman gli cha do sder 'bod pa 'di dag tsam yin/ 'di dag gi khrod du skyes pa/'i rabs dang sngon gyi byung ba sogs/ la sgru nga gtam gyi slad gtan nas med pa min yang / gzhi rtsa'i cha nas ston pa nyid kyi sku tshe lo rgyus dang mdzad pa phrin las sogs dngos yod dang thag nye po zhig 'khod yod/ sto na pa nyid zhal bzhugs pa'i dus kyi slob ma'i gtso bo mchog zung dang / nyan thos 'od srung chen po sogs dang / mya ngan las 'das nas bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun la sogs pas bsta na pa skyong ba'i ska bas su yang theg chen gyi grags 'gul ci yang med/ de lta'i ngang nas mi lo brgya phrag mang po zhig song ba'i rjes su gzhi nas sngon gyi sems tsam pa'i slob dpon lnga brgya so gas kyis gsung rab rnams 'don pa cung zad mi 'dra ba kha cig gis 'don zhing / 'das rjes kyi lo chig stong la nye ba'i ska bas su da gzod klu thogs gnyis sogs brgyud nas shin tu mi 'dra ba'i chos skad rlabs yo che dag sa khyab rdo khyab tu gyur pa red/ de dag gi khungs dang rgyud pa gang yin dris pa na/ klu sgrub kyis kho rang sa 'og tu 'dzul nas yar la drangs pa yin tshul dang / thogs med kyis kho rang nam mkha' la 'dzegs nas mar la phab pa yin tshul sogs gsungs pa ma gtogs 'jig rten mi yul 'dir mdzub mo 'dzugs sa gcig kyang rag med pa red/ khornga rnam gnyis la bsta na pa'i shing rta chen mor bgrang ba'i rgyu mtshan yang drang mor zhus na khungs lung med pa'i grub mtha' mi — 188 —
'dra ba gnyis bsar du spel mkhan yin pa 'di 4 thug yod/ gcung dbyig gnyen sku na gzhon dus theg pa che chung gi bar na rtsod pa dza drag che ba'i sgang yin pa 'dis ska bas der theg chen sa thog tu bud nas dus yun mi ring bar shes thub/ des na slob dpon klu sgrub khong 'das rjes kyi bzhi brgya lon dus sku 'khrungs shing dgung grangs drug brgya'i bar du bzhugs pa sogs ni gtam rgyud tsam dang / dgu brgya tsam du 'khrungs shing stong phrag yas mas su grongs pa ni dngos don du bzung na 'grig mkhas dbang dge chos lags kyis/ legs ldan dang chos grags so gas gsang sngags la cha rgyus med par gakhungs pa ltar du4ge rabs bdun pa'i g.yas g.yon tsam la yang yongs grags su gsang sngags nang bsgyu ra gnang ba'i mgo phal cher tshugs med pa 'dra/ phyis su ni slob dpon klu sgrub kyi mtshan 'khod pa'i gsang 'dus rim lnga dang / zla ba'i mtshan 'khod pa'i sgron ma gsal ba sogs ma nga du dar yang slob dpon de dag gi gsung ga la yin te/ de tsho nī klu sgrub yab sras 'das nas mi lo brgya skor mang po song rjes gzhi nas don pa yin 'dug pa'i phyir/ srong btsan gyi bka' chems dang / pad ma'i bka' thang zer ba dag dang 'dra bar slob dpon gong ma'i mtshan g.yar ba tsam du zad do// mar+ya'i rgyal po mya ngan med kyis 'dzam bu'i gling du chos kyi pho nya bkye skabs rgyal bstan dar ba'i shar lho e she ya'i yul gru khrag tu sde pa ma gtogs theg chen med pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / rgya nag gi slo ba dpon thang sde snod gsum pa — 189 —
phyir phyogsogs kyis mdo skor ma gtogs gsang lngasas khur ma 'ongs pa'i rgyu mtshan dang /bod dar rdzogs chen h+ye chos skor dus phyis su 4/nga rgya gar na mjal rgyu med pa'i rgyu mtshan bcas la thugs/ bsam drang mor bzhes na go ba nam langs pa lta bu re 'char rgyu yod mod phyogs lhung gi re lde nag pos mgo gtums mjug gtums byas pa'i mi dag la ci cha/ rgya gar du klu spru ba zhabs kyis sher phyin 'bum pa klu yul nas blangs pa nas bzung ste mdo gsar rtsom gyi mtshams bzhag cing / tsi lu pa'am dus zhabs pas dus kyi 'khor lo mi yul du blangs rjes rgyud gas/ra rtsom gyi tsha rlabs zhi 'jags su phyin par grags/ 'on kyang nga tsho bod yul la mtshon na ni de nas bcis pa'i mi lo stong phrag gcig gi rjes te dus da lta yang sa chos rdo chos sna tshogs rdol mtshams bzhag thub kyin med pa 'dis/ nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di da dung yang bar snang khams nas mar 'bab yag byas med pa'i ra sprod byung yod/ theg chen pa'i rang skad ltar na ston pas gdul bya rigs can gsum nga chos 'khor rim pa gsum dngos su bskor myong ba yin yang / khong dgongs pa rdzogs ma thag glo bur du mi yul 'dir theg chen gyi gdul bya gcig kyang go rgyu rig rgyu med pa chags pas/ sras kyi thu bo byams 'jam dbyangs sogs bya thabs zad de theg chen gyi sde snod rnams bsnams nas lha klu lha min dri za'i yul bcas su phebs te/ dus yun ring po'i bar 'khyam po ldom po'i 'tsho ba rol bzhin bzhugs dgos byung ba yin 'dug byams 'jam dbyangs zhu ba 'di dag kha cig — 190—
gis rgya sar lung pa'i nang du sa skyes rdo skyes kyi mi yin zer ba dang / kha cig gis/:'jig rten gzhan nas 'khyar 'ong ba'i lha red zer bzhin 'dug ste/ do na du/dngos yod dngos med gang yin brjod tshod mi thig pa zhig tu snang // phyogs gcig nas/ ston pa khong skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur la rang dbang thob cing / gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus las skad cig kyang mi yol bar nam dgos na nam yin par bshad pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas/ dus tshod ma ran gong nas chos 'khor stong bskor mdzad cing / sras kyi thu bo tsho skug longs med par sku tsho'i 'phen pa rdzogs 'gro ba 'di dag la 'grel bshad ji lta ra brgyab/ dgung grangs drug brgya bzhugs pa'i sku tshe zhig yod na klu gra ba las ston pa nyid la mkho che bar mi 'du ga gam/ gdul bya dbang po yang rab de tsho bstan pa yar dar gli ska bas su gcig kyang 'ong rgyu med par lnga brgya tha ma tshes la nye dus gzhi nas khyu dang khyu byas te gang nas gshar yong ba yin sus shes/ theg chen gsung skabs sbyin bdag rgyal yo ma skyes dgra dang / zhu mkhan gnas brtan kun dga' bo/ nyan mkhan dge slong brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum/ da dung dge bsnyen pha mas gtsos pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag de 'dra'i mang po zhig yod 'dug pa/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das ma thag su zhig gis de tsho yod tshad la brjed zas brjed chu 'dra drangs pa yin na ma gtogs/ kho tshos theg chen gsung sa'i snod ldan gyi slob ma ma rnyed pa'i dbang du btang rung mi tshe lo rgyus gsung sa'i mi re gnyis shig ci la mi — 191—
rnyed/ des na nyan thos sde pa dag gis/ thes chen sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i bka' ma red/ klu spru ba sogs kyis rang bzo byas pa'i bstan bcos red ces smra ba la ni thugs lag khyon nas mi 'dug ste// dper na deng sang mi kha cig bis/ lha yul dang klu yul nas blangs pa'i rje tsong kha pa'i gsung rtsom yin zer nas brjod bya chal tshal can gyi dpe deb zad rgyu rdzogs rgyu med pa zhig phud 'ong ba'i dbang du btang na/ dz+re yi chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i bsam shes can gyi mkhas pa sus kyang khas len gnang thabs bral ba dang gcig mtshungs yin pa'i phyir/ rdo rje theg pa'i chos skor rnams la ni de bas kyang dgu 'gyur gyis khungs lung med pa sha stag ste/ gsang sngags kyi ston pa rdo rje 'chang zhes pa de sangs rgyas shākya thub pa skya sar bags pa'i ming yin zer ba lta bu gsung mkhan khungs lung med pa dang / sa gnas ri rab kyi rtse'am rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga'i nang du yin zhes pa lta bu gsung sa khungs lung med pa dang / rgyud 'chad pa po nga dang zhu ba po'ang nga yin zhes pa lta bu gsung yul khungs lung med pa dang / 'khor ba thog med nas bstan pa'i chos yin zhes pa lta bu gsung dus khungs lung med pa dang / nyon mongs ma spangs lam du khyer zhing ma bsgoms thos pas chog ces pa lta bu gsung rgyu khungs lung med pa dang / nub phyogs o rgyan gli yul der mtsho zhig yod pa skam pa'i shul nas rang byung gi rgyud sde'i dpe mdzod khang zhig thon/ de'i nang gi dpe cha rnams grub chen sa ra has rgya gar du skyel 'dren byas pa red ces pa lta — 192 —
bu rgyud pa'i lo rgyus khungs lung med nga/ bcas pha su yi na bshad rgyu med pa'i na'/ gyi bu zhig dang 'dra yang / bsam blo gu yangs btang drags pas gang la yang 'gal 'brel gyi rnam gzhag brtsi mi dgos par// slob dpon so so'i bsam tshod dran tshod re dang / ci dga' gang skyed re gdams nas bag/da chos gi yod pa red/ de bas rgyud sde re re la lugs srol mi 'dra ba nyi shu sum cu re tsam thon yong gi yod la/ de dag gcig las gcig rlabs che zhing ya mtshan pa dag dag yin/ mdor na sngags kyi chos 'byung ni gna' po'i rig byed gtam rgyud las kyang dgod bro ba'i lha sgrung 'ga' zhig ste/ rje red mda' bas/ gang nas blangs pa'i khungs kyang mi snang na// 'phyon ma'i bu bzhin 'di la sus yid rton/ zhes gsungs pa de nyid 'phangs pa ni dus kye 'khor lo sge ra gyi thog tu 'phangs pa yin kyang phog pa ni rgyud sde spyi yi sna la phog 'dug go /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mar nas mar la je 'grib dang / gdul bya'i blo rig je brtul je dig tu bud 'gro bzhin yod skad kyi bshad yam de dang bstun na/ chos kyi zab khyad kyang ji sdug je zhan du 'gyur 'gro 'os pa la/ de ltar min par theg dman gyi rjes su theg chen dang / mtshan nyid kyi rjes su sngags/ rgyud sde 'og ma'i rjes su gong ma bcas rim gyis dar zhing / de dag snga ma snga ma rnams las phyi ma phyi ma rnams je mtho je rdzig tu bud song ba 'di gnyis gab mi thug pa'i nang 'gal bla na med pa zhig ma yin nam/ gnas lugs rkyang pa'i ngos nas bshad na ni de ltar lags — 193 —
mod/ theg chen gyi slo ba dpon rnam pas theg chen gyi mdo dang rgyud sde dag gsar du dar spel btang ba la dgos pa dang rgyu mtshan med ces ni nam yang smra ba min te/ rgya gar gyi mu stegs byed dag gis stobs 'byor rgyas pa'i zhing khams dang / mi sems/ sgul ba'i thar pa'i gling kha mang po gcig rjes gnyis mthud du 'dzugs skru na byas pa na/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i mkhas pa tshos bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin dengs 'gro tshul gyi skad cha rnying pa de rang bshad de bsdad na mdun lam sor gang yang med par shes te/ rnga dang bstun nas 'cham rgyag pa'i dpe ltar 'jig rgyu med pa'i dag zhing dang / shi rgyu med pa'i longs sku/ gsal sgrib med pa'i rnam mkhyen sogs ya mtshan che ba'i theg pa 'di 'dra zhig gsar gtod thub pa des rang nyid 'chi lam nas thengs gcig bskyabs pa yin zhing /grub mtha' snga phyi'i bar na thod mi thug pa'i he bag rgyug skabs drang nges kyi khyad par phyes te 'gal ba bzlum pa 'di yang 'thab jus lhu things po zhig ma red ces sus brjod shes/ yang mu stegs dbang phyug pa sogs (ba cig la/ lta grub skya thad nas sangs rgyas pa sogs grub mtha' gzhan dag dang 'gran rtsod byed pa'i spobs pa med kyang / rtsa rlung theg le'i rnal 'byor sogs lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i man ngag dang / man ngag de dag las bltas bltas rig rig gi grub 'bras mang po bstan rgyu yod pas dad ldan mi dmangs kyi blo yid 'gugs pa'i nus thugs la sus kyang 'gran zla dang bral ba'i tshad du sleb pa na/ sangs rgyas chos — 194—
'u sas pas kyang blo stobs chen pos mu stegs lugs kyi ngo mtshar che ba'i rlung sbyo ra gyi man ngag mang po nang 'dren gnang thog man ngag de dag la bsten nas tshe lus gcig la 'tshang rgya thub pa'i 'grel bskyod gsar du bskyon pa sogs gzhan gyi legs cha 'dus la rang gi khyad chos kyang yod pa'i gsang sngags kyi bstan pa 'di spel ba des dza drag che ba'i 'gran rtsod khrod nas slar yang rgyal kha thengs gcig blangs pa red/ 'on kyang skabs de nas bzung ste lta sgom spyod gsum gang gi thad nas kyang sangs rgyas pa gcig pu ya med lta bur chags pa'i dbang gis mu mthud legs bcos dang yar rgyas ma btang bar ma zad/ rang lta mchog 'dzin la brten pa'i rnying zhen mkhregs 'dzin gyi smyu gu zhig kyang 'bus 'go tshugs pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas 'thad sgrub kyi rigs pa mi dgos par mtshon cha la brten nas bstan pa spel mkhan gyi kla klo'i dmag dpung yul dbus su slob pa bcas rkyen ngan 'gal 'dzing gi khrod nas rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin bzhin ma bsdad par rgud pa nas rgud pa'i phyogs su chas song bar snang ngo // rmo la rjes 'jug ra la ya btags pa zhigrjod byed theg chen gyi sde snod rang ldog la dpyad na khungs ldan min pa'i tshul de ltar yin la/ brjod bya theg chen gyi rnam gzhag thun mong min pa rnams la yang /bltas na mtshar mtshar tsam las dpyad na snying po de tsam med pa'i tshor snang zhig byung ste/ theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems la mtshon na/— 195 —
phyogs dang ris su ma chad par mkha' ma nyam 'gro ba yongs kyi bde sdug la sems khur gnang ba ni dngos gnas rlabs po che yi thugs bskyed cig yin pa smos ma dgos mod/ 'gro ba'i bde sdug rang rang gi las la rag las pa'i ris pa'i gzhung 'u gas de nyid dbang btsan du byas nas bshad na/ rlabs chen gyi thugs bskyed de'ang stong bsam tsam las lag len gyi rin thang cher med cing /bdag gzhan brje ba dang bdag bas gzhan gces bsgo ma pa'i thabs lam de dag la'ang spags rang gis zos rjes thang khug mi'i mgor g.yogs pa lta bu'i g.yo sgyu'i cha zhig 'dres yod bzo 'dug ste/ rgyal kha gzhan la sprod khul byas na khe spogs rang gis len thub pa'i gnad gsang zhig rig nas de ltar bsgom pa yin 'dug pas so// rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi rtsa ba mar shes drin dran gyi gdams ngag 'di la ni gnas lugs cung tsam yang mi 'dug tshe rabs gzhan du pha ma ma byas pa'i sems can su yang med pa'i rgyu mtshan phyis yod tshad da lta'i pha ma nang bzhin brtsidagos na/ tshe rabs gzhan du dgra bo ma byas pa 'i sems can su yang med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yod tshad da lta'i dgra bo nang bzhin brtsi mi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yod/ gzhan dag rang gi pha mar gyur pa'i skabs su zas kyi phud byin/ gos kyi ces g.yogs nas byams skyong gnang ba nang bzhin rang nyid gzhan pa'i pha mar gyur skabs su yang de ltar byas yod nges pas da ni gcig gis gcig la byas yus 'don rgyu dang / sprod len bya rgyu gang yang lhag mi — 196—
'dug de ltar bas ma na mar shes drin dran khyi man ngag de sem sa can gzhan la phan 'dogs rigs pa'i shes byed du mi 'gro ba'i thog catu da lta'i pha ma'i bka' drin kyang byas pa rjes med du gtong ba'i ngan jus shig red/ ces bshad 'ong na de la lan 'debs ji ltar dgos pa kho bos mi shes par 'dus pas shes/ mkhan khyed cag la 'dri bar 'dod do// bden bzhi'i 'jug ldog dngos/ stobs kyi rigs pas 'grub pa bden na/ gsum la skyabs su ma song ba'i mu stegs pa 'a/ thar lam med pa'i rgyu mtshan mi 0ridus ste/ kho tshos kyang rigs pa'i lam nas srid rtse'i dngos gnyen rgyud la bskyed chog pa 'i phyir/ dngos po stobs zhugs la ston pa dang bsta na pa'i cha rkyen cing mi btub pa'i phyir/ des na chos 'di pa las phyi rol tu gyur pa'i mi la thar pa'i skal pa med ces zer ba ni sger gcod kyi rang gshis phyi ru mngon pa tsam du zad/ 'khrul pa'i rtsab bdag 'dzin yin pa bden na/ de'i gnyen ngo/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab gcig pus chog gi /lobs su tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong zhes pa de tsho dgos don ci yod/ las dang lus zad sogs mi dgos mi nus mi shes par bshad pa min nam/ bskal chen grangs med gsum gyi bar du sbyin dang bde gshegs mchod pa de gzhan don gzugs sku'i rgyu yin zer yang / de ltar na gzugs sku'i yon tan thug bcas su khas len 'os/ te/rgyu thug bcas thig las 'bras bu thug med cig 'ong tshan med pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas thob rjes su mchod sbyin grangs med pa zhig gnang ba de'i lag rjes su — 197 —
gzugs sku gnyis pa zhig kyang yod par 'gyur te/ slob pa'i dge mchung ngu der yang gzugs sku gcig yod na/ mi slob pa'i dge rtsa rlabs po che de bar ma do ru chud 'dza' ba 'os ma yin pa'i phyir/ des na skabs rer sems rtogs na ye shes yin par bstud pa dang /: skabs rer tshogs ma rdzogs na sangs rgyas mi thob par bshad pa de dag kyang nang 'gal can gyi rnam gzhag tu nges so/ཿ/ bsam pa dge dang mi dge'i bye brag las dge smyug gzugs brnyan che chung gi rjes su mi 'gro ba'i langs phyogs 'dis don dngos su kun spyod la bag chags ngan pa zhig bzhag yod de/ nang bi kun slong gang yim ni su la yang gsal cha med pas kun slong bzang po yod khul gyis spyong ngan 'khrab tshad la gzhan pas stangs 'dzin bya thabs bral bas so// lhag par du ku/sang sngags lugs la rtogs pa'i gdeng dang ldan na lung pa dmar por bsgyur yang rang lag yin pa'i khrims lugs 'dis chos 'dul ba'i lugs kyi dmangs gtso dang 'dra mnyam/ drang bden bcas/ kyi sa bon yod tshad cad nas phyungs tri/nga rmang nas bsgyel/ khrims lugs 'dis bla 'o/ dang gong ma rnam pa'i mdzad spyod la tshad 'dzin cung tsam yang med par dmigs bsal ster rkyang byas pas/ khong rnam tsho'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rnam par thar pa la rul dri dang skyur dri 'thul ba'i rtsab klu yul nas tshugs shing rtsemo lha yul du rgyas pa red/ mtshog gi spru la sku'i rnam thar gyi skor la/ 'das pa'i dus su sangs rgyas 'od sru nga zhu ba de 'dra gtan nas byon ma myong zhing / ma — 198 —
'ongs pa'i dus su 'ang sangs rgyas byam sa pa zhu ba de 'dra 'apyon rgyu yo da pa'i shes byed phra mo tsam yang med/ da lta'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa khong la ya ba yum sra sa sros med/ sha khrag rus pa med/ bu ga dang khong stong med/pa 'khyag rgyu lto gas rgyu med/ na rgyu tsha rgyu med/ 'chi rgyu rgas rgyu med/ de dag yod tshad tshul bstan dang cho 'phrul tsam yin zhes pa 'dis don du ston pa sangs rgyas mi gral nas phud de lha sgrung khrod kyi mi sna ru bsgyu ra ba yin/ mi zhig yin phyin chad yab yum dang sku lus 'das grongs bcas med thabs med pa'i phyir/ rgyal po zas gtsang ni rgya bal mtshams kyi rgyal phran chung chung zhig yin pas / khong gi mnga' zhabs yongs su bud med na chung ma brgyad khri bzhi stong yod med kyang the tshom tsam yin na/ rgyal sras don grub la btsun mo brgyad khri bzhi stong 'jog rgyu'i cha rkyen ga la 'dzoms/ston pa'i thugs rgyud du shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen med kyang skyon du mi che ste// ring por mthong ba'am min yang rung // 'dod pa'i de nyid mthong ba yi/na// 'di yis srin bu'i grangs mkhyen pa// nged la 'gar ya nga nyer mkho med/ces bden bzhi'i blang dor thabs dang bcas pa ste dgos pa'i don kun mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen yod na thar 'dod kyi bsam don 'grub par ma bshad dam/dkyil yangs kyi bsam blo 'di tsam zhig yod na yang snod bcud kyi chags dbyibs dang / phra rdul gyi grub tshul sogs kyi thad nas chos tshan gnyis mi 'grig bzhin du mgo sbrel byed pa'i thugs khur 'o brgyal de 'dra myong dgos don rtsa ba — 199—
nas med/ nyan thos sde pas rnam mkhyen gyi go don ched du gzigs na gang yang mkhyen thub pa zhig tu 'dod cing / de yang nyin lan gsum mtshan lan bsum ste nyin mtshan dus drug tu 'jig rten khams 'dir gzigs nas sems can su ni dar/ su ni rgud sogs zhib 'jug gnang ste las don sgrub pa zhig yin par bshad pa 'di nyid don la gnas min gang ltar yang rnam gzhag cung zad bab chags pa zhig red/ lhag par du sde pa'i lugs la ston pa mya ngan las 'das rjes chos 'dul ba nyid kyis ston pa'i rgyal tshab dang bstan pa dam chos gnyis rma'i go chod dgos pa ma gtogs/ ston pa sangs rgyas rang ngos nas ye shes dang phrin las thams cad rgyun chad 'gro bar 'dod pa'i grub mtha' 'di ltos bcas kyis bshad na cung brtan brling can zhig yin/ de min theg chen pa'i lugs ltar sangs rgyas snga ma gcig kho na'i mdzad phrin yang nam mkha' ltar kun la khyab cing bstsal pa ji srid bar du tshar rgyu med pa zhig yin tshe/ sangs rgyas phyi ma tsho 'byon pa la dgos nus spu tsam mi 'dug ste/ sangs rgyas snga ma des bsgrub mi thub cepa dang / mi tshar ba'i las ka sna gcig lag tu 'ong rgyu med pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas phyi ma tsho nam yang lag pas lag pa bcangs te kha rog ger 'dug dgos par 'gyur ro// mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi zhal nas/ 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams de rgya gar tsha ba'i lung pa nang bzhin dus bzhi dbyer med sngo theng nge bar yod pa ni zhing khams de 'dzugs skrun 'char 'god gnang —200—
mkhan rgya gar ba'i mi yin pa'i rkye na gyis red la/ nges pa lnga ldan gyi longs sku de rgya gar ba'i yul mi'i cha lugs nang bzhin dar gyi stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dang / rin po che'i rkang gdub lag gdub gyon nas bzhugs yod pa ni longs sku de rgya gar gyi mi yi sku skye yin pas red/ des ribs 'gres nas rgya nag pa'i mi zhig longs sku thob pa'i dbang du btang na 'os ag tshom ring po zhig bzhag ste gser 'brug ris kyi ber chen zhig gyon nas sdod par nges la/ bod mi zhig shi nas 'og min du skyes pa'i dbang du btang na khos dpag bsam shing gi lo mar 'dod 'ango'i ba mare sbyar ba'i dkrug ja zhim po zhig 'thung bzhin bsdad yod rgyu red/ ces gsungs/ pa 'dis theg chen pa'i lugs kyi sku dang zhing khams yod tshad kye dbu la thog brgyab pa yin mod/ khong gi rjes 'jug tu rlom pa'i bstan 'dzin rnam pas de don zur tsam yang ma dgongs par da dung srog bcad sa la bla 'khor nas lus yod pa 'dra/ ston pa shākya thub pa khong bzang po'i bskal pa 'di la slar yang byang chub snying por gshegs pa'i tshul tsam bstan pa yin gyi/don du 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bla na med pa'i go 'phang mngon du byas zin/zhes pa'i skad cha zhig theg chen pa'i khrod du khyab 'dug pa 'di ni shin tu ma legs pa zhig ste/ de ltar na gsar du lam la bslab nas phyis su sangs rgyas thob pa'i mtshan gzhi 'jog rgyu mi rnyed par 'dug pa'i phyir/ ngo mtshar dang ya mtshan gyi gtam la ha cang rngam drags na don dngos kyi rin thang thams cad 'di ltar —201—
phyir rtogchud zos su 'gyur 'gro/ skad cha 'di'i thusas rkyen ngan pa nga tsho'e rgyud la 'gos tshabs shin tu che ste/ bla ma su zhig gi rnam thar 'go btsugs ma thag tu/ kho bo cag gi 'dren pa thugs rje can 'di nyid nges pa'i don du bskal chen grangs (med du ma'i snga rol nas sangs rgyas su zin yang / drang don gdul bya'i snang ngor slar yang theg nga rim 'dzeg gi mdzad pa 'di dang 'di lta bu bstan/ zhes pa'i che brjod 'di 'dra zhig cis kyang byed ngagos shing / de ltar min par tshe /'di rang la bslab nas mkhas dang grub pa'e go 'phang thob par byas na de ni shin tu rlabs chung zhing pha la cher smad pa'i gnas lta bur bzhi 'di 'dra'i goms srol la brten nas cung zad skad grags/ yod pa'i mi sna yod tshad lha 'dre gdon bgegs gang rung zhig gi tsho 'phrul du brtsis te/ mes dbon rnam gsum rigs sasum mgon po dang / 'u dum btsan po bdud 'dre'i glang gog rgya nag gong ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ dbyin ji'i rgyal mo rje btsun sgrol ma / a ri'i srid 'dzin 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa bcas yin rgyur thag bcad/ 'u cag ni sha dang khrag las grub pa'i skye bo tha mal pa yin pas kho tsho ltar ga la yong zhes rang gis rang la mgo lcag tsha ber ba re bzhus te sus kyang ma bskul bar bran 'bangs kyi brtul zhugs dang du blangs/ gzhan pas nga la de tsam gyis gus 'dud ma byas kyang chog ces mar la gnang ba byin yang / phran chung ngas khyed la gus 'dud rab gcig ma zhus na ga la 'grig ces yar la zhu ba phul nas pus mo thang la —202—
rtog ge pa'i mig nang gi chos lugs kyi 'jig rten/btsugs shing mgo bo brang khar phab ste sdod par spro ba'i rang cag gi da lta'i mi gshis sdug po 'di nyid bskyed cing bsring ba yin no// de ltar brjod gzhi po ste lnga las brtsams te brjod bya sangs rgyas chos lugs la rtog se'i la ma nas brgal brtags cung zad byas pa 'di ni mtshon pa tsam ste/ zhib tu na chos lugs 'di yi phyi nang bar gsum na ther 'don bya rgyu grangs med pa zhig mchis mod/ ha cang mang myo nyob pa'i rgyu las dge mtshan che ba ma mthong ba'i thog tu/ dus tshod rin po ches gtsos pa'i cha rkyen yod dgus kyang kho bor sgo kun natra/ gtug cing gtses r+b+ya ra gyur pasad ni de tsam gyis chog shes pa'i bgyi ba lhur blangs pa 0phugs ru(//bla mas bstsal ba'i chos ming 'bod phod med//pha mas gnang ba'i gces ming 'bod rgyu med//rang gis btags pa'i smyug ming mda' smyug tu//'bod pas sa byi sasar tshes dgu la sbyar//— 203 —
phyir rtog— —— —rang rtsom log rtogs snying lhos dang 'brel ba'i gtam/log rtogs snying stobs zhes pa ni ku re'i m+mu du btags pa'i dra ming zhig las rtsom yig 'di'i kha byang dngos min/ 'on kyang ming tshig 'di la yin gcig 'grel ba zhig brgyab da gos pa'i dbang du btang na/ sngon byon skyes chen dam pa gnam sa lta bu dag gi rdo rje'i spang la mtha' gcig tu ngo log cing /jirgyab bstan pa 'di gzhan pas bltas na log slobs ya nga ba zhig dang / mi lo stong tsho brgal ba'i ring la 'jig rten sus kyang thug reg ma nus pa'i rnag thum zhig gtsag gshag btang ba 'di rang ngos nas bltas na snying stobs shig yin zhes snod tshog pas ku re'i khrod du bden lugs kyang tog tsam 'dres yod/ de — 204 —
min rang rgyud kyi dgag sgrub bsam blo 'di log rtogs yin pa'i ngos len zhus pa min la/ log rtogs kyi blo rig de snying stobs su khas blangs pa'ang min pas/rjes phyogs dgag lan 'bri mkhan 'dra yod tshe/ shin tu zhib mo rnam 'thag yin [bul gyis/ thog mar log rtogs snying stobs zhes pa'i kha byang 'di mi 'thad de log rtogs yin na snying stobs yin pa 'gal ba'i phyir/ zhes sogs don med kyi rtsod rnyog de rigs slong don med ces zhu ba yin/ ma gzhi deng sang nga'i sems khams kyi gnas bab ni rtsom brgyab rgyu'i spros pa dang bral ba'i tshod du lhung yod mod/ log rtsom 'di zla ba bdun brgyad kyi yar sngon zhig nas 'bri 'go btsugs tshar bas da mjug cig ma bskyangs na ngo tsha bar sems te a na u tshugatraṭa kho na bskyon pa'i 'bras bur da char thabs chag cig grub pa'i khul yin yang / thugs kyis bab pa min par btsan gyis btsir ba'i dbang gis tshig don gnyis cha natraṭa rang gis bsam tshod tsam zhig 'khyongs mi 'dug cing // tshan pa dang ngo/ tsam ma gtogs gzhan dag la zhu dag yag po zhig kyang bya longs ma byung bar 'bri tshar rim bzhin dra thog tu spel stabs lhag tu ma 'dang sa yod srid/ de'i cha nas ha re hu re can gyi mi ngas khyed klog mkhan rnam par thog mar dgongs dag zhu ba yin/ 'on kyang rang btsugs kyi zam par rang nyid thar dgos pa'i dpe ltar brjod bya dang dzod byed gang la yang skyon dang dri ma ci zhig yod kyang 'gan khur cha tshang len nges yin pa ma gtogs khag 'dogs bya sa btsal te g.yol rtsis —205 —
min pas go ba sgra log mi len pa'i re ba yod/ nga'i gnyug sems kyi ngos nas bshad na chos lugs la dgag pa brgyab ste rtsamed du gtong dgos snyam gyi med la/ nga rang nyid chos lugs la mtha' gcig tu zhen pa log pa zhis kyang min /chos gagaso ni mi'i rigs kyi bsam pa'i zas yin pas med par gtong dgos don med nga/ra ma zad gtong thub pa zhig kyang ma red/ chos lugs ni dus ji srid kyi bar du mi yul du dar bar nges shing de srid kyi bar du mi rnams la zhabs tog bsgrub par nus/ 4mi rnams kyi nus pa la tshad yod cing re ba la tshad med/tshad med pa'i re stong kha shas chos lugs ma gtogs gzhan gang gis kyang skong ṭhi thub/ chos lugs kyi rnam gzhag la brtags shing dpyad na dpyad bzod pa zhig red mi 'dug mod/ dpyad mi bzod pa tsam gyis 'dor dgos pa'i nges pa med/ ngagos mkho yod na gnas lugs med kyang chog ste/ sgyu rtsal gyi 'jig rten de 'jig rten rdzun ṣ+yo/ zhig yin pa shes bzhin du mi tsho der 'cham 'cham 'gro bzhin ('dug pa lta bu red3/ nga rang bsam rgyu dran rgyu mang ba'i dbang gis khyed rna ma pa lta bu'i rmongaṭaṭa dad byed pa'i las dang skal pa ldan ma song yang / ngas dgos pa'i dbang gis bcos ma'i dad pa zhig byed kyin yod la// dus da lta'i bar /du phyag 'tshal ba dang skyabs 'gro 'don pa sogs chos lugs kyi byed sgo nyi ma ba]cig la'ang mtshams bzhag myong med/ byed sgo 'di dag gis nga 'u thug cing thabs zad pa'i skabs su sems gso dang rogs ram thob pa ma gtogs —206—
bgegs dang bar chad gang yang ster gyi mi 'dug lhag bsam rnam dag si/ji sgo nas chos la dad pa gnang mkhan tshor ngas mtha' ba]cig tu yi/ rang dang brtsi bkur zhu ba las 'phya smod dang khrel dgod byed kyin med la/ khong rnam pa'i lhad med dwangs gtsang gi thugs sems der ngas phog thug rtsa ba nas ga'ong 'dod med/ de bas chos lugs dkyil yangs kyi bsam blo mnga' ba'i chos ldan rkya che'i ser skya mang tshogs yongs la ngas bris pa'i log rtsom 'dis thugs su na bzos tshad tham sa cad la nongs 'gyod chen pos snying thag pa nas dgongs sel zhu ba yin/ ngas da res mi 'dod bzhin du sangs rgyas chos lugs/ kyi phyi nang yod tshad 'di lta ra caltaslog tu gtong dgos don ni/ chos lugs de chos lugs kyi/ tshad du mi 'jog par dngos yod kyi 'jig rten yod tshad chos lugs kyi kha 'og lab/ ji'og tu 'du dgos par 'dod pa'i rang re'i rgyud kyi thal mtha'i bsam blo 'di yo bsrang bya rgyu kha tsha dgos gtug yin pa dang / rang nyid chos/ dad che mdos gis mi gzhan pa'i chos dad kyi dbang cha btsan 'phrog byed mkhan gyi chos lugs sger gcod kyi mi sna de tsho'i mgo la sta re zhig ma bzhus na thabs med red ce'dug pas yin/ gong du bshad tshar ba bzhin chos lug〈ge ni 'tsho ba'i khrod du med thabs med pa zhig yin mod/ dngos yod kyi gnang don chos lugs kyis thag gcod bya thabs med/ chos lugs ni mi'i nus shugs mi slebs pa'i phyogs su bed spyod gtong rgyu zhig ma gtogs mi'i nus shugs kyi tshabs byed dngos po — 207 —
zhig gtan nas min/ da lta'i bar du nga tshos kha cho les tshig na dkon mchog dang / 'phong shig gis zos na'ang dkon mchog kho nar gsol ba 'debs pa las/ rang gi klad pa dkrug dkrug dang / lag pa 'gul skyod gtong myong med/ rna lam la ma song na 'das pa'i mi lo stong phrag gi ring 'u tshang la mkhas pa gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu byon nas gsung rtsom brag ri bcig bcig byas yod kyang /mi chos ring lugs kyi mkhas pa gcig kho na dang / 'tsho thabs ston pa'i glesas bam kher ru ma zhig bgrang rgyu med pa 'di ci zhig gis ma nyan pa red bsam blo thongs shig nga tsho'ang mi lus blangs tshar bas mi tshe skyel stangs kyi rig gzhung cig ci la mi mkho/ yin na'ang nga tsho chos lugs kyis bzi drags pas yar mar gang la yang bsam blo ma btang bar da lta'i bar du nag thom mer lus song ba red/ nga4khu 'ji ltar bshad pa pha mes yang mes rnam par le bda' dang / khong rnam tsho'i rus pa la khrims chad gtong dgos zer ba min/ nga tshos lo rgyus kyi bslab bya blangs nas 'a ma nor ldog shes dgos zhes skul ma byed pa yin/ chos gzhung khrod kyi tshad ma'i skyes bu dang / mchog gi sprul sku sogs ya mtshan can gyi rnam gzhag 'di dag mi rnams kyi mos pa dang re ba tsam gyi tshad du bzhag nas dang pa dang yid ches byas pa yin na dgag pa brgyab dgos don ci yang med mo/da/ nga tshos de dag dngos yod kyi 'jig rten du ped spyod yod pa'i dngos po zhig tu rlom nas gcig gcig gnyis gnyis lag bltar byed kyin 'dug de'i —208—
rang rtsom log rtogs snying stobs dang 'brel ba'i gtam/— bang gis sangs rgyas chos gzhung du tshan rig gi tshabs byed thub pa'i dngos po / gcig med bzhin du tshan rig pas gang shes chos lugs pas shes yod ces nyang lab brgyab pa dang / byis pa snabs lug cig la sangs rgyas gson po zhes /'i ming skam zhig btagasabanas tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi blo gtad hril po bcol ba cags ma 'os pa dang ma 'tsha4/sa pa'i las lam 'di dag dar ba red/ chos sprugs kyis bsam blo'i rang dbang 'phros med rabs bco brgyad brjod bzhin radug mod 'phrog yod pa ngas myong ba mngon sum gyis grub pa yin/ nga 4 skyes phyob kyi shes rab dkyus ma'i nang gi ches dkyus ma zhig las med cing / mi tshe redir slob sbyong byas tshad bsdoms bzhag na mi lo drug zin min tsam yin/ de'i nga la yang sngon gyi mkhas pa'i rnam thar nang bzhin nyin mtshan ngo mi shes pa'i sprubad brtson de 'dra'i cha yi cha shas tsam yang 'jon ma song / 'on kyang rang dbang gi blo kha sangs rgyas chos gzhung la bskor ba tsam gyis ma 'dang sa dang ma 'grig sa btsimi thon pa tsam mthong 'ong gi 'dug / 'o na sngon gyi mkhas pa mi tshe thos pa la zad pa'i sbyangs pa can/ bka' 'gyur thugs thog nas thon pa'i blo rig can/ rnge btsun 'jam dbyangs kyang yid smon shor dgos pa'i mkhyen rab can de tshos/ chos lugs 'di'i zhan cha spu tsam mthong ma thub pa de bsam blo'i rang dbang med pa'i skyon min na dbu sa 'og tu bcug cing spyan btsums nas bzhugs pa'i skyon yin nam/ bod kyi mkhas grub chen po kurma pa/ sa skya pa/ tsong kha —209 —
pa sogs yod do cog ro sngon la phud nas skar ma rjes la lta malan rkyang rkyang ma gtogs/ bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du legs par brtags shing dpyad rjes da gzod dang du blangs pa'i rnam thar su zhig la mjal rgyu yod/ dge ldan pa'i gral gdan steng du sdod tshad kyis rje tsong kha pa la rdzun tshig mi srid par 'dod cing / snga rabs pa'i lus blangs tshad kyis rje tsong kha pa ni rdzun gyi rkyal pa zhig tu rtsisrol yod/ de yang nged tshang la phyogs rgyug mkhan ma gtogs rang tshugs zin pa'i mi med song bas lan pa red/ sangs rgyas chos lugs la sger gcod kyi rang gshis med pa bden na/ so so'i bsam tshul shod malan gyi mi re 4nyis rig ma thag chos pa tsho'i ngo gdong de ja mdzo bco brgyad chu la shor song ba ltar ci la log 'gro ba red/ mi 'khyag kha nas smras kyang 'khyag 'dar lus la rgyug ces po ltar nga tsho'i bsam blo gu yangs los de nga tsho rang gi ngo gdong 'dis gsal bshad byed kyin mi 'dug gam/ nye char zhogs dung sogs kyis kyang sangs rgyas chos lugs la brten nas 'jig rten 'tsho ba'i gnad don thag gcod mi thub par bshad pa tsam las/ chos lugs rang ngos kyi rin thang ngo ma ste gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag gang la yang sdug nad mi khyag pa'i dgag pa tshabs chen zhig brgyab mi 'dug mod/ gnam 'og 'dir nga min na su yin snyam pa'i rang mthong can gyi rang re'i mkhas pa de tshos/ sangs rgyas chos lugs med na 'dzam gling 'di tshar 'gro tshul dang / sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi nang du — 210—
ma 'dus pa'i shes bya sna gcig med tshul dang / lta chul gsar pa de rigs la ra ma zhig gi rin bab kyang med tshul sogs 'ar 'jun dang rdzig gtam kho nas zhogs dung sogs sa 'og gi 'jig rten du brdzangs 'gro la khad byed kyin 'dus chos pa de tshos rlabs rgyag rgyu mang drags pa'i dbang gis/ zhogs dung sogs kyes kyang rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi thog nas bshad na sangs rgyas chos lugs 'dir ljid gog rab gcig yod rgyu red snyam mas zhed snang langs bzhin yod pa 'dra/ don dngos su rigs pa'i lam nas brtag na yang sangs rgyas chos lugs 'di chos pa tshos bshad pa nang bzhin skyon kun zad dang yon tan kun ldan zhig rtsab nas ma red la/ rang re'i mkhas pa rnam pa ni rigs lam skam po kho nar 'dres shing 'grogs nas 'tshar longs byung ba zhig yin stabs/ risas lam gyi thog nas ya lan nan po zhig ma 'phrod na kho tsho'i rgyud kyi blun sprobs de nam ya nga gzhom mi thub/ de bas da res kho bos srol rgyun gyi rigs pa'i 'gro stangs de rang gzhir bzhag gi thog nas chos lugs 'di'i nang snying cha tshang phyi ru brus pa yin la/ da dung dus ji srid du rang re'i chos lugs 'dis sger gcod kyi rang gshis ngan pa 'di ma bskyur ba dang / rang re'i chos pa tshos rang lta mchog 'dzin gyi bsam blo rengs po 'di ma dor ba dang / chos lugs kyi dad mos nge mi sger gyi gnad don zhig tu ma chags pa'i dus de srid du/ nga tshos nga tsho'i chos lugs 'di dgra bo'i dwangs mar brtsis te ya nga snying rje med pa'i sgo canas dgag — 211 —
rgyag dang 'thab rtsod bya dgos/ de la brten nas phyogs zhen can gyi chos pa tsho ma dga' nas gas song na'ang 'dra/ ma sgyid nas shi song na'ang 'dra/ nga tshos sems gso dang gu yangs gtong tshod med/ phyogs zhen can gyi chos pa tshos nga tsho la lta log dam nyams/ bstan bshig sogs kyi ming ngan 'dogs shing dmyal ba zangs dmar ma'i mthil du 'byar 'gro tshul sogs kyi 'jigs snang skul bzhin yod mod/ nga tshos ming ngan 'di dag dga' bzhin dang du len 'dod cing / dmyal ba zangs dmar ma'i mthil du spro bzhin 'gro bar phod/ skad cha 'di dag gis nus pa ma thon pa shes rjes/ kho tshos deng sang dmar srung mi sna dang /srid gzhung gi rgyug khyi/ dngul lo'i bran g.yog a ma'i nu ma 'cha' mkhan sogs dpyid nyi ring mo la dran mi dgos ston gnam khra mo la rmis kyang ma myong ba'i nag nyes dang gleng phyogs snying la gri yog pa lta bu re bzo 'ong gi 'dug nag nyes dang gleng phyogs ji tsam mang ba de tsam gyis nga tsho'i 'gro stangs 'di 'grig bsdad yod pa'i dpang rtags bstan pa yin/ rgyu mtshan ni nga tshos mi ma bsad/ rta ma bcag bla ma btsongs na yang dran tshul kha nas thal ba tsam gyis nga tshos nag nyes 'di tsam zhig khur dgos byung ba red/ 'dis nga tsho'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab ni ma rung pa zhig dang / nga tshos ma rung ba'i gnas bab 'di la rgol 'dzing byed pa ni don snying ri bas kyang che nges pa'i dngos ra 'phrod pa yin/ chos lugs kyi lta ba tog tsam mthun min byung 'phral kho tshos mi rigs kyi brtsesems skyag pa — 212—
bskyur bskyu ra byas nas nga tsho phyir 'bud gtong thabs byed kyin 'dug 'dis kyang don du su zhig gis mi rigs dang rgyal khab 'tshong rtsis yod pa shes thub/mdor bsdus nas bshad na da sngon kho tshos btsan tshod zin ma song bas da res btsan tshod med sa la brdab pa red/ rgyu mtshan rgyu mtshan zer mkhan de tsho da ni rgyu mtshan la g.yol nas ma 'dug cig dgag rtsom 'di la lan ma byung na lan ma thebs pa las ma btab pa'i gras su brtsorgyu min/ tshig spu btog la dga' ba'i dge ldan pa tshos tshig skyon thongs/ don dmar 'ju la mkhas pa'i rnying ma pa tshos don skyon tshol/ yul la dgra byung na rnga 'byar khyi yin na'ang zug dgos pas 'chugs mi nyan/ lhag par du bstan pa'i nang snying don dam stong nyid kyi skor nas gleng dang / khyed tshos phyogs 'di nas shor na shor ba yin la/ nga rang phyogs 'di nas ska rags mi bor ba pho ba la yid ches yod/ log rtogs snying stobs brgya cha'i lnga bcu yan chod tshar gcod thub mkhan zhig byung tshe/ ngas mi lo sum cu kha lhag gi ring la rtsam pa tshod med cig zos pa de yongs rdzogs 'phro brlag tu song ba'i gsal bsgrags spel nges yin/ spyir bstan pa dpang du btsugs nas rtsod pa brgyab pa dang / rtsod pa shor tshe bstan bcos khyi yi rnga mar btags shing / rtsom mkhan gyi lag pa gcod pa sogs ni shin tu gu dog pa'i las stangs yin pas/rig gnas dkyil yangs kyi khor yug na skad cha btsog pa 'di rigs nam yang 'chad mi 'os kyang / nga tsho'i rna rtsar skad cha btsog tsam ma bshad na go brda mi —213—
'phrod par 'dug go/ 'di dag gtso bo mkhan po tshul khrims blo gros mchog la zhus pa yin/ mkhas dbang khong gi sku gsung thugs gsum gyi yon tan la nga rang dga' zhing gus pa la ni tshod gcig med mod/ ngan mtshang yod rgu shi sbas ro sbas gnang ba'i khong gi rigs zhen chos zhen de la nga de tsam mi dga' zhing /ngas bos pa'i gtam la ya lan zhig yong ba'i re ba'ang khong gcig pu la che bas yin/ de 'og a mdo'i skad du a lags dor zhi zhu ba'i skya bo chos smra zhig 'dug pa de la'ang springs pa yin/ khong ni bod snga phyi gnyis kyi bar na yang chags sdang me ltar 'bar ba'i phyogs ris can zhig yin pas/ gdon 'dre mi yul du slob pa lta bu'i kho bo gzigs pa yin na 'phag 'tshag stobs can zhig brgyab rgyu los yod 'dod pa yin/ de min ldong yon tan dang klu tshang rgya grol sogs la yang go tsam byed dgos yod/ yin na'ang kho tsho'i gras kyis kho bor ya lan tsha mo zhig 'phrod e yong snyam pa'i re dogs gang yang byed kyin med/ da dung ming ma smos kyang su zhig gi mtshang du phog pa'i mi de dag rang rtsom log rtogs snying stobs 'di'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya dang / dgra bo gnyis ka yin pas de kun la tshag sgra dang tshig sgra ci tsam grag rgyu 'dug kho bos nyan rna dang ngang sgug byas nas bsdad yod do//sa byi dang po'i gnam gang nyin mor bris/—214—
zhogs dung gi gdong grogs/lung gi ljid gog mi che zhing //rigs pa'i rno so mi chung ba'i//phas rgol 'joms pa'i mtshon cha 'di//stabs bde deng rabs can zhig yin//thog ma'i sems bskyed/'dzam gling thog gi chos lugs chen po gsum gyi ya gyal sangs rgyas chos lugs 'di ni/ mi lo nyis stong lnga brgya'i yar sngon gyi gna' bo'i dus shig tu rgya gar dang bal po'i mtshams su dbu brnyes shing / rim gyis rgya bal gli yul gru tsam — 215 —
las brgal te phyogs dang phyogs su dar khyab phyin pa'i nang nas/ rgya nag dang /༈kho re ya phyed gling / nyi hong gling tshom sogs su dar ba la shar brgyud nang bstan dang / 'bar ma// the lan di/ wed nam/ nyin rnyu nyi zhi ya sogs su dar ba la lho brgyud nang bstan/ bal po dang 'brug yul brgyud nas bod dang hor sog gi yul du dar ba la byang brgyud nang bstan nam bod brgyud nang bstan zhes 'bod/deng sang chos brgyud mi 'dra ba de gsum gyis grub pa'i chos lugs 'di la dad gus dang yid ches zhu mkhan mi grangs dung phyur kha shas shig yod par grags/ de dag gi nang nas bod brgyud nang bstan 'di nyid kyis 'das pa'i mi lo chig stong sum brgya'i ring la dbu thog tu gnam dang / spyan snga ru phyag snyan lam du bstod pa rkyang rkyang ma gtogs med par byas te bod mi rigs hril po dam la btags shing dbang du bsgyur nas bzhugs yod/ gnas tshul 'di ni yul gru gzhan dang / mi rigs gzhan/ chos brgyud gzhan pa gang zhig gi khrod du'ang mthong dkon pa'i byung ba ya mtshan can zhig yin/ de bas bod brgyud nang bstan dang bod mi rigs gnyis po rkya bsgril te gleng skabs/ mtha' 'khor gyi mi rigs gzhan dang / chos brgyud gzhan dag bar ṣ+ṭi 'brel bas spar bkab gnang na de tsam 'os shing 'tsham po med pa 'di thog mar shes dgos pa'i don dag gal chen zhig yin/ mi yi rigs kyi rkang pa gnyis po brgya lo nyer gcig pa'i nang du slo 'go tshugs pa tsam nas bzung / srol dang lugs las brgal ba'i bod — 216—
pa'i na gzhon kha shas kyis/ bod brgyud nang bstan gyi bla na med pa'i khe dbang yod tshad la thengs dang por phyir rtog dang skyon 'dogs byed 'go brtsams/ de dang dus mtshungs su dang po nyid nas cha rkyen ci yang med par sa ngas rgyas chos lugs la mgo 'bul lus 'bul zhus zin pa'i chos lugs de'i bka' yi pho nya dang / las kyi sne mo bar gtogs pa dag gis ni na gzhon de tsho bstan dgra dang /dam nyams sogs su brtsis te tshar gcod dang tshur bsdu'i phyag las sna tshogs rab dang rim pa spel/ da lta ni gnad don de tshabs je cher phyin te khyod shi nga gson lta bu'i bsam blo'i 'thab 'khrug rgyag bzhin pa'i sgang yin/ bye brag tu 'thab 'khrug de'i nang du dbang med du tshud cing / mnar gcod dang rdung rdeg rim pa mang po brgyud nas yong ba'i kho bo la mtshon na/ bsam blo ji tsam btang ba de tsam gyis tshul 'chos dang brdzu bag gi gsob nas phyir don te/ gang dran kha nas bzhur ba'i mi kha ri kha thug cig bya rgyu'i 'dod pa je bas je cher song zhing /dus da lta'i bar du ci mdzad legs mthong dang / ci gsung tshad 'dzin/ thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi dad pa dag t+na nga kho nas gtsug tu khur zhing / phug tu bshams pa'i rang re'i pha nor 'di la/ da cha phyogs gzhan pa zhig nas bskyar zhib cig dgos pa ni kha tsha dgos gtug gi gnad don yin pa'i nges shes gting nas rnyed/ de 'dra'i bskyar zhib kyi las de'ang kho bo lta bu mi drang mo zhig dang / rgyus yod cig gis phrag tu blangs na ma gtogs/ mig yod kyang blta mi —217—
phod pa dang /ཿ blta 'dod kyang mi ga ldongs pa'i ri de dag gis 'i nus re bral bar mthong nas/ tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi bya gzhag rlabs po che gzhan yod tshad blos btang ste don 'dir 'jug rgyu'i sems thag gcod rgyur byung song / de bas da thengs kho bos lta log pa zhogs dung sogs kyi rgyab tu langs nas/ lta log pa zhogs dung sogs kyis tshig gi dngos lan ma thebs par lus pa'i bstan dgra tshar gcod kyi bstan bcos kha cig la tshig gi dngos lan zhig btab ste/ bstan bcos rtsom pa po'i bstan srung de tsho'i thugs sems chu nang du dbyug rgyu dang /dngos yod kyi spyi tshogs dang lag len gyi khrod du sangs rgyas chos lugs kyis bzhag pa'i bag chags ngan pa 'ga' re gtsang bsher gyis ther 'don bya rgyu yin/de min gnas lugs rang ngos nas sangs rgyas chos lugs 'dir rin thang dang /ljid tshad ji tsam yod med ni rigs lam dpang du bcol te zur du bgro 'dod yod pas 'dir dmigs kyis gling bar mi bya'o//skyes chen gser nag gi ri 'dra ba zhig gi gsung la dpyad pa/deng sang bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'di yi phyi nang gnyis su/ bod mi yongs kyi gtsug gi nor bu lta bu'i rlabs chen gyi ded dpon gcig dang / rna ba'i rgyan du gyur pa'i slob dpon chen po rnam pa gnyis te/ zhal bzhugs pa'i nges don gyi skyes bu dam pa gsum yod pa'i nang nas/ rna ba'i rgyan gnyis kyi ya —218—
gyal lam sa bla rung lnga rig chos grwa chen mo'i mkhan po mkhas dbang tshul/ khrims blo gros mchos gis/ bag chags dong sprug mgo 'bus ma thag nas tshar gcod par rtsom gnang ba'i rtsod yig skad grags can de la/ da res gas pas shes tshod kyi gsung lan nyung bsdus shig 'bul 'dod 'dug spyir mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan phun sum tshogs shing / byang sems rlon pa ches/ mtshan du gsol kyang ngo gnong mi dgos pa'i dam pa khong la kho bo lta bus yid 'a/zugang dran dang / kha nas gang thon brjod de 'gog rgol byed pa ni 'os med yin nges kyang / gnas lugs kyi mdun du su la yang dmisas bsal med pa'i mdon nyid yid la bcangs te/ spro sa bstud/ yams bshad/ 'khyog bshad/ rdzun bshad sogs min pa'i drang po'i bsam 'char thung ngu zhig 'bul ba la/ ha cang 'gal 'dzol che rigs yod mi srid snyam nas dpa' bskyed de zhu ba lags pas/ thugs dmigs pa med pa'i sgo nas snya na dar gcig gtad par zhu/ zhogs dung gis bris pa'i bag chags dong sprug las/ nga tsho rgud pa'i rtsa ba de gzhan du med par nga tsho rang steng gi bag chags ngan pa 'di rang yin zhes bshad pa de khyed thugs kyi zur tsam la yang ma babs par phyogs snga kun gyi thog ma ru bkod gnang 'dug des na gus pas kyang thog mar 'di'i thad nas sku nyid la ba7'a 'dri dgongs skor zhig zhus na bsam/ 'das pa'i mi lo brgya phrag kha thas/ ring gi 'dzam gling gi 'pho 'gyur dang / 'phel rgyas kyi lo rgyus 'khu phyir gzigs rags —219
tsam zhig gnongs dang / sa chen yongs kyi mi grangs kyi brgya cha'i bdun cu yas mas zin srid pa'i lho a h+phe ri kha dang / shar e sha ya'i gling chen thog gi mi rnams kyis dus tshod de tsam gyi ring la/ mi yi rigs la ngom du ri ba'i legs skyes sna gcig 'bul ma thub 'dug pa 'di don dam par ci zhig gis lan pa red/ che ba 'jig rten 'phur gru dang / glog gi klad pa nas bzung ste/ phra ba cha rdul gyi nus shugs dang / gzugs med rlabs phran gyi bar/ yang na deng sang nga tshos kyang yin shag shag dang / stabs bde mdog kha pos nyin rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod du bed spyod gtong bzhin pa'i rlangs 'khor/ sbag sbag rkang 'khor/ rlung 'phrin/brnyan 'phrin/ kha par/ tha na chu tsha po 'dug byed kyi tsha dem yan chad nyer spyod kyi yo byad yod tshad nub byang gi mi de tshos dka' las brgyab nas rnyed pa dang /'char gzhi 'then nas bzos pa sha stag red zer/ spyi tshogs tshan rig gi khyab khongs chab srid kyi lam lugs la mtshon na/ sngon gad rmi lam du'ang 'khor ma myong ba'i rang dbang dmangs gtso'i lam srol gyi ka ba chen po gsum du grags pa'i khrims bzo/ khrims skyong / khrims zhib bcas kyi sgrig gzhi gtan 'bebs dang / mi lo sto nga phrag ring gi bran g.yog lam lugs rtsagator/ 'gro ba mi'i thob thang yongs khyab gsal bsgrags/ chos lugs dad pa rang mos kyi dbang cha sogs da lta rang re la longs su spyod rgyu med kyang / rna bas zar zur re thos rgyu yod pa'i bya gzhag rlabs po che de dag yod tshad/ nub dang byang gi mi de tshos khrag dang —220—
'osas dung ṅga gdong grogs /dngul chu phangs med du gtor te brtson len byas pa'i 'bras bu yin skad 'dug mtshan snyan nam yang mi nub pa'i rang byung tshan rig si slob dpon chen mo brgya stong khri phrag mang po'e mtshan tho'i nang du/ rang re'i phyogs nas mi gcig kho na'i ming tho ma gtogs 'god rgyu med/ mi gcig po de ni shar phyogs kyi skar ma 'od chen zhes 'bod pa bar rdul gsar rnyed malan gyi nyi hong gi r+ya khas pa zhig yin/khong yang yul de ga'i bsam blo pa grags can h+phu khri rdza ba yo khri chi sogs kyis mig nub gling la bltas te bsam blo'i bcos bsgyur dang / me rje'i lugs bsgyur sogs chab srid kyi bcos bsgyur rab dang rim pa mang po byas zin pa'i rjes te dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus dkyil du gzhi nas byon pa tsam red/ 'di ltar bsam blo gtong dus nga tshos rang che rkub 'bur bya rgyu bskyur te/ nub gling pa'i mdun du pus mo gtsugs nas phyag 'tshal dgos pa'i tshad du thon yod/ 'o na mi dang mi'i bar la shi gson thug pa lta bu'i bar khyad chen po 'di 'dra zhig shor dgos pa'i don dag 'di gang la thug yod mkhas dbang khyed kyis gcig gsung gnongs dang / gnas sdod bya yul la go la shar nub dang / lho byang gi khyad par yod pas red dam/ gnas sdod byed mkhan la sha mdog dkar nag ser gsum gyi khyad par yod pas red/ yang na mgo skra ser nag gi khyad par dang / mig 'bradra/ kong du rdib min dang / sna rtsothur du gug cing zags min gyis sam/ khrag rigs la ka pa dang / kha pa'i khyad par 'dra yod pas red/ yang na nga tsho'i chos dang rig — 221—
gzhung gi 'grel bshad rgyag stangs ltar byas na/ 'dzam gling shar nub kyi mi yi bar la skye ba sngon mar tshogs bsags ma bsags dang / blo sbyangs ma sbyangs kyi khyad par 'dra yod pa e yin/ a h+phe ri kha gling dang / e sha ya gling gi mi rnams skye ba snga mar dud 'gro nas shi 'phos te 'dir skyes pa yin pas rang bzhin gyis glen zhing lkugs pa dang / yo rob gling dang / a me ri kha gling gi mi de tsho lha dang mi nas shi 'phos te mi yul 'dir skyes pa yin pas blo gsal zhing rig pa rno ba red ces gsung rgyu e yod/ de min na sngon chad rgyang 'phen pa zer ba zhig gis ci zhig 'tshad pa red ces shod srol yod pa ltar/ rgyu rkyen ci yang btsal du med pa dang / gnas lugs gang yang bshad du med par ngo bo nyid las byung ba'i rang byung gi snang tshul tsam yin zhes gsung na e mi drag gal srid de dag gang yang min par bsam blo'i 'khyer so ste/ 'jig rten lta tshul dang / mi tshe'i lta tshul/ rin thang lta tshul/ mdzes dpyod lta tshul bzhi po 'di ma 'dra ba'i dbang gis byung ba yin na ni/ zhogs dung gi bag chags dong sprug de nag thig gi thog tu brgyab bzhag pa ma red dam/ mkhyen rab dang thugs rje can khyed kyi thugs sems de drang por bsrangs nas thugs bsam bskyar ma zhig bzhes par lu gri ba 'di la ni dam pa khyed kho na tsam min par rnying pa srung zhing gsar pa gsod pa'i ched du bsam bzhin skye ba bzhes pa'i skyes bu de tsho yod tshad kyis mthong thag chod pa'i lan 'debs bya dgos yod/ de ltar ma byung phyin dam bca' nyams shing —222—
grub mtha' shor ba yin pas phyin chad gdong la 'bag gyon nas 'cham rgyag par ma yong zhig ces tha tshig bsgrags pa yin no//rna ba'i rgyan cig shos ni blo bzang bstan 'dzin rin po che ste/ khong gis mi rigs 'di la phyag rjes ri rab las che ba zhig bzhag dang 'jog bzhin yod/kun gzhi bde gshegs snying po dang / 'khor rtsam rig pa nas bzung ste/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi bar gyi grangs su bgrang ba 'di dag gis/ dam pa lha chos kyi mgo nas rnga ma'i bar gyi bsdus gzugs de legs par mtshon thub 'dug na/ de dag chos kyi rnam grangs brjod pa'i deb chung sogs dpe deb gang zhig nas bshus min de gleng dgos pa'i gnad don ci yang ma red snyam/ 'dis don du zhogs dung gis chos kyi rnam grangs brjod pa'i deb chung zhig kha phye myong ba tsam kho na ma gtogs/ gzhan chos lugs la cha rgyus spu tsam yang med ces zur za gnang ba yin 'dug zhogs dung kho mi lo stong phrag kha shas ring skyes chen mkhas pa tsho res mal res rgyug gis phebs sa'i gzhung lam de nas 'gro ma myong ba bden mod/ sngon chad su yang 'gro ma phod pa'i 'dre lam mam 'phred lam zhig bzung nas phyin 'dug pas ltad mo gzhan dag las mi chung tsam zhig mthong med dam snyam/ khyod la dam pa lha chos kyi bag chags cung zad kyang yod tshod mi 'dug pas blo bde mor byas te mi sdod par/ spang bya med bzhin du spong ba'i 'bad brtson ci la byed pa yin/ zhes bstengs shing bzhungs pa'i tshig 'di ni — 223 —
khyed nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i mkhas pa ma che dgu che zhig gi gsung dang 'dra po ye mi 'dug sangs rgyas chos gzhung du bag chags zhes pa de mi dgos bsam pa tsam gyis med 'gro ba zhig yin par bshad 'dug gam/ kun btags kyi bag chags spong ba la bskal chen grangs med gcig lhan skyes kyi bag chags spong ba la bskal chen grangs med gsum zhes zhal byang byang du 'don bzhin pa ma lags sam/ zhogs dung gi rgyud kyi bag chags de gcig pu gos badz+re po rgyag pa dang / kha ngo'i dri ma bkrus pa nang bzhin kha bral rgyur bde mo sla mo zhig yin don ci yin nam/ chung ngu'i dus su pha ma dang dge rgan sogs kyi shugs rkyen 'og chos la bag chags bzhag pa'i mi de/ gnas skabs ring lta ba log nas sangs rgyas nam mkhar 'phur yang dad pa dang / sems can rgyu ma rlugs kyang snying rje med par a pho nga dang / dbyug pa mdung zer nas 'gro 'dug mkhan zhig tu gyur song na yang / tshe smad la slobs dus sla ra bsam blo 'khor nas lag phreng ba dang / kha ma ṇi dang mi 'bral ba'i chos pa bzang po de 'drar 'gyur srid pa'am/ yang na na tsha gdon bgegs sogs rkyen ngan god chags dang 'phrad skabs da gzod rang tshugs shor nas mgo bo skur yong gi red ces shod srol 'dug 'dis chung dus rgyud la bsgos pa'i chos kyi bag chags de 'dor rgyu dang / spang rgyu ni las sla mo zhig min par bstan yod/ chos phyogs nas bshad na yang sto 'grangs nyi mas dros tshe chos pa'i gzugs// rkyen ngan thog tu bab tshe tha mal pa// zhes nam rgyun zhi — 224—
—dul bab chags can gyi chos pa mang po nyon mongs skye ba'i rkyen dang 'phrad tshe de 'phral sngar gyi rang gzugs ngo ma de slar mngon yong gi yod ces ngan phyogs kyi bsam blo spang dka' ba'i tshul yang ji ltar bshad 'dug 'tsho ba'i khrod du chang 'thung ba dang / sho rgyag pa/ dug 'then pa sogs nyi tshe ba'i goms gshis ngan lang shor ba kha cig bcos bsgyur dgos na yang khrag po gang 'dra'i mi 'dug mi zhig gi gzhi rtsa'i lta ba dang / bsam blo/ langs phyogs yongs rdzogs rtsab nas bsgyur dgos tshe de ni zhag po kha shas dang / mi lo re zung gi ring la 'grub pa'i bya gzhag cig min par bsam blo btang na ha los go mdor na zhogs dung gi rgyud kyi bag chags rnying rul de tsho zhogs dung gis tshe gang po la bkrus kyang dag thub pa zhig min par ma zad/ zhogs dung khos zhogs dung kho'i bu bu mo tshor bsgos pa'i rnying dri dang rul dri de tsho'ang zhogs dung kho'i bu bu mo de tsho'i tshe gang gi ring la yal thub dka' rgyu red snyam/ rgyu mtshan ni mi lo stong phrag gam yang na khri phrag gi ring la rdo lag brgyud byas te/ mthar zhogs dung sogs kyi pha mas zhogs dung sogs dang sha 'dres rus 'dres su bsres yod pas red/ de bas zhogs dung khos/ nga yang lha chos rig gnas kyi bag chags 'og nas 'tshar longs byung bas lha chos rig gnas kyi bag chags zab ces dang / dung zhen gyi cha nas bshad na nga tsho'i rig gnas 'di la/ khyod tsho'i dung zhen de lta bu nga la yang yod ces dang / yang sprul lam lugs mamed du gtong dgos zer na bla sprul khong rnam tsho —225 —
ma zad/ bod mi phal pa zhig yin pa'i kho bo rang la yang bzod dka' ba'i na zug 'dug ces bshad pa red/ 'gas gtor gyi mda' kha rang sems la gtod/phyi rgol gyi dbu sgo rang nyid nas brtsam/ zhes sogs bshad pa'ang bod rigs phan tshun bar la nang 'khrug rgyag dgos/ skya ser gnyis kyi bar la shog kha bye dgos sogs zer ba min/ bsam blo gsar rnying bar gyi 'gal ba de'ang zhogs dung dang mi gzhan zhig gi bar gli bsam blo'i 'gal ba min/ zhogs dung kho rang gi rgyud kyi bsam blo snga phyi bar gyi 'gal ba yin/ mda' kha gtad sa dang / 'khrug pa rgyag sa yang zhogs dung kho rang gi rgyud kyi dad pa dang dag snang sogs bag chags rnying rul de tsho yin/ mi kha cig gis/ khyod kyis rgud pa'i rtsa ba bag chags rnying pa yin par ngos zin nas/ de nyid lhag lus med par dong du sprugs tshar song bas/ da lta khyod kyi 'tsho ba la yar rgyas chen po phyin yod shag red ces co 'dri khul byed pa dang / khyod kyis dpal 'byor yar rgyas thongs dang / khyod kyi rkang 'a/ga la chos pa nga tshos sgrog brgyab med/ nga tsho'i chos gzhung du'ang bzo grwa ma btsugs/ 'phrul chas bzo mi chog ces bka' btang mi 'dug pas khyod kyis chos pa nga tsho dang / nga tsho'i chos gzhung la le bda' bya rgyu med ces zhogs dung sogs la sdigs bzhin 'dug de dag ne 'gan khur dang drang bzhag med pa'i skad cha 'ba' zhig red/ lag shes bzo las shig yin na'ang dang por slob 'dod skyes/bar du bslab cing sbya nga / mthar lobs nas lag tu bltar rjes da gzod 'tsho ba —226—
la phan thogs dgos pa yin na/ bsam blo'i dpal 'byor ni spags g.yos pa myong bzhin lam seng kha nang du brdzang chog chog cig ga la yod/ rkang lag sgrog gis bcings pa dang / kha lag 'gul bskyod mi chog pa'i btsan bka' gtong ba la dbang cha sger gcod zer/ nga tsho'i chos rig 'di dbang cha sger gcod yin par sus kyang ma bshad/ bsam blo sger gcod kyis ni/ thad sprur min par lkog gyur dang gsang ba'i sgo nas/ thabs dang 'phrul gyi sgo nas/ zhi 'jam dang lhod chags kyi sgo nas/ go ba dang bslab bya'i sgo nas/ sha tsha tsha dang snying nye nye'i sgo nas/'dra chags chags dang 'brel yod yod kyi sgo nas/ rang mos rang 'thad lta bu dang / gnyis lo drang bzhag lta bu'i sgo nas rtog dpyod dang 'tshol snyeg gi srog rtsa la bsnyab pa zhig la zer ba yin/ gong gi mi de tshos 'di 'dra'i dmigs rnam ma phyed pa'am/ phyed kyang bsam bzhin du bsnyon pa gang rung du nges so//spang bya'i bag chags la/ ya thog lha 'dre'i bag chags/ ya thog shes rig gi bag chags/ dam pa lha chos kyi bag chags/ dpe lugs sku|ma4ge srol gyi bag chags bzhi ru phye nas de dag re re bzhin ngos 'dzin rgyas 'grel dang / bod rje btsan po'i skabs kyi tshur len gyi snying stobs dang / blo gshogs sogs bzang dang dge mtshan can gyi bag chags dus da lta'i bar du ma nyams par yod pa de rnams ni mu mthud srung 'dzin byed dgos nges kyang / da sngon nga tsho bzang cha kho na gleng nas bsdad pa yin pas da res de'i phyogs nas gleng rgyu min/ zhes dong du —221—
sprug rgyu dang mi sprug rgyu'i bag chags gnyis su phye 'dug pa gzigs bzhin du ma gzigs pa'i khul gnang ste/ bag chags yin na spang bya yin pas khyab zer ram/zhes don med kyi dri ba zhig bkod pa dang / khyab na bod ska da bod yig kyang spang dgos par thal/ zhes 'brel med kyi thal 'gyur zhig kyang 'phangs 'dug pa 'di dag ni rang thugs dgyes pa'i ched du dgra lha dpung bstod gnang ba tsam du zad/ da dung 'di las kyang thal che ba'i dgag pa ngo tsha dgos pa zhig nub byang mi rigs slob gling gi dge rgan chen mo dor zhi tshang gis btang yod pa ni 'di ltar/ rnying po yod tshad bsgyur dgos na za ma kha nas za ba dang / bshang gci rkub nas 'dor ba'i srol rnying de'ang bsgyur dgos par thal/ gsar pa yin tshad sngon thon yin na deng sang gsar du thon pa'i e rdze zhes pa'i reg dug gi na tsha de'ang sngon thon yin par thal/ zhes so// khong rnying pa dang bstan pa gnyis la lhag bsam che ba la ni dpe red 'dug mod/ rdzun lab cig brgyab/ ham pa zhig bshad de bzhugs pa tsam gyis rnying pa dang bstan pa gnyis 'dzin thub dka' rgyu red ya/ rnying pa yod tshad bsgyur dgos zhes dang / gsar pa yod tshad sngon thon yin zhes 'dre zhig gis zangs sbug brgyud nas khong gi snyan khung du bskyal ba yin na ma gtogs zhogs dung phyogs gtogs dang bcas pa mi su zhig gis kyang gtam de 'dra bshad myong med do// bag chags rnying pa dong du sprug dgos/ zhes pa'i tshig 'di tsam la brten nas rigs 'phrul zhes pa'i bsdus ra ba'i lugs kyi —228—
ce /pa sbyo sbyo k+ṣiṃ ༵ ༵/rnayin ༵༵ kli rnyi /lha ༵༵ ༷༷dī ba/ ga ga~X/ 〈sna pa ༷r+shadī /ldan sus kyang khas len mi srid/ a lags 'di pa tshang sku yon shin tu che yang gzu bor cung zad kyang mi gnas pa'i mkhas dbang gug to zhig yin par kho ༷byi /( sbyo sbri k+ṣiṃ dz+nyo shinā ༵ /༷ sbyoX lha sprir+sha ñtsha snaX ñdzadī sbyozlo /me/// ༵ ba mdo khong gis kyang / bag chags dong sprug dgos na lha chos dang // mi chos bcu drug rnam bshad khyod rang yang // bag chags rnying pas bskyed pa khas blangs pas// sprug bya skyon gyi rgya las ci la thar// zhes sogs dgong shor 'ong ba'i tshigs bcad 'ga' 'bri stangs mdzad 'dug mod snying rje bar bsam/ ste re zhig bzhag go/bag chags yin ga tsam gyis spong dgos par ma nges kyang dam pa'i lha chos kyi bag chags 'di nyid nges par druṃ slong dgos te/ dam pa lha chos kyi bag chags ca'di nyid yag rabs 'jigs rabs kyi bshad pa ci 'dra zhig brgyab kyang don dngos su 'khor ba la skyon dang r+nghi/ sngi tshe la than du brtsis te de dag dang rgyang cibkyed pa'i bag chags shig red 'dug le/ mi yul gyi bde ba don du gnyer zhing 'jig rten 'iphel rgyas kyi phyogs su sha thad thang du 'bad mkhan dag la mtshon na/ bag chags 'di dang lag pa rgyab 'ogal ma gtogs 'gro sa mi 'dug ces zhus na khyed la ci zhig gsung rgyu yod/ ci yang gsung rgyu med na ni zhal nag rog — 229 —
