ger bzhugs par mdzod cig theg chen dang theg dman/ skyes bu che 'bring chung gsum sogs kyi bshad yams mang po zhig gnang 'dug pa de tsho la nus pa cung zad kyang med/ bod yul 'di ni dbu ma'i lung pa dang / bod mi yod tshad byang chub sems/ dpa' dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa rkyang rkyang yin zer ba las nga theg dman dang / nga nyan thos yin zer mkhan su yang mi 'dug zhogs dung kho theg chen bkag nas theg dman sgrub mkhan yang ma red/ khros daca/ pa lha chos kyi gzhung lugs 'dis 'jig rten 'tsho gnas kyi phyogs nas yar 'then med par mar 'then byed kyin 'dug pas dong du sprug dgos zer ba ma gtogs/ dam pa lha chos kyi gzhung nas theg chen gyi lam 'bras rkyang pa las theg dman gyi lam 'bras bstan mi 'dug pas dong du sprug dgos zer ba ga la yin/ de min na khyed kyis theg chen theg dman sogs kyi gsed bkrol gnang ba de 'dre shar sgo dang glud nub cho/ las gzhan 'gro sa ci zhib/ 'dug skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim gang yin yang 'dra/ kha skye ba phyi ma dang / de'i yang phyi ma sogs la gtad pa ma gtogs tshe 'dir 'tsho sdod ji ltar bya tshul gyi phyogs su gtad pa gcig kyang med/ mi bden snyam na phyi mar mtho ris don gnyer gyi blo la chung ngu dang / thar pa don gnyer la 'bring po/ rnam mkhyen don gnyer la chen po zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal/ yod med cha mi 'tshal ba'i mtho ris dang thar pa sogs kyi med du 'bad pa bas/ yod nges yin pa'i tshe 'di yi 'dug chus la brtson na khe che zer —230—
mkhan gyi mi zhig la/ skyes bu che chung sogs kyi 'grel bshad brgyab pa ni/ rnam 'grel las/ dogs pa 'brel med gzhan bkod nas/ lan ni 'brel med gzhan btab pa'i bzhad gad kyi gnas su gsungs pa de kho nar song 'dus pa mkhyen par mdzod/ sangs rgyas zhes pa sku mdzes pa/ gsung snyan pa/ thugs bkra ba zhig ga shed cig tu yod kyang rung la med kyang rung / theg chen gyi skyes bu de tsho bde ba can sogs dag pa'i zhing khams rnams su sos dal bag phebs kyis bzhugs chog kyang 'dra la ma chog kyang 'dra/ zhogs dung gis ni de'i skor la sngar the gtogs byas mi 'dug cing / phyis su yang kha mchu rgyag mi srid pas de'i phyogs nas khos mi shes shes mdog gis bstan pa dkrug 'gro ba'i thugs khral de 'dra ma gzhi nyid nas gnang dgos med/ rang don yod tshad rtsab nas blos btang ste thog mtha' bar gsum du mi gzhan par phan bde kho na bsgrub rgyu'i dam bca' bzhag sbyor ba lag len la yang de ga rang btab nas dus 'da' ba'i bsam sbyor rlabs po che de 'dra ni/ sbo la gshog pa btags nas bar snang du 'phur ba'i chos pa'am/ thar pa sgrub mkhan tsho'i mtho snyeg bya yul zhig yin pa las/ mig gis mdun la bltas nas gom pa sa thog tu sbo ba'i 'jig rten pa'am 'tsho gnas la 'bungs mkhan tsho'i don du gnyer bya min/ 'di ni zhogs dung sogs 'jig rten 'khor ba pa rnams kyis dus ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 'dor mi srid pa'i langs phyogs dang / phyogs bcu dus gsum du springs pa'i bsgrags gtam yang yin/—231—
langs phyogs 'di dang bsgrags gtam 'di dam pa lha chos dang d+ma mthun pa'i ngan rtog ngang log pa'i slob gso yin shas che/ 'jig rten mi chos dang yang rgyab 'gal gyi 'chal btam yin gsungs pa ni bden pa ma red/ thog mtha' bar gsum du rang nyid kyi khe phan la stos med kyis mi gzhan pa'i bran g.yog tu rgyug dgos pa'i mi chos ring lugs kyi bsam blo dang kun spyod de 'dra stong bshad dmar po'i lam lugs tsam ma gtogs gzhan 'dzam gling shar nub gang du'ang dar myong med/ tshe snga phyi dang / las rgyu 'bras/ dam pa'i chos bcas la yid ches med phyin chad mi gcig gis gcig la mi rung snyam pa dang / mi 'os snyam pa de 'dra gang sna/nga med par ngan spyod sna dgu 'dzem zol med par byed nges so// zhes pa 'di chos pa tshos so so'i gnas bab mtho ru gtong ched rang nyid kyi ga'/ che'i rang bzhin 'ad sgrob byas pa tsam red/ de lta min par dngos su de ltar bsams te smra ba yin na ni/ smra mkhan rang nyid rtog btags lha chos kyi 'khrul t+na nga kho na las/ dngos yod mi chos ring lugs la cha rgyus rta rnga tsam yang med pa'i rmongs rtags phyi ru bstan pa las gzhan ci/ skad cha de la lan mang po mi dgos/ da lta 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab phal cher yod do cog gis rnam pa 'dra la mi 'dra ba'i khrims dang sgrig gzhi'i gtan 'bebs yod tshad/ khrel dang ngo tsha/ drang bden bcas mi chos kun spyod kyi tshad gzhi kho nar brten nas gtan la phab cing lag bltar byed kyin yod pa las/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs skul dang / lha — 231—
'ogs dung oṃ bdong grolas/yul gyi 'tsho ba bede sgyid ldan pa dag bis bslu brid byas te las don sgru ba mkhyen su yang med pa 'di ma khyen par 'tshal zhes zhu ba yin/ 'on kyang chos srid zung 'brel zhes chos srid sanyis med kyi lam lugs gnyer mkhan kha cig la gong si skad cha des cung zad ma khyabacana'ang thang / mtshams 'dir ngas nyid la mi chos kun spyod kyi mtshan gzhi thung thung gnyis/ dper brjod kyi tshul du ngo sprod zhu bar bya ste/ pha yul khams dkar mdzes phyogs nas yin pa'i pho gzhon zhig yo rob dbus ma'i yul gru si wes tser gyi bu mo zhig dang gnyen sgrig byas te yul gru der 'tsho ba skyel bzhin yod/ yu'/ der dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs ha cang bzang zhing de'i dbang gis dpya khral yang ljid po zhe drag red/ gal srid so so'i gla cha'i nang nas nyam thag si mi gzhan pa tshor rogs phan 'dra gnang mkhan yod na dpya khral chag yang gtong ba'i srid jus shis yod pa yin 'dug bod pa'i pho gsar khos srid jus 'di shes rtogs byung 'phral so so'i bza' zlar bshad rgyur/ de lo 'u gnyis pos nged kyi pha yul gyi mi ser nyam thag kha cig la rogs skyor bya 'char yod pa'i snyan zhu zhig phul nas dpya khral gyi khur po yang du gtong thabs bya/ zhes/ dga' spro'i ngang nas gros mgo bton pa na/ ma bsam sa nas bza' zla mo rlung langs thag chod de/ khyod ni mi ci 'dra'i khrel med cig red/so so'i rgyal khab la skyag rdzun bshad nas mgo skor gtong dgos bsam gyin 'dug gam/ drang bden gyi khrims lugs 'og tu mgo mi sgur ba'i ngan rengs kyi — 233 —
blo ngan de 'dra su/ zhig gis/ bslab byung / phyin chad skad cha tha shal de 'dra nam yang ma bshad cig de lta min na nged gnyis lhan du 'grig thabs med ces lab byung zer/ bu mo de dngul la ma dga' ba min la/ phyi ma'i bu lon la skrag pa ni de bas kyang min/ mi tshe ni lugs mthun drang bzhag gis skyel dgos pa dang / g.yo sgyu khram gsum gyi sgo nas gson pa bas/ bden pa bden thub bcangs nas shi na bzang ba'i kun spyod slob gso yag po zhig thebs yod pa'i dbang gis/ mos rang gi gdong par bsam bzhin du nag thig 'bri ma 'dod pa red/ da dung yul der dngos po che chung gang 'dra zhig bor stor byung song yang slar do bdag gi lag tu mi tshud pa mi srid pa lta bu dang / sung lam nang du rkun jag gis mi yi lus steng nas chadangul dngos ham 'phrog byed pa'i gnas tshul ni go myong thos myong tsam yang med zer/ de bzhin 65 ri'i rgyal khab la mtshon na/ khyim du rkun ma 'dzul nas khyim chas skyel 'dren byed 'gro ba'i gnas tshul de 'dra'i dpe mi srid la/ khyim mtshes bar la dogs pa byas te sgo la zwa brgyab dgos pa'i srol yang dar med/ de tsho yang dmyal yul la zhed cing lha yul la spro ba rgyas drags pas min par kun spyod slob gso'i nus pas yin/ yang deng sang nub phyogs yul gru khag tu khyi dang byi la gson por bsha' ba dang / spre'u gson po'i klad pa ldag pa sogs dud 'gro sems can gyi rigs la tshad las brgal ba'i sdug sbyong mnar gcod btang na srid gzhung gis khrims thog nas rtsar byed yong gi yod la/ dus —234
gtan du dmar zas spong mkhan yang lo re bzhin du je mang red/ nye char 'jar man gyi rgyal khab gcig pur mi 'bum lnga lhag gis sha bcad skad/ kho tsho'i chos lugs ltar na dud 'gro rnams ni dkon mchog yi/sa mi la gnangs pa'i dngos grub yin pas bsad pa dang zos pa la sdig pa ci yang brtsergyu med/ des na sha gcod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang po ni/ mi'i lus khams la sha zas 'di 'phrod po zhig gtan nas min par shes pas dang / gnyis pa ni tshe srog yod tshad la tshe srog gi rtsis thang zhig sprod 'dod pas red/ bya spyod 'di dag gis ma nam 4/kha' dang las rgyu 'bras gleng rgyur dga' ba'i mi rigs 'dir khrel dgod byed kyin mig'dug gam/ zhor du bshad rgyu gzhan zhig yod pa ni/ca phyir sdod bod mi'i spyi tshogs su dud 'gro rang dbang tshogs pa zhes pa zhig gis/ dmar zas nyung 'phri gtong thabs kyi las 'gul spel bzhin yod la/ grub 'bras kyang yag po thob ste phyir sdod rang rigs spu na zla'i khrod du sha mi za ba'i mi khri tsho kha shas byung yod zer/ yin na'ang kho tsho'i las 'gul der dka' ngal che shos gnyis 'phrad bzhin yod pa las gcig ni/ sbor to mor to de tsho ngan lang shor nas rang nyid sha gcod rgyu phar bzhag phru gu tshor yang sha ma zos na gzugs pos ar brten gyi ma red ces ngan skul gtong ba dang / kha lag bzo dus stabs bde po mi 'dug ces sdug shod mug shod byas te gzhon skyes tsho mi 'dod bzhin du sha bza' ru bcug pa 'di yin la/ dka' ngal gzhan zhig ni/ grwa sa che khag gi dge bshes rnam pas —235
phyir rtos sha za tshog pa dang / za dgos pa'i rigs log cig khur 'ong nas dngos r+ya thong si gnas tshul ji tsam zhus kyang ga san 'jog mi gnang ba 'di red zer/ ye shu'i chos pa tshos ston pa ye shus sha zos na nyes pa med ces pa'i lung de las brgal nas sha zos na mi bzang ba'i gnas lugs khas len thub kyin yod mod/ bod kyi chos pa tsho sangs rgyas la dad pa che drags pas sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang 'gal dogs kyis sha za khrag 'thung ma brgyab ka med du gyur yod pa 'dra/ lo nas lor bsgril te ston pa tshad sgrub gnad ba'i grub 'bras de 'dra'i yag po zhig thob 'dug da dung 'bad brtson gyis dang / mi ring bar mi gsod chog pa dang / rku brgyab dgos pa'i lung tshad ma de 'dra'ang rnyed rgyu yod shas che/ blun dad dang rmongs dad bya rgyu mang drags na de 'dra ma gtogs mtha' rgyu ci zhig yod/ drang por bshad na kho tshos sanges rgyas kyi bka' la skrag nas sha za ba rang dag min/gtso bo rang nyid sha 'dod kyis sangs rgyas ni kha lag phyi sa tsam dang / de min gnas tshul gzhan zhig ni/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang dang / ngor e wam pa kun dga' bzang po gnyis la brten pa'i grub mtha'i chags n+da nga zhig gis kho tshos sdig pa mig btsums 4mi byed ka med du chags yod pa red/ sha ma zos na shor 'gro ba'i mkhas grub rje dge legs dpal bzang gi grub mtha' de dang / 'dre ma mchod na nyams 'gro ba'i rje tsong kha pa blo rbezang grags pa'i bstan pa de tsho snying re rje/ sha ma zos na lhas sbyin gyi brtul zhugs su 'gyur 'gro ba'i kho — 236 —
5 bsam tshul 'di/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang ge grub mtha' rtsab pu min mod da de ring de tsho bshad pa'i skabs min pas bskyur zhogdes na las 'bras khas mi len pa'i mi la rgyu 'bras yod mi srid snyam pa za / chos lugs ma dar ba'i phyogs su byams dang snying rje yang spel mi thub bo khu du dgongs pa ni gzigs rgya chung ba'i skyon yin/ rdul phran mtshon cha bzo can dang dbyug mkhan de tsho cha tshang chos dad med pa'i mi rnams yi na nges pa dang / chos dad can a+thi+-i mis rdul mtshon gyi ched du mdzub mo tsam yang sa mi srid do snyam du dgongs pa yang gsan rgya chung ba'i skyon yin/ chos dad 5nga che ba'iḥkha che'i rgyal khab i ran dang / nang ba'i rgyal khab byang kho re ya sa kyis gzhan pas bkag kyang mi khogs par phu shor byor gyis rdul mtshon bzhin yod/ nyi tong zhi grong khyer he ru sha ma dang / na kha ge khru 4nyis kyi thog la mtshon dngos su bed spyod gtong malan gyi a me ri ka yang ye shu'i chos la khams yin/ 'jar man gyi dmag dpon hi thi lir zer ba sa yis mi thegma gyis mi khebs pa'i sdig nyes gsog mkhan de yang chos dad med pa'i mi da/ chos dad che drags pas mi lo nyis stong yar sngon gyi sha 'khon btsad de mi rigs sa ya drug sa la brdabs pa/ red/ de tsho'i chos dad de chos/ dad go ma min na da chos dad go chod ma'i mtshan gzhi zhog cig nga tsho bod pa tsho'o 0du dgongs na/ bod pa tshos rdul phran mtshon cha bzo ma tshes nas lus pa yin — 231 —
nam// snying rje bsgoms te ma bzos par bzhag pa yin gcis/ gsungs gnongs dang gus pas dgod bzhin nyan chog mdor na mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ mi bsrun brlang por spyod pa'i skye bo la// mgo bo gcongaji nga/'i khrims lugs ma mdzad na// snying rje'i lam nas tshul de rdzog pa la// dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bstan la sa thabs gzhan ci// zhes gsungs pa ltar ches gdod ma dang ches kla klo yin pa'i spyi tshogs nang gi bsam blo nar ma son pa'i mi tsho mgo skor ba dang skrag 'phud pa'i cha la ga tu chos gzhung nas bshad pa'i byams snying rje dang / las 'bras sogs mkho gal chen po yod/ mi chos kun spyod kyi rtsab brtan yo ra tshuzla'i tshar ba'i spyi tshogs dag tu ni de tsho la don dngos kyi rin thang cher med ngeng sa nga dpa la yon dar ba'i rgyal khab dag tu 'di dag la dga' po byed pa ni/ yid ches kyi dbang gis min par dgos pa'i dbang gis red/ dper na mi sngu gi nga/ bsgoms nas chags sred gnon thabs byed pa dang 'dra/ tshe rabs gzhan du rin thang je tsam yod zhogs dung gis gleng mi 'dug zhogs dung gi rgyud la tshe lnga phyi dang las rgyu 0bras yod nges yin pa'i nges shes med la/ med nges yin snyam pa'i log rtogs kyang med/ yod med gang yang thag ma chod par the tshom dang partag bya'i gnas su bzhag yod/ khos yod med thag mi chod pa'i de tsho'i ched du yod nges pa'i mi tshe'i bde skyed 'di blos gtong byed phod kyin med/ gus pas bltas na'ang kho'i langs phyogs 'di 'grig bzhag snyam/ song na phan thogs yod — 238—
med dang / sa phyogs gang du 'gro dgos min ma shes gong nas sang sar smyo rgyus byas kyang ci zhig phan/ des na zhogs dung sogs la tshe snga phyi dang las rgyu 'bras med thag chod nges kyi rigs pa khur 'ong dgos pa'i 'os 'gan ci yang med pas/ yin gcig min gnyis de 'dra'i rigs pa zhig khur 'ong dgos zhes btsan bka' mi gtong bar zhu/ rjes phyogs su de 'dra'i ris/sa pa khur 'ong mkhan zhig thug na de dus mi 'chugs par zhu/ chos ma bsgrubs pas yar rgyas 'gro na/ zing 'khrug lo bcu'i ring la ma ṇi tsam yang 'don mkhan dkon pas ska bas der yar rgyas ci zhig byung 'dug ston dgos/ zhes pa'i khyed kyi bka' bkyon 'di dang /jidge bshes mun 'joms sgron me lags kyis kyang / chos lugs srid 'byor 'tsho ba'i bkag yin na// dus zing chos ska da rna dang bral ba'i 5/bas// rgya dang bod la tshan rig dngos po'i dpal// 'phel kha dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas yod dam/ zhes chi ba rdzig po zhig 'phangs 'dug pa 'di dag spyir na blun gtam gdug pa can ] stag red ces smra bar 'dod mod/ bod yul mkhas pa yongs kyi gral mgo nas nal mar 'khor gyis bzhugs yod pa'i dge bshes khyed cag blun po sha stag red ) sa zhus na cung mi bde bas da ni gtam 'di dag 'khyog gtam sha stag dang //dzod rnam pa ni gnad 'gag gi skabs su drang bden bskyur te 'khyog lam du bas mkhan sha stag red 'dug ces mi zhu ka med chabs song / chos bsgrub mi sgrub de ma ṇi 'don mi 'don la thug yod pa e red/ ma ṇi mi 'don pa dang — 239—
phyir rtog 'don mi phod pa gnyis la khyad par e yod// yod na chos mi thru ba pa dang bsgrub mi phod pa'i khyad par mi 'byed par rgyug pa leb rdung ci la byed/ chos bsgrub pa zude yar rgyas kyi gegs yin pa'i dbang du btang rung / chos ma bsgrubs nga/ tsam gyis yar rgyas 'gro bas ga la khyab/ 'bras bu skye ba la 'gal rkyen med pa tsam gyis mi chog par mthun rkyen kyang 'dzoms dgos pa ma yin nam / da dung dpal 'byor yar rgyas 'gro ba'i gesas chos kho na las gzhan med ces sus smras/ des na zhogs dang khyod ltar na/ rig gnas gsar brje'i ring la yar rgyas chen po zhig song bar khas len dgos pa'i skyon yod/ ces pa'i skyon cha de zhogs dung gi kha la bskus kyang mi 'gos pa zhig yin pa maskrun par mdzod la/ phyin chad mig gson po'i nang du thal ba shi ro 'di 'dra mi 'debs par zhu'o// dpal 'byor da nga risas gsar dar ba'i cer son pa'i rgyal khab gzhan dag gi nang du phyi ra nas 5 chang ngu 'i bar gyi chos lugs sna tshogs dar zhing rgyas kyang de gnyis gnod bya gnod byed du ma song ba dang / nga tshor de gnyis gnong bya gnod byed kyi 'gal bar song ba gnyis mi 'gal/ ba /9nan dag gis chos lugs de kha dang la ku pas bsgrub mi thub pa'i sems nang gi re ba la cig bsgrub pa'i ched du bed sbyo/da ku/tong bzhimyo yod la/ nga tshos kha thog tu rdo rje bzhag cing lag zung ga lcags sprog brgyab nas la dang lag pa gnyis kyi tshab tu chos lugs bed spyod gtong bzhin yo da/ da dung dpe gzhan dag cig gi steng nas gsal bshad zhus na/ chos —240—
lugs 'di tshwa zhig yin pa'i dbang du btang na/ gzhan pas zas kyi bro ba 'don pa'i ched du za bzhin yod la/ nga tshos grod log brgyag pa'i ched du 'gam bzhin yod/ de'i dbang gis gzhan pa'i bde thang ge grogs dang nga tsho'i dgra ru gyur pa red/ ngas nga tsho'i chos lugs dang mi rigs bar gyi 'brel ba dang / gzhan pa'i chos lugs dang mi rigs bar gyi 'brel ba gnyis mi 'dra bas/ de gnyis gcig gis gcig la spar bkab bya mi rung bar bshad don de yin/ nang pa'i chos la theg pa rim pa r+ya nga po yod pa dang / skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim gsum yod pa'i skor de yang bshad bskyar bshad mi dgos/ zhogs dung gis de tsho'i skor la ched du zhib 'jug dang nyams len gang yang bya ces mi 'dug de dag gis bsgru ba bya ni yod med ha mi go ba'i phyi ma zhes pa de'i bde skyid red la/ zhogs dung la dgos rgyu ni yod nges pa'i da gang gi bde skyid red/ de gnyis bar la thun mong gi skad cha med ces sngar nas zhus zin/ las 'bras la yid ches med na/ dmar gsod/ rku 'phrog btsan g.yem/ bza' 'thor/ mgo skor/ mtshang 'bru sogs phung krol sna tshogs kyis spyi tshogs hril po gang 'gro ba'i nges pa'ang gtan nas med/ bod la bza' 'thor nyung ba 'di yang gcig na mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba la 'khrug cha dang / rnyog 'dzing che ba'i spyi tshogs khrod du 'dug mi dgos par ri lug lung kyog re na 'tsho ba skyel bzhin yod pa dang / gnyis na bud med tsho la khyo ga'i brnyas bcos dang gnya' sga khur rkyang ma gtogs mgo bo 'degs pa'i — 241 —
phyir rtog spobs pa med pa dang / gsum na bud med la rang rkya pher ba'i 'tsho rten nam las ka med par khyo ga la re nas 'dug dgos pa dang / bzhi na goms gshis dang mi kha'i gnon shugs ma theg par mi 'dod bzhin du sdug sgu ra byed pa dang /lnga na pho mo'i 'brel ba la ngos 'dzin yag po med par ngu 'dzing thal gtor kho na'i khrod nas mi tshe 'phro brlag gtong ba bcas kyis yin pa las chos lugs kyi bka' drin gcig pus ma yin/ lar chos pa tsho'i bsam blo 'di mtho dus mtho tshod mi zin pa dang / dma' dus dma' tshod mi zin pa zhig 'dug pa ni ngo mtshar che ste/ skabs res 'ga' ni gzhan la phan zhig thogs na rang nyid dmyal ba rdo rje gdan du 'gro dgos song yang dga' rgyu ma gtogs sdug rgyu med snyam du bsam pa dang / skabs ris 'ga' ni skye ba phyi ma la bu lon 'jal dgos kyi red snyam nas skrag gi 'dug gal srid phyi ma'i rnam smin zhes pa zhig med pa'i dbang du btang na/ rku 'phrog dang gsod rdung gang la yang ya nga dang bag tsha dgos don med snyam bzhin yod 'dug mi chos smra ba dag gi bsam blo ni 'di lta ste/rang rin po che las rtsa che ba zhig med stabs gzhan don du rang nyid blos gtong ba'i byang sems kyi rnam thar de 'dra ni 'khyongs re bral/ de lta na'ang rang gcig pu'i khe phan la dmigs te mi gzhan pa'i mgo thog tu zhabs bro brgyab na mi 'grig gzhan dag kyang nga rang dang 'dra bar bde 'dod sdug bsngal mi 'dod mkhan rkyang pa yin pas kho tsho'i bde sdug dang khe gyong la yang bsam shes —242—
thub los dgos/ snyam pa'i ku/na spyod kyi mdon zhig rtsibasrung byed kyin yod pa red/༷ nga'i grogs po zhig gis/ nga tsho'i chos lugs 'di dmar po'i lam lugs dang 'dra po zhe drag yod/ dmar po'i dbang 'dzin pa tshos kyang / spru/ nas dmangs kyi don du tshogs pa btsugs nga/ dang / rgyal khab kyi don du srid skyong ba/tshogs pa ga ge mo/'i sngon thon rang bzhin/ zhes sogs thos pa tsam gyis grol 'gro ba sha stag shod kyin mi 'dug gam/ don dngos su kho tsho btsan shed kyi sgo nas kha mar 'khor te mi dmangs kyi mgo thog tu bsdad yod pa las/ mi dmangs kyis nga tsho'i dbu khrid khyod yin zhes yar bzhag pa min/ dngos gnas byas na kho tshos mi dmangs la mi dgos pa'i legs skyes de 'bul mtshams bzhag nas/ mi dmangs la dgos pa'i rang dbang de gcig sprad bzhag na ci 'dra'i legs pa la ang/yin na'ang da de tsho gling mi nyan/ gleng na ngo log pa'i nag nyes 'khri 'ong ba red/nga tsho'i chos pa rnam pas kyang zhal nas 'gro ba sems can thams cang sogs bka' mol snyan po sha stag gsung nas bzhugs yod/ don du rang nyid rang mgo mi thon par gzhan la zhon nas 'gro dgos mkhan sha stag red bzhag khong rnam tshos mi theg bzhin du khur ba'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad phar g.yugs te/rang nyid rang gi rkang pa gnyis kyi thog tu yar la gcig langs thub na dga' ba la ang / yin na'ang da de tsho bsam mi rung / gal srid de 'dra bsam pa yin na sdig pa tshabs chen bsags tshar ba red/ ces bshad song la der kho bos ma red —243—
phyir rtog ce ces lan 'debs shes ma song ngo // du nub phyogs pa dag gis rdul phran mtshon cha sna tshogs bzos te srog chags yongs rdzogs gshin rje'i sgo drung du mug tu gcug pa 'di snub phyogs pa dag las 'bras la yid ches med pa'i skyon ga la yin te/ de 'dra'i dpal 'byor dang lag rtsal rtser son gyi nub phyogs pa de tsho'i khrod du phyi pa nas nang pa'i bar gyi chos lugs sna tshogs dar zhing rgyas nas yod pa'i phyir/ 'di la lan byung na gus pas khyed kyi drung du gus phyag 'tshal chog zhogs/ dung khos/ dam pa lha chos kyis 'bri bzhengs byas pa'i 'jig rten de zhi bde tshad med/ mnyam gnas tshad med/ rang dbang tshad med/ thob thang tshad med cig yin yang de ni 'byung 'gyur smon pa gtong sa tsam las mngon sum dbang po'i spyod yul du slebs dka'/ldes sogs bris pa de tshor sku nyid kyis go ba yag po zhig lon yod na shog bu hūṃ zlu/ // ||/ /| bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ — 2sgyu
ma rung snyam du dgongs bzhin yod 'dug pa de 'dra la zer/ sngon bstan pa yar dar gyi dus su'ang sa steng gi mi yongs rdzogs mi dgos brgya cha gcig gis kyang bdag gzhan brje thub med na/ deng sang ni snyigs ma lnga mtsho ltar rdol ba'i dus yin rabs 'dug pas/ dus ngan 'gi 'dra'i skabs su gnam 'og sa steng gi mi yongs rdzogs kyis bdag gzhan brje rogs bya rgyu ma red snyam/ 'grub thabs med pa zhig la re stong brgyab ste bzhugs na dus tshod 'phro brlags ma red dam/btsan po gnyom chung la sdang ba sogs dam pa'i chos kyi dgongs pa min yang 'gro ba mi'i gshis ka yin/ mi ma shi'i bar du gshis ka bsgyur mi thub/ mi thub bzhin du u tshugs byed pa ni lkugs rtags yin/ mi gshis dang mi 'tsham pa'i rig gzhung de ngo mtshar ci 'dra zhig che yang don du rig gzhung skyon can zhig las ma 'das/ spyi snyoms chen po'i ring lugs de la'ang stong lab rgyag tu bcug na skyid po zhe drag yod/ lag bltar byed skabs mi'i rang gshis dang rtsab nyid nas 'tsham gyi med/ de'i dbang gis da char mi kun gyis de bsgyur te dngos phan ring lugs bdams pa red/ lo rabs bdun cu pa'i nang du spyi la bdag pa'i lam lugs lag bltar byas/ phan tshun rogs ram byas/ phan tshun gzhogs 'degs byas/ mnyam za byas/ mnyam las byas/ mi byed dgu byed mang po zhig byas byas pa'i mthar/ mjug 'bras yag po gcig kyang ma byung bas da gzod rang gi gdong pa dang lhan du/ stong gtam de dang stong bsam de gnyis 'dzam gling gi mi —245—
yongs rdzogs kyi mig mdun nas chu bo'i gzhung la bskyur dgos byung ba red/chos lugs yin na 'dra/ srid lugs yin na 'dra/ mi gshis la rtsi'ajog dang khas len ma byas na 'ong rgyu de ga rang red/ sangs rgyas chos lu gas kyis kyang chags sdang rmongs gsum mi'i rang gshis yin pa la rtsi'ajog gnang thub med/de'i dbang gis nam yang gra ma 'grig pa sha stag yong gi yod/ 'dzam gling 'dir dug gsum gtan nas med pa'i mi sngon chad su zhig byon myong / da lta su zhig bzhugs yod/ ma 'ongs par su zhig 'byon bzo 'dug bskal chen grangs med gsum gyi ring la dug gsum tshar gcod kyi g.yul 'gyed gnang myong bar grags pa'i ston pa khong nyid kyang / srid pa tha ma'i dus su da dung btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du bzhugs nas sras bskyed gnang ba min nam/ 'di dag yod tshad la ma chags chags pa chen po zhes sogs kyi mdzes zhwa sna tshogs bsgron bzhin yod mod/blo rig ha cang brtul drags pa'i mi min thog min kha cig dang / blo rig ha cang rno drags pa'i mi min lha min kha gcig ma gtogs mi mtshan nyid pa su zhig gi rna bar 'gro/ 'dod chags med kyang yod mdog ston dgos kyin yod na dang po nyid nas ma spangs par beskyur gzhag na yag shobasha red/ thog mar dka' las ma che dgu che brgyab ste med par bzos/ med par bcos tshar ma thag tu 'dug ma bde bas yod mdog gi bcos rdzun 'khrab dgos byung ba yin na las ka de nor 'khrul las 'os ci yod/ nga tshos grub chen zhes 'bod pa'i rgya gar gyi sngags pa de —246—
tsho phal mo che dang / mar pa dang ra lo sogs bod yul gyi sngags rgan rnam pa'i rnam thar la ni dag snang dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i shel mig gyon rgyu med na mjal mi bzod pa sha stag red/ rje btsun tsong kha pa sogs 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i skyes chen gser ri'i phreng ba calta bu khong rnam tsho la mtshon na/ tshe btson gyi ske la g.yogs pa'i tshe sgo las kyang lci ba'i sdom khrims btsan po des gcun drags pas phyi tshul nas mjal na bag yod btsun tshugs can rkyang rkyang yin/ de lta na'ang nang logs su thal dong nang gi me bzhin mi yi rang gshis de sngar bzhin gson ngo ra gnas ban+da da yod/ chos lugs rang ngos nas bshad na/ dbyangs can lha mo dang rje btsun sgrol ma la 'jam dbyangs dang spyan ras gzigs la med pa'i yon tan lhag po ci yang bshad rgyu med yod/ rang re'i skyes chen tsho dbyangs can lha mo dang rje btsun sgrol ma kho nar bsnyen sgrub dang nyams len gnang bar dgyes/da dung gsung sgros la/ skyes pas mo lha dang / bud med kyis pho lha bsgrubs na 'grub thag nye zhes grags/ de ltar na sgrub mkhan gyi mi de tsho ma zad bsgrub bya'i lha kho tsho yang pho mo'i bar gyi rnyi rgya de las thar thub med nges red/ snyan ngag gi lam nas yi dam gyi lha mo de tsho la bstod ra gtong skabs/ rnam rgyal lha mo'i mig zur rno rabs/ ngag dbang dbyangs can ma'i sha lo dkar rabs/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i myos bum che rabs/ rig byed dbang mo'i brla sha mkhrang rabs/ rdo rje phag mo'i bha ga dam rabs sogs 'dod sred kyi gtam kho na gleng yod/ nu ma che zhing —241—
brla sha ma khrang ba sogs ni mdzes ma'i yon tan tsam las/ chos phyogs kyi yon tan gzhar yang min pas dad pa kho nas bstod pa yin na de tsho gleng don spu tsam med/ da dung rab rtog dang gzugs can gyi rgyan sogs kyi snyan rtsom 'bri skabs/ mchu sbyor ba/ sos btsir ba/ lces ldag pa/ sen mo 'debs pa/ spu zing ba/khrag dros pa/ mthang sbyar ba/ cha lang brdab pa/ 'khun bu shor ba/ ngu zug byed pa sogs 'jig rten 'khor ba pa'i gsang ba dmar dmar tig tig de tsho go skabs yod tshad bed spyad de 'bri ci thub gnang yod/ nam rgyun chags gtam bshad nas bsdad na skyes bu dam pa'i gral du tshud re med pas shod yod kyi med kyang /bstod pa dang snyan ngag gnyis rkya 'thab pa'i sgrib shing de'i 'og tu da gzod sems nang gi skad cha kha nas don 'ong ba dang / snying nad kha shas phyi ru 'phud thub kyi yod pa red/ khyad mtshar ba'i snang tshul 'di dag la dmigs te/ rje 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho sogs dam pa 'dul zhen can kha cig gis/ grwa pa dang dbyangs can ma'i bar la 'brel thag gcod dgos pa'i blang bya yang 'don dgos thug yod par ma zad/ pi wang khur ba'i bu mo der grwa zlog lha mo zhes pa'i ming ngan zhig kyang thogs yod/ 'di dag skyes chen khong rnam tsho la mtshang 'bru spu btog bya phyir bris pa min/ mi gshis khyad du gsod pa'i 'dod sdom ring lugs 'dis 'gro ba mi'i rigs la sdug ci tsam gtad yod pa dang / mi yi mi gshis ni shi ba'i nyin mor ma gtogs 'dor thabs med pa dang / mi la mi gshis dang mi —248—
mthun pa'i re ba nam yang ston mi rung ba sogs shes pa'i ched du bris pa lags/des na sa steng gi mi yod tshad kyis bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang / bdag gzhan brje ba dang / bdag bas gzhan gces sogs tshul bzhin nyams su len thub na yag po yong shas che yang / mi 'di tsho'i kha ngo dang bzo lta la bltas na sku nyid kyi thugs re de rmi lam dang sgyu ma la rlom sems byas pa tsam du zad cing / rmi lam gyi nang nas kyang rmi rgod dang / sgyu ma'i nang nas kyang sgyu lhod la rlom sems byas pa red snyam/'jig rten pas 'dzam gling zhi bde dang / 'gro ba mi'i thob thang rang dbang dmangs gtso'i lam lugs/ khrims dang srid kyi stangs 'dzin sogs don du gnyer yang / chos lugs pa'i dgongs pa lta ra mtha' gcig tu btsan po dang gnyom chung cha mnyam/ phyug po dang dbul po cha mnyam sogs dgos zer gyi med/btsan gnyom dbul phyug su yin yang rang rang la dpags pa'i thob thang re dang 'gan 'khri re yod ces shod kyi yod/ khrims mthun gli sgo nas phyug yo phyug po'i lam du 'gro chog pa ni mi chos ring lugs kyi thob thang yin/ phyug po'i 'bad 'bungs la rtsis med kyis med po dang cha mnyam bzo dgos pa ni lha chos ring lugs kyi dgongs pa yin/ de gnyis mi mtshungs bzhin du mtshungs pa bsgre ba'i thal 'gyur 'phen pa ni 'phen mkhan nyid kyi blo skyon yin/ chu 'di'i phar kha nas 'jigs su rung ba'i 'dre zhig gis bsgugs nas bsdad yod rgyu red snyam nas — 249 —
dngangs skrag dang mya ngan gnang ba ni ri bong gnam rdib gyi sdug bsngal yin/slar yang lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi sogs las brtsams pa'i bgro gleng gnang ba ni dgos pa med pa'i zlos skyon yin/ dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ mi rnams bde ba'ang longs spyod med min la/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ni lag len med pa'i kha g.yang yin/ de yin te/ longs spyod med na bde ba mi 'byung ba sus kyang shes pas gsal bshad mi dgos la/ longs spyod 'tshol thabs shig ston rgyu yod na kha tsha dgos gtugs yin kyang ston rgyu ma rnyed 'dug pas so// sbyin pa bstan mi 'dug gam snyam na/ bstan 'dug mod de longs spyod brlags thabs yin nam 'tshol thabs yin sus shes/ gzhung lugs kyi ngos nas bshad na mdo sngags gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i sangs rgyas chos gzhung gang gi nang du'ang longs spyod brlags thabs ma gtogs 'tshol thabs sna gcig bstan med la/ rig gnas che ba lnga dang chung ba lnga zhes grags pa'i rang re'i rig gzhung 'di hril po'i nang du yang 'tsho gnas la kha yod lag yod kyi phan thogs yod pa zhig phal cher mthong rgyu mi 'dug dper na/ bzo rig gis lha dang lha yi phyag mtshan kho na ma gtogs mi dang mi'i lag cha gcig kyang bzo ma myong / sgra rig la mtshon na 'dzam gling thog tu go brda 'phrod pa'i skad yig stong tsho kha shas yod par grags pa de tsho gcig kyang mi bslab par/ 'jig rten mi gcig la go brda mi 'phrod pa'i 'od gsal lha yi skad yin rabs kyi sgra gzhung zhig bslab nas sdod dgos —250—
pa red/ kho bos kyang lha skad 'di'i ched du dus tshod dang 'gro gron mang po gtong myong yod/ rjes phyogs lha yul du 'gro skabs skad sgyur khrid mi dgos tsam zhig yong mdog kha/ da lta mi yul du sdod ring ni khrom lam du thug pa phor gang mngags dgos kyang lag brda ma gtogs kha brda mi 'phrod pa'i kha stabs 'di ga red/ kha stabs 'di nyid kho bo gcig pu'i kha stabs min par lha ma gtogs mi mig nang du med pa'i rang re'i rig gzhung 'di dang nged gnyis thun mo nga gi kha stabs red ces bshad na'ang mi chog rgyu ci yod/ tshad ma'i gzhung gis kyang / mi yod tshad kyis ha go zin pa'i bum pa la mchu yod med dang / ri bong la ra yod med/ ba lang la nog yod med sogs rtsod pa shas che la/ gzham rgyu 'bras dang /'gal 'brel gyi rnam gzhag sogs tshan pa yag po kha shas yod kyang / de tsho kha thog nas shod pa tsam las 'tsho ba'i khrod du bed spyod 'asnga ltar btang nas dka' khrag 'di 'dra zhig sel yod ces su la yang ston rgyu med/ go thos la ciyoge rig ni slob tshan kun gyi nang nas go dka' shos dang / mgo nyob shos de yin la/ slob chen gyi slob ma phal pa mang por skabs 'dir bsam blos ma 'dang bar klad par skyon shor ba'i nyen kha yod/ legs par shes na shes bya phal mo che la 'dis rgyas btab chog zer/ nga tsho la rtsis rig ngo thog ni ngagu mtha' rang las med cing / dgu mtha' ni nyi ma gsum la hur thag gis sbyang na yag thag chod shes 'gro bzo 'dug gus pas ched du sbyangs ma myong yang gros/sa pos ri mo 'bri zi—251—
bsub byed pa mthong myong stabs/ kha lag la byang cha med pa tsam las ri mo'i ngo bo lam tsam bud 'gro yi 'dug gnam rig skar rtsis kyis li tho zhig 'don srol yod pa'i nang don phal cher rmongs gtam shas che la/ gnam gshis sngon brda ni/la lar kha rlung 'khor/ 'thibs dwangs res mos byed/ yang na nyi ma ston/ mtshan mor 'bab shas che/ zhes pa lta bu red ma red gang yang zer mi btub pa'i spyang grung zhig 'khrab nas bzhag yod/ sa khams kyi skor la/ stong dang po/ stong gnyis pa/ stong gsum pa sogs chen po chen po mang po zhig la tshad dang thig btab yod mod/ dregs bral 'gram gyi sprel mthong yang // phor pa'i nang ni tshod ma mi mthong ba'i mngon shes ltar rgya nag bod kyi shar phyo nub byang gang du yod shes kyin med la/ lho shar gnyis ka rgya mtsho'i mtha' la thug pa'i rgya gar phyed gling de 'dzam bu'i gling gi lte ba dang / skam sa yongs kyi dbus dkyil yin zhes khron chung nang gi sbal chung gi rnam thar bskyangs yod/ snyan ngag gi brjod bya chos yin pa las 'jig rten ma yin/ sgyu rtsal gyi cha nas go dka' sla gnyis zhes pa zhig ma gtogs gzhan thun min gyi khyad chos yod pa'i lugs dang grub mtha' sna gcig bshad rgyu med/ mngon brjod dang zlos gar gnyis la ni gleng rin ci yang med/sdeb sbyor dang skar rtsis gnyis ni gleng tsam yang bya 'dod med/ ngom rin tshog pa gso ba rig pa 'di yin zer yang / grwa btsun tshos gso rig lag len byas nasdom pa 'tshor nyen yod/ ces 'dzem zol gnang dgos pas mu mthud yar rgyas—251—
'gro rgyu lta ci/ snying chu 'dren pa/ sgang lde'u len pa sogs lag len dka' tshad dkon tshad rgyun chad de/ deng sang za stabs mi bde ba'i khrog sman gyi sdeb sbyor tsam las gzhan ci yang lus med pa 'di ltar red/ des na dbu ma 'jug pa tsam min par bka' mdo rgyud bstan bcos dang bcas pa zhal phye nas mjal ba yin mod/ 'jig rten phun tshogs la phan nges pa'i nom pa 'di 'dug snyam pa zhig ma shar/ gzhung lugs kyi ngos nas de ltar yin pa ltar lag len gyi steng nas bshad na yang / bod brgyud nang bstan pas bod pa'i 'tsho ba dang kha rgyab thad nas bod mi tshor khur po lhag ma zhig bkal ba tsam las 'gan khur spu tsam ya/nga blangs med/ 'das pa'i mi lo stong phrag gcig tsam gyi ring la rang re'i chos pa tshos spyi tshogs phan bde'i bya gzhag gzhan dag dag lta ci ste/ ches bsgrub 'os pa'i shes yon gong 'phel gyi thabs lam tsam la yang / tha na mi ser dkyus ma'i bu phrug dkyus ma gcig kho na la yig rmongs sel ba'i rogs ram gnang myong ba'i lo rgyus shig mthong lam na e yod/ kho tshos kho tshor glo snying brang gsum gtad nas dmar dmar smug smug yod dgus mchod pa 'bul mkhan gyi dad ldan mi ser tshor lha mdun du phyag 'tshal du bcug pa dang / ri skor mtsho skor sogs su mngags pa/ gto dang zlog pa 'phen par skul ba/ ma ṇi grangs med cig gsog rgyu'i dam bca' 'jog tu bcug pa tsam kho na yin/ de'i dbang gis mi ser gyi blo ngor chos zhes pa de'ang de 'dra zhig tu 'char bzhin yod pa red/ mi — 253—
'bor brgya cha'i go grangs ka ngo ra ngo mi shes pa'i yig rmongs pa yin bzhin du/nga tshor phyi dngos po'i yar rgyas de tsam med kyang nang bsam blo'i yar rgyas ni 'dzam gling gi rtsemor slebs yod/ ces sogs kyi bka' mol gnang ba thos skabs ngo tsha 'ong bar 'dug mod rang nyid sha pags srab drags pa'i skyon yin shas che/ bod kyi zhing 'brog mi dmangs yod tshad ri khrod du bsdad 'dug zhu ba min yang / mi rigs gzhan pa nang bzhin las ka la hur po de 'dra min par/ lha sgrung dang ngag 'khyal la dang dod che zhing / pho ba 'grangs ma thag brang khog kha phyesadza nas nyi mar bsro 'ong ba'i sgyid lug 'thom sbrid che ba'i nal phrug 'di'i pha rgan de/ gang la yang snying po med zer mkhan gyi rig gzhung 'di min nam snyam du dogs bzhin yod/ le lo dang sgyid lug chos pa'i spang bya las blang bya min pa khyed bden yang / 'jig rten pa'i bya bar sgyid lug pa de chos pa'i blang bya dang / 'jig rten pa'i bya bar 'bad pa de chos pa'i lugs kyi bya ba ngan zhen gyi le lo zhes spang bya'i gras su gtogs pa ma yin nam/ chos lugs la cha rgyus chung ba'i zhogs dung gi mgo la rdza ma g.yog cis yin na ma gtogs chos pa'i lugs kyi le lo dang / 'jig rten pa'i lugs kyi le lo gnyis ming 'dra ba tsam las don ro rgyab gtad yin no// 'di tsam gyis kyang khyed rnam pa'i thugs sems de drang po drang bzhag dang / bla ma dkon mchog cig min pa'i thag chod ma song ngam/sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi rin thang de bden pa bzhi dang phyag rgya gsum —254—
gyi sgo nas 'jal dgos pa las/ lha 'dre gdon bgegs yod med tsam la rtsab nyid nas rag las med snyam mod/ sku nyid kyis ni/ a h+phe ri kha gling gi mtsho nang du 'dre gru gtong bzhin yod/ ces dang / a ri'i pho brang dkar po'i nang du shi 'dre rgyu bzhin yod/ ces dang / nga'i pha yul gyi mi zhig 'dre tshang la gos bzo ru 'gro myong yod/ ces sogs 'dre sgrung gzigs tshad dang / gtam 'chal gsan tshad bris te sangs rgyas chos lugs la dag 'bud gnang bzhin 'dug pa 'di ya mtshan/ tshan rig pa tshos a h+phe ri kha gling gi mtsho nang gi 'dre gru de tsho 'khrul snang red ces lab pa de 'grel bshad yang dag min pa'i khyab pa med/ nga tshos kyang rgya mtsho'i 'gram du nyi 'od 'phro stangs khyad par ba'i skabs 'gar dri za'i grong khyer zhes pa med bzhin du cig snang rgyu yod par bshad yod pas so// pho brang dkar po'i nang du shi 'dre rgyu bzhin yod pa bden pa yin tshe/ srid 'dzin rbu zhi tshang gis bod nang gi sngags pa kha shas gdan 'dren zhus te gshed 'dul zhig mi bca' ba ci yin nam/ sku nyid kyis khong stangs dpyal gnyis la de lugs kyi dran skul zhig gnang na e mi drag khyed kyi pha yul gyi mi de'i bshad stangs la bltas na/ kho 'dre tshang gis 'khrid pa min par kho la tsha ba stod rgyug gi na tsha zhig phog yod bzo 'dug dga' bzhi tshang gi byung ba brjod pa zhes pa'i deb der gcig gzigs dang / bka' blon bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor rgya nag tu 'khrid 'gro skabs lha 'brum na nas de ga rang lta bu'i tsha 'khrul zhig byung myong mi 'dug —255—
gam/ yin na'ang rdo ring bka' blon mkhas pa yin pas tsha 'khrul tsha 'khrul du ngos zin la/ khyed kyi pha yul/ gyi mi de la 'tshem 'drub kyi lag shes tsam las gzhan shes bya yon tan gang yang med pas bsam blo gtong ma shes par 'khrul snang dang dngos snang nor song tshod red/ de min na 'dre tshang nas khyer 'ong ba'i dar zab de shog bu tshig ror log 'gro don ci yod/ lar 'dre t+pu nga gis khyed la thugs phan sos bzhin yod na rjes phyogs su gus par 'brel ba gnongs dang mang po zhe drag zhu rgyu yod/ des kyang ma tshims na nga'i pha yul du phebs dang yul de ni 'dre sgrung gi 'jig rten yin/ sa 'bar 'bur re re'i thog tu 'dre du tsam bsdad yod pa dang / rdo 'cha' 'chu re re'i rtsaru 'dre su zhig nyal yod pa/ 'dre re re bzhin du na tshod ji tsam lon yod pa/ 'dre phan tshun bar na mthun lam gang 'dra chags yod pa/ 'dre pho mo'i bar na 'brel ba ji ltar byung yod pa/ 'dre khyo shug zung la 'dre phrug du tsam skyes yod pa/ 'dre de tshos de ring ci zhig za bzhin yod pa/ 'dre kho tsho sang nyin gang du 'gro rtsis yod pa sogs yod tshad lag mthil nang gi ri mo yin/ mi re regashi tshar ma thag tu/ mi de'i bla khur mkhan gyi 'dre de su yin pa dang / khur ba'i dus nam yin pa dang / 'khur sa'i yul gang yin pa dang / 'khur ba'i tshul ji ltar yin pa dang / 'khur dgos pa'i rkyen gang la thug pa dang / khur tshar nas ji ltar zos btang ba sogs kyang gsal gsal thing thing bshad rgyu yod/ 'dre sgrung bshad bshad nas bsdad de nam gyi —256—
gung la slebs dus khyim de ga'i pha rgan gyis phar 'gro'i sngon ma dang / tshur yong rjes ma'i srung skyob ma gnangs na byis bo dang bud med tsho'e skyag gcin phyi logs su mi thengs pa de 'dra'i tsham rtam yod pa red/ kho bo yang sngon chad byis pa skrag shor de tsho'i gras kyi gcig yin/ de lta na'ang rjes phyogs grong khyer nang du mar slebs ma thag 'dre tshogs yod tshad gnam thang pa ltar sngo sgag ger yar 'gro gi 'dug de'i rgyu mtshan gang yin ngas gsal por mi shes/ phal cher 'dre ni gna' rabs kyi srog chags yin stabs deng rabs kyi 'phrul chas la 'drog bzhin yod pa e yin snyam/ gang ltar 'dre ri dwags gnyis po gzigs 'dod na sa khug lung kyog rnams su phebs shig khyed rang gsan log thebs pa red ma gtogs cogs dung gis ni lha 'dre gdon bgegs med ces thag bcad mi 'dug kho la r+ya tshon na lha 'dre gdon bgegs yod med de gleng rin yod pa'i don dag cig gtan nas min/ 'tsho gnas kyi rgyal pham rtsodajipa'i 'jig rten 'dir/ lha 'dre'i khyu tshogs ci'i phyir 'tshang kha rgyag pa yin/ zhes pa 'dis kyang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba rnams mi'i yul nas phyir 'bud btang ba tsam las/ lha lha yul dang / 'dre 'dre yul na 'dug mi chog zer med/ de yang ga shed cig tu lha zhes pa'i tshe srog snying rje po zhig yod pa'i dbang du btang rud / kho la mchod bstod bkur ste byas pas nga tsho skyob mi srid/ de bzhin 'dre zhes pa'i srog chags zhig yod du chug mod/ des nga tsho za mi 'gro ba thag gis chod/ lha yis bskyabs — 257 —
pa'i lha snyung dang / 'dre yis zos pa'i 'dre sgrung ni sgrung rang yin pas rlom mi rung / 'jig rten mi yul 'di'i bdag po mi nyid yin pas/ mi las dbang thang mtho ba dang / mi las do gal che ba dang / mi las thob thang mtho ba dang / mi las stobs shugs che ba dang / mi las blo rig rno ba gzhan su yang med/ de bas lha la dga' zhing 'dre la zhed nas lha mchod 'dre rdung gi tsho ga phyag len mang po zhig bzos te/ de'i ched du mi thugs rgyu shugs dus tshod bcas phangs med du gtong ba ni mi dgos pa'i thugs khur 'o brgyal rang yin/ 'jam mgon zhogs dung tshang gi dgongs pa ni de 'dra red lags/ rang re bod mi rigs rjes lus su gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan yang lha 'dre gdon bgegs yod par bzung ba tsam gyis yin par mi 'dod/ dbang cha dang go sa yod tshad lha 'dre gdon bgegs kyi tshogs la rtsis 'bul zhus te/ 'u cag ni lha 'dre rnam pa'i zhor gtogs dngos po tsam dang /yang na lha 'dre gang rung gi rnam 'gyur tsam du ngos 'dzin bzhin yod pa 'dis lan pa yin par 'dod/ nga tshos skyes pa brgya yi nang nas dgu bcu go dgu lha pho dang / gcig 'dre pho/ bud med brgya yi nang nas gcig kho na lha mo dang / dgu bcu go dgu po yod tshade 'dre mo red ces shod srol yod/ shod srol 'dis rang re'i bud med tsho'i gnas bab gsal ler bstan yod la/ shod srol 'di la brten nas rang re'i bud med tsho'i mgo la sdug ci tsam bzhag pa dang / snying la rma ji tsam bzos pa sogs ni de ring mi gling / shod srol 'di la brten nas nga —258—
tsho'i sems nang du nga tsho ni mi ru snang ba tsam las don du mi min par 'dod bzhin yod par shes thub/ shod srol 'di la brten nas nga tshos lha 'dre ni gtso bo dang / nga tsho ni phal pa/ lha 'dre ni ngo bo dang / nga tsho ni rnam 'gyur/ lha 'dre ni don dam dang / nga tsho ni kun rdzob/ lha 'dre ni bden pa dang / nga tsho ni rdzun pa/ lha 'dre ni don dngos dang / nga tsho ni rtog bzo/ lha 'dre ni gnas lugs dang / nga tsho ni 'khrul snang / lha 'dre ni dpon po dang / nga tsho ni g.yog po/ lha 'dre ni gzhis pa dang / nga tsho ni 'gron po/ lha 'dre ni yod pa dang / nga tsho ni med pa bcas rgyal kha dang bden kha yod tshad lha 'dre la ster nas/ lha 'dre'i mdun du nga tsho ni 'bu zhig gi snang ba tsam las mi zhig yin snyam pa'i spobs pa tsam yang 'khur phod kyin med pa shes thub/ 'o na dbang cha dang go sa yod tshad lha 'dre rnam par rtsis 'bul ji ltar zhus yod snyam na/ mang po zhig bshad ga la dgos/ gnam la nyi ma zla ba/ sa la rgyal ba paṇa chen/ zhes tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi skyabs gnas/ chos 'jig rten gnyis ku'i bdag po/ yod na des chog med na des phung / dpral ba'i migkhog pa'i snying / khong rin po che rnam pa gnyis kyi bzhugs khri'i thog tu phru gu su zhig 'jog rgyu'i thag gcod cha tshang dpal ldan lha mo dang / gnas chung chos skyong sogs lha 'dre rnam pas gnang dgos kyi yod/ lha 'dre rnam pas thag gcod gnang ba'i phru gu de gnyis la nga tshos pus mo btsugs nas blo gtad lings bskyur byed dgos kyi yod/ yin na'ang da res lha 'dre tshos khri thog tu gzhag pa'i —2594
phru gu de gnyis kyis nga tshor blo gtad sa nas snying phug med/ gal srid khong rnam gnyis kyi bzhugs khri'i thog tu 'jam bzhad ra tsa gdong nyag tshang dang / zhing skyong dri med mgon po tshang lta bu zhig bzhag yod pa'i dbang du btang na a tsa ma de nas nga tshos ci byed dgos red/ rjes phyogs su de 'dra zhig 'jog mi yong ba'i nges pa spu tsam med pas da ni bsam blo tan tig gtong dgos pa'i dus la slebs yod/ da dung lo rgyus thog tu phyir bltas shig gnongs dang / bod pa tshang li/ las dbang yong tshad thag gcod gnang ba'i bod rgya bar gyi chings yig don tshan bcu bdun la tha ma'i ngos len ñtsha mtshan rtags kyang lha 'dres lam ston 'og tu bskyon pa ma yin nam/ bod gzhis byes gnyis su gyes dang mi gyes kyi tha ma'i thag gcad kyang lha 'dre'i lam ston 'og tu byas pa ma yin nam/ kho ngos nam yang brjed mi thub pa'i mthong ba khyad mtshar zhig la/ hor khang bsod nams dpal 'bar gyi rnam thar las/ kho bo gzhon dus lha sa'i rtsam gnyer las khungs kyi gnyer pa'i 'gan khur ba'i lo de'i dpyid spru'i smon lam ñtsha ring der/nyin zhig gnyer tshang gi 'og shod mar rdo dang / bud shing sogs me 'jug sla ba'i dngos pos byur bur khengs pa der/ glo bur du me skyon chen po zhig shor te nyen tshabs shin tu che bas de 'phral gnas chung grags ldan dang / spyan g.yas ra mgo can gnyis gdan 'dren zhu bar rgyug pa yin zhes bris 'dug tshig gsal po mi dran kyang don de 'dra zhig red/ ci me la chu mi gtor bar 'dre gdan 'dren zhu —260—
bar brgyugs nas mgo thod pa ci zhig bya rtsis yin sus shes/ da dung rgyal mchog bcu gsum pa chen po'i4sku khams dza drag can du gyur skabs/ sku'i bla sman pa phar bzhag ste/ 'dre gnas chung chos skyong la sman bcos byed du bcug pas khong de 'phral med par chags pa sogs re re bzhin du brjod kyis mi lang nga tshos lha 'dre la re bcol dang / yid ches de 'dra sha stag byas yod pa las/ sa rko rdo slog sogs las don phran tshegs re sgrub skabs yul lha gzhi bdag tshor skrag mi skrag gi skad cha tsam ni min lags/ 'o na lha 'dre de tshor mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul sogs gzhan dang ma 'dra 'dra zhig yod dam zhe na cung zad kyang med/ gal srid mngon shes dang lung bstan phra mo tsam zhig yod rgyu na/ paṇa chen dge 'dun chos kyi nyi ma rgya lag tu ma brgyab tsam zhig yong dgos shing / de ltar byung na go lan gcig chod pa yin mod/ mkho nyag la thug dus na smug gi dkyil du brgyab pa'i wa rang red/ mi dgos pa'i dus su/ dus bde zhod 'jags kyi skabs su/ nyin bzhin lha mi khog tu zhugs shing / mgo ḍa ru ltar 'khrol bzhin/ ci yang zhu rgyu med na yang cig yod khul gyis/ kha snyan khung la gtug cing / nga'i slob dpon ṣ+yo/thong ba don ldan/ zhes sogs mi 'jigs 'jigs mdog dang / 'dre ngan ngas khag theg bya chog ces sogs mi 'jon 'jon mdog gi lung bstan dang / bya byed sna tshogs kyis ri sgul zhing mtsho skyom 'gro ba de 'dra byed kyin 'dug dngos gnas drang gnas the'u rang lha zer ba de 'di 'dra min na ci 'dra yin snyam/ don 'di — 261—
das la bsam blo gtong skabs/ dgyes pa'i bzhad sgra 'byin rgyu phar ri'i mgo la rgyobs/ yi chad blo pham gyi mig chu shor 'gro bar 'dus go/ ches sngon thon can gyi nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi slob chen khrag gi nang du chos lugs la zhib 'jug dang /slob sbyong gnang ba tsam gyis slob ma de dag gi rgyud la ya thog shes rig gi bag chags 'jog pa'i nges pa med/ dpal ldan chos grags mi lo bcu gnyis ring la mu stegs pa'i gzhung la zhib 'jug dang slob sbyong gnangs nas bzhugs kyang /khong gi rgyud la mu stegs pa'i bag chags cung zad kyang 'gos med pa ltar red/chos med dmar po'i gzhung gis kyang / chos lugs de sgyi tshogs tshan rig gi zhib rkya4ga khyab khongs su bzhag ste zhib 'jug byed kyin yod/ gal srid nub phyogs pa'i slob myo/ 'ga' re'i rgyud la chos lugs sogs ya thog shes rig gi bag chabs cung zad re bzhag yod srid kyang / bag lugs dang chags lugs nga tsho dang mi 'dra zhes sngar nas zhus zin/ ye shu dang kha che'i chos pa'i grangs 'dren de'i nus pa de yin la/ rjes su 'gro ldog gi nges pa'ang de tsam yin/ spyir nub phyogos pa'i mi tshos chos la dad pa byed pa rgyu mtshan du drangs nas nga tshor mig dper ston don med de/ kho tsho phyug po'i gces phrug brgyags nas mthu slob pa dang / 'u ma bu sdug thug nas mthu slob pa gnyis gnas bab gtan nas mi mtshungs pa'i phyir ro// tshan rig lag rtsal dang / bzo las gsar brje dag gis khor yug la thugs rkyen cis kyang thebs yod mod/ de tsam gyis de tsho skyon can —262—
du brtsis te 'gog mi rung / zas zos na btsog pa 'dor dgos pa'i dka' ngal yod kyang dka' ngal de la skrag nas za mtshams 'jog mi 'os pa ltar red/ gal srid gnad don de tshabs chen zhig yin pa'i dbang du btang rung / nga tsho la de'i thad nas 'gan 'khri dang nus pa gnyis ka gtan nas med/ nga tshos sngon chad khor yug la gnod 'tshe bzo myong med 0// ma 'ongs par mi lo brgya yi nang tshun du'ang nga tshos khor yug la do phog 'gro ba'i bzo grwa zhig brgyab mi 'ong ba'i 'gan 'khur thub/ de bzhin rdul mtshon gyi dgun dus zhes pa'i 'jigs su rung ba'i gnad don de'i thad nas kyang / nga tsho nang phan tshun gcig gis gcig la dogs pa dang / bslab bya de 'dra rtsab nyid nas gnang dgos med de/ nga tsho la rdul phran mtshon cha mi dgos me mda' rkang gcig kyang bzung rgyu med gas so//des na bslab bya dang 'jigs skul de dag nga tsho'i phyi logs su yod pa'i mi stobs chen de tsho dang / nga tsho'i mgo thog tu sdod pa'i mi dbang chen de tsho la gnang bar zhu/ nga tsho rkang pa gnyis la brten nas yar langs dgos pa thugs bden yang / rkang pa de gnyis mi rkang rang yin dgos pa las lha rkang dang 'dre rkang de 'dra yin mi 'os/ tshad rdul nus shugs kyi rigs pa dang / ltos grub kyi rigs pa/ phra ba'i 'jig rten dang / mkha' dbyings kyi rnam gzhag sogs rigs gsar gyis da gdod mngon du byas pa mang po zhig kho bo cag gi grub mtha'i nang du sngar nas mngon sum du gtan la phab tshar/ zhes sogs dpa' gtam dang —263
dpung ngom gnam sa ral ba'i tshod tsam zhig gnang 'dus pa 'di dag la da res lan mi zhu/ rjes phyogs su nyi ma dro dus shig dang / dus tshod yag dus shig la/ sa cha skyed sa zhig tu gdan 'dren zhus te/ mngar kyur kha gsum gyi bro ba 'dzoms pa'i gsol tshigs gra rgyas po zhig 'bul 'dod yod lags/ mkhan chen thugs rje can khong tshang gi kha mig sna gsum la bzo lta tog tsam zhig sprad zin to// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ kho bor mkhas pa'i tshogs la 'gran bzod pa'i//dri med rnam par dpyod pa mi mnga' yang // 'di na su dang gang la mi smon pa'i//gzu bo'i blo 'dis nam yang brod pa skyed//bod me phag zla 10 pa'i tshes 15 nyin/—— 264 —
deb sgrig pa po'i gsal bshad/tsha sgang blo gros dpal ldan nam tsha ba mda' smyug ni/ deng gi dus su dpyod pa'i blo mig shin tu rno ba'i na gzhon shes rab 'bar ba zhig red/ da nga por/ bdag gis66bod skad yig zin bris dra tshigs su kho pa'i zin bris su bkod pa'i rtsom yig dag brgyud de kho la do snang byed dgos byung zhing / phyis su grogs skal bzang sbyin pas mtshams sbyar pa la brten nas/ mda' smyug nged gnyis gas kha par gyi lam nas thengs gcig tsam la kha brda thung ngu zhig byas myong yod de/ngas kho la/ khyod kyi dra rtsom dag gcig tu dril nas deb tu bton na yag po red/ces par/ khos de mur/ kho ni grwa pa grwa rkyang zhig yin/ deb dpar skrun gyi cha rkyen ched ces lab byung / der ngas/ deb dpar skrun gyi dpe rtags kyi rin dang dpar —265 —
rin sogs kyi 'gro song ngas thabs shes byed chog 'on kyang khyod la deb bton pa'i rtsom yon ster thub rgyu ma red/ khyod kyis bsam blo yag po zhig btang rjes/nga la dpar chog dang mi chog gi lan zhig byin zhes bshad/ khos/ nga la rtsom yon mi dgos/ deb tu dpar skrun byed thub na par dbang ngas khyod la rin med du sprad chog ces de 'phral du thag bcad pa red/ rjes su/ khos rang gi zin bris su zin rtsom zhig gi mjug tu/ rang gi zin bris der bkod pa'i rtsom yig yod tshad kyi par dbang byang skar la sprad zin pas gzhan gyis mu 'god ma byed/ ces gsal bshad kha gsal zhig kyang bris 'dug cing / gsal bshad de nga dang nga lta bu'i kho pa'i zin bris la dga' po yod mkhan gyi dra klog pa tshos phal cher rig yod kyi red/de nas bzung / kho pa'i rtsom yig dag deb tu 'don rgyu'i don dag de nga'i sems su nyar nyar la yod kyang / lo 'di 'gar rang khyim gyi gtong sgo mang du 'gro dgos byung nas/ deb de dpar skrun byed rgyu'i dngul re zhig tshags ma thub pas/ thabs zad de kun su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang la/ kho tshos mda' smyug gi deb 'di 'char can gyi dpe skrun 'char gzhi'i khongs su 'jug rgyu'i re 'dun nan zhu byas par/ deb kyi rin thang la gzhigs nas/ rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa sku zhabs gcod pa klu rgyal dang / dpe skrun khang gi 'gan 'dzin rgan 'brug rgyal mkhar gnyis kur/ 〈〈phyir rtog〉〉ces pa'i deb 'di kho tsho gzhung nas dpar —266—
skrun byed rgyu'i yid 'thad byung ste/ bdag gi re 'bras kyang don thog tu smin song ba red/ 'dir/ kho bos rtsom pa po'i tshab byas te lhag bsam rnam das gis khong cag la thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / zhar la/ deng phyin deb 'di'i par dbang thad rtsodarnyog 'dra byung na yang / khur de sgrig pa po be'u brgya lha mo skyabs kyi gnya' la yod pa las kun su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang la med/ ces ched dmigs su gsal bshad cig byas pa yin no//byang skar nas zla tshes bzang por/2011/0'ge21/—267—
